title: 'Bella Astillah, Syed Saddiq to release reality show documenting their love story
body: 'Muar MP Syed Saddiq Syed Abdul Rahman and Malaysian singer-actress Bella Astillah are offering fans a closer look at their relationship through their upcoming reality series, Walimatul Urus Bella Astillah & Syed Saddiq. At a press conference in Kuala Lumpur last week, the couple said the show would chronicle their love story, their journey towards marriage and what lies ahead for them. Bella, whose full name is Dayang Nabellah Awang Astillah, admitted that she was initially nervous when discussions about collaborating with Astro on the series began. However, she felt it was time for her and Syed Saddiq to give fans a more personal glimpse into their lives together. "Many fans already know that Syed Saddiq and I frequently do live streams together, but we have never talked in detail about how we first got acquainted and so on," Bella, 32, said. She added: "This journey is very meaningful to us, especially because we get to share these happy moments with our family, my two children, Ayden and Ara, and everyone who has supported us. "May this story become a sweet memory that we will cherish forever." Meanwhile, Syed Saddiq, 33, said he has always reminded Bella that happiness is something that should be shared with everyone. "Without their prayers, support and encouragement, our journey together might not be the same as it is today. Everyone has a role in making our journey a success," he said. The former youth and sports minister added that he is eagerly anticipating their wedding day on Oct 10 at Menara Merdeka Maybank in KL. "I cannot wait to share this happy day with everyone, especially my family and friends who have been waiting for a long time," he said. title: 'Malaysia steps up healthcare push in Cambodia
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia is stepping up efforts to attract Cambodian healthcare travellers, with Maybank (Cambodia) Plc and the Malaysia Healthcare Travel Council (MHTC) showcasing 14 Malaysian hospitals in Phnom Penh. In a statement, Maybank Cambodia chief executive officer and country head Rath Sophoan said the event aimed to make it easier for Cambodian families to make informed healthcare decisions while incorporating financial planning into the process. "MH WellFest Cambodia 2026 was designed around a simple question: how can we make it easier for Cambodian families to take a confident next step when health matters? "The event connected families with the people, expertise and options behind Malaysia's healthcare institutions, while bringing financial readiness into the same conversation," he said. MH WellFest Cambodia 2026, held at Borey Peng Huoth Eco Park, drew about 2,000 visitors and almost 800 runners, providing Cambodian families with direct access to Malaysian healthcare providers and specialists. The two-day event, endorsed by the Malaysian Embassy in Phnom Penh, highlighted Malaysia's healthcare capabilities, including health screening, preventive care, specialist services and treatment options. MHTC chief executive officer Datuk Suriaghandi Suppiah said healthcare travel depended on trust and confidence in the quality of care available. "Malaysia Healthcare brings together quality care, specialist expertise, accessible healthcare options and a patient experience shaped by genuine hospitality. "MH WellFest Cambodia 2026 created a direct bridge between Cambodian visitors and this ecosystem, allowing them to meet Malaysian healthcare teams, learn from specialists and gain greater clarity and confidence as they consider care across borders," he said. Malaysian ambassador to Cambodia Shaharuddin Onn said stronger connectivity between Malaysia and Cambodia was creating more opportunities for families to access expertise and services across borders. "MH WellFest Cambodia 2026 reflects this progress by linking Cambodian communities directly with Malaysia's healthcare institutions and specialists," he said. The event featured a Wellness Discovery Hub with five health talks, giving visitors information on healthcare options and navigating treatment in Malaysia. Maybank and MHTC said the event marked a step towards strengthening cross-border healthcare connectivity and raising awareness of Malaysia as a healthcare destination among Cambodian families.

title: 'Sector Sweep - Singapore’s Maritime Sector Sees Stronger Earnings and Business Sentiment
body: '5 Maritime Stocks with the Highest ROE Source: Bloomberg and SGX data as of 30 September 2026. Rising offshore rates, sustained chartering demand and firm order books are lifting earnings across Singapore’s maritime sector. Clarksons Research reported that 2026 is on track to be a historically strong year for newbuild contracting, with 2,128 ships ordered in the year to date, double the ten-year average. The medium-term outlook also remains constructive, with maritime trade forecast to grow 2 per cent annually between 2026 and 2030. The top 10 maritime stocks by return on equity (ROE) recorded an average ROE of 24.4 per cent as at 30 September 2026. Outperformers include Yangzijiang Shipbuilding and small- and mid-cap names, such as Nam Cheong, Beng Kuang Marine, Marco Polo Marine, and ASL Marine Holdings. Yangzijiang Shipbuilding delivered a ROE of 32.2 per cent and a year-to-date total return of 54.5 per cent. The group reported record 1H2026 revenue of RMB17.5 billion, up 36.2 per cent year-on-year, and net profit growth of 28.4 per cent. Supported by higher-value vessel contracts and a favourable product mix, its order book stood at US$22.4 billion across 256 vessels, providing earnings visibility into 2030. Nam Cheong recorded the highest ROE among the group at 45.4 per cent, with net profit more than doubling on the back of contributions from both its shipbuilding and vessel chartering businesses. The company expects to add five vessels by year-end, while 71 per cent of its fleet is secured on long-term charters. In August 2026, RHB Research maintained its ‘Buy’ recommendation, citing its promising growth prospects as well as undemanding valuation. Growth is expected to be driven by a larger fleet of vessels, contribution from its new shipbuilding segment, and margin expansion from a more favourable sales mix. Beng Kuang Marine posted a ROE of 34.1 per cent as stronger engineering and shipbuilding activity lifted 1H2026 net profit by 20.8 per cent year-on-year. The group secured S$85.2 million in new contracts in the first half and ended June with S$70.7 million in outstanding contracted work. In August 2026, UOB Kay Hian maintained its ‘Buy’ recommendation and expects re-rating to continue due to the full consolidation of Asian Sealand Offshore and Marine which would provide a significant earnings uplift in 2H2026, alongside strength in its underlying business and market leadership. Marco Polo Marine achieved a ROE of 25.9 per cent and is seeking to unlock value from its shipyard business through the proposed reverse takeover of Fuji Offset Plates Manufacturing. The group is also expected to benefit from growth in offshore wind projects and continued fleet expansion. In September 2026, Maybank Research maintained its ‘Buy’ recommendation, noting that the group is entering a rapid-growth phase from FY26 to FY30 and will benefit from its diversification away from oil & gas into offshore wind projects, supporting energy-security concerns that have been underscored by the Iran–US conflict. ASL Marine more than doubled full-year net profit to S$33.3 million, driven by stronger chartering performance and lower finance costs. Its shipbuilding and chartering order books stood at approximately S$18 million and S$61 million respectively. Meanwhile, Seatrium continued its turnaround, recording a 54 per cent year-on-year increase in 1H2026 net profit (excluding divestment gains) and maintaining a net order book of S$13.3 billion. The group remains on track to achieve its FY2028 targets, including EBITDA of more than S$1.0 billion, as part of its efforts to enhance total shareholder returns. title: 'Smoky Singapore gears up to talk money ahead of F1
body: 'SINGAPORE, Oct 5 (Reuters) - Regional, business, cryptocurrency and sports leaders are meeting in Singapore for a slew of finance-focused conferences ahead of this weekend's Grand Prix as haze continues to shroud the city-state. Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr, famed investor Ray Dalio and Eric Trump, co-founder of the family-backed cryptocurrency business, are expected, while hundreds of thousands of Formula 1 fans will converge on the island. The night race through the city streets and some 40 sideline events are typically a global showcase for Singapore and hotel room rates have soared. The Fullerton Bay Hotel next to the race track is charging S$5,030 ($3,933) a night for a room that typically costs $1,460. This year the pall from Indonesia's most intense fires in more than a decade will probably form part of the backdrop. Air quality was forecast at the "high moderate to low unhealthy" range on Monday by Singapore's environment agency. No longer-range forecast was provided for Sunday's Grand Prix. Singapore's tourism board said F1 and its surrounding events had "strong momentum" reflecting confidence despite economic and geopolitical uncertainty. Jitters in financial markets where bond prices are slumping and sentiment around on AI is shifting from euphoric to cautious will occupy investors and business chiefs at the Forbes CEO Conference andMilken Asia Summit, which runs from Wednesday. Trump, a co-founder of crypto venture World Liberty Financial, is due to speak at the TOKEN2049 cryptocurrency event with digital asset markets fragile following a bruising 12 months. A hoped-for regulatory framework failed last month to clear the US Senate, in part as President Donald Trump's personal crypto dealings became a flashpoint for Democrats. Despite a recent bounce, the total value of the cryptocurrency market is down about a quarter over the last 12 months to $3 trillion, according to data aggregator CoinGecko. Still, organisers say their event is nearly sold out with 25,000 attendees expected, the same as last year. The Straits Times reported that about 90,000 "c-suite," or top ranking, executives will be in town. F1 generates around S$145 million in incremental tourism receipts for Singapore each year, according to official estimates. Maybank economistChua Hak Bin expects it to hit S$160 million this year, along with "wider economic benefits" from deals struck at sideline events. ($1 = 1.2794 Singapore dollars) (Reporting by Xinghui Kok and Tom Westbrook; Editing by Kim Coghill)

title: 'TIPAK Marks Path to Leadership in Packaging Solutions Following Listing on SET
body:

BANGKOK, Oct 5, 2026 – ACN Newswire via SeaPRwire.com – Thai Packaging Industry PCL (TIPAK), one of Thailand’s leading developers, manufacturers, and distributors of packaging solutions, made its trading debut on the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET), establishing itself as a leader in providing complete packaging services across Thailand. As a stock in the Industrial Goods/Packaging sector, TIPAK has demonstrated strong potential for sustainable growth. The company announced a planned investment of approximately THB 100 million in modern technology to upgrade its production processes, aiming to optimize cost management and create innovative, high-value products with distinctive and differentiated solutions. TIPAK highlights its strength in developing specialty packaging and sustainable packaging to align with the global growth of the sustainable economy, and is actively expanding its customer base among industries and factories nationwide.

Mr Veerachai Monsintorn, TIPAK’s Chief Executive Officer, stated that the Company successfully listed its shares today on the SET’s Industrial Goods/Packaging sector, symbol “TIPAK”. He expressed confidence that with the Company’s strong foundational capabilities, including the upgrade of modern technology to improve production efficiency, the development of distinctive and differentiated high-value products, and the delivery of comprehensive end-to-end solutions that meet specific customer needs, TIPAK was well-positioned to respond rapidly to evolving market demands and support the sustainable growth of all industrial sectors. Guided by the vision “Solutions Unfold – Meeting Customer Needs Perfectly”, TIPAK is committed to becoming Thailand’s leading provider of complete packaging solutions.

The Company expects to allocate approximately THB 100 million in 2027 across its Samut Sakhon and Prachin Buri factories through three key projects:

1. Project to Upgrade Production Efficiency and Automation Systems — Transitioning the production lines for corrugated paperboard and corrugated boxes to fully automated systems to reduce waste and increase speed (reduce Speed Losses).
2. Project for Smart Manufacturing Innovation and Digital Infrastructure — Investing in data-driven factory management systems to enable real-time monitoring and analysis of production performance.
3. Project for Quality Control and Production Stability Enhancement — Improving the consistency and reliability of the Quality Rate by upgrading quality assurance systems.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company’s total production capacity exceeds 140,000 tons of corrugated paperboard and more than 170 million corrugated boxes per year.

The Company has formulated a strategy to leverage its experience and expertise in the paper packaging business to develop high-value products and improve production efficiency, aiming for zero defects with new manufacturing technologies. Under a well-balanced pricing strategy, TIPAK designs and produces corrugated paperboard and boxes that are distinctive, differentiated, and precisely tailored to customer requirements, with customized features including packaging solutions for long-distance delivery and e-commerce logistics. The Company also develops sustainable paper packaging made from recycled materials to support the global shift toward environmentally responsible trade under ESG frameworks. Additionally, TIPAK provides consulting services for packaging design and improvement, and continues to expand its customer base among high-potential industries and factories nationwide.

Ms Nalyne Viriyasathien, Managing Director of Investment Banking, Maybank Securities (Thailand) PCL, in her role as financial advisor and joint lead underwriter, said that TIPAK has a clear and comprehensive business plan focused on sustainable growth across all dimensions – from its large-scale manufacturing facilities and internationally recognized production standards, to its relentless pursuit of innovation in high-value products and continuous expansion into diverse industrial sectors. This reflects a diversified revenue base, and she is confident that TIPAK will become a value-driven stock with strong potential for sustainable growth.

Ms. Nuntarut Sangsuwannukul, Executive Vice President, Investment Banking, Land and Houses Securities PCL, in her role as joint lead underwriter, said that TIPAK plays a critical role in driving Thailand’s industrial supply chain. Its commitment to upgrading factories with modern technology enhances efficiency, reduces costs, and strengthens competitiveness. Furthermore, TIPAK benefits from the projected 2.9% growth of the paper packaging industry in 2027, combined with the global momentum toward a sustainable economy. With these solid fundamentals, TIPAK is fully prepared to achieve its goal of becoming Thailand’s leading provider of complete packaging solutions with stable and confident growth.

title: 'Bursa once said no to crypto. LIDAC26 showed how far Malaysia has come since
body: 'Back in 2024, I wrote a column lamenting Bursa Malaysia’s decision to keep bitcoin and other crypto assets off its new multi-asset exchange, asking whether it might go down as Bursa’s biggest blunder.  Two Thursday’s ago, I spent the better part of a day at M Resort & Hotel in Kuala Lumpur listening to regulators, bankers and fund managers talk about digital assets not as a fringe curiosity, but as the plumbing for the next generation of our capital market. What a difference two years makes.  The event was LIDAC26, the Luno Institutional Digital Asset Conference, now in its second edition. Luno, one of the digital asset exchanges registered with the Securities Commission Malaysia (SC), pitched it squarely at institutions rather than retail punters, and the room reflected that.  The main hall kept the headline sessions flowing from 9.30am, four breakout sessions ran in smaller rooms alongside it through the day, and the session screens I saw all carried a QR code for live audience questions.  Attendees could even earn seven continuing professional development (CPD) points, the credits licensed finance professionals collect to keep their qualifications current, which tells you exactly who the organisers were courting.  So what were the big takeaways? Three stood out.  1. Stablecoins are the real story  Luno chief executive James Lanigan opened proceedings with a slide that cut through a lot of the noise. By Luno’s count, about RM1.43 trillion worth of assets had been tokenised, or recorded as digital tokens on a blockchain, by the first quarter of 2026, and roughly RM1.26 trillion of that was stablecoins, tokens pegged to a currency such as the US dollar.  That’s right. Around 90% of all tokenised assets are, in effect, digital cash, the overwhelming majority of which is tokenised USD, cementing it as not only the world’s reserve currency but the currency of choice in the budding crypto economy.  Lanigan’s framing was that the industry had moved from speculation, through building infrastructure, and was now firmly in its institutional era, with one of his final slides declaring that Malaysia was not a late market, but an early one.  2. The regulator wants substance, not buzzwords  The most anticipated session was that by Wong Huei Ching, the SC’s executive director of digital strategy and innovation, who laid out where Malaysia’s rules are heading.  Her message, stripped to its core, was that putting an asset on a blockchain is not innovation in itself, and that pilots need to prove their worth before the rules are rewritten.  The SC is practising what it preaches. In April, it teamed up with Khazanah Nasional, our sovereign wealth fund, to price Malaysia’s first tokenised sukuk (an Islamic bond recorded on a blockchain), a RM100 million pilot that SC chairman Mohammad Faiz Azmi said would test tokenisation’s potential “in a controlled and credible manner”.  The market she regulates is growing fast, too. Trading value on Malaysia’s licensed digital asset exchanges hit RM17.14 billion in 2025, a 23% jump from RM13.93 billion the year before, according to the SC.  3. The ringgit is going on-chain  John Ho, head of legal and financial markets at Standard Chartered, walked participants in the main hall through Bank Negara Malaysia’s growing list of experiments. These include Project Mawar, which explores a wholesale digital ringgit for banks, and the central bank’s Digital Asset Innovation Hub, where Standard Chartered and Capital A are testing a ringgit stablecoin, while Maybank trials tokenised deposits.  The prize is not small. One industry estimate cited on stage, and widely reported, puts Malaysia’s tokenisation opportunity at around RM175 billion by 2030.  The tidbits  Many other speakers added flair and colour to the proceedings. Former deputy international trade and industry minister Ong Kian Ming spoke on navigating digital assets in a fragmenting global order, while Harjit Singh of HSS Advisory and Anil Puri of EY tackled a question plenty of Malaysian crypto investors have been asking for years: how exactly will all this be taxed?  My favourite, though, was a breakout billed as Malaysian builders shaping the global digital asset landscape. On one stage sat TM Lee, co-founder of CoinGecko, Matthew Tan, founder of Etherscan, and Siong Ong, co-founder of Jupiter, products used by crypto traders the world over.  CoinGecko and Etherscan were both born right here in Kuala Lumpur, and I can’t help but feel proud that some of the most widely used tools in the industry were built by Malaysians.  Siong Ong’s speaker photo on the big screen? A Pudgy Penguin, an uber popular non-fungible token (NFT) collection. In a day full of suits, it was a welcome reminder of where this industry came from.  The one glaring miss  I was, however, surprised that bitcoin, the 800-pound gorilla in the room, barely got a look-in. title: 'Player fatigue threatens TNB campaign as MHL resumes
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: The second round of the Malaysian Hockey League (MHL) begins on Monday, and it has caused havoc for league leaders Tenaga Nasional (TNB) and their season campaign. TNB will face the Armed Forces on Wednesday at the National Hockey Stadium in Bukit Jalil but 11 of their players will only be arriving on Monday from the Asian Games. Malaysia were defeated 5-1 by defending champions India in the Asiad final in Nagoya on Saturday. The first round of MHL ended on May 17 with TNB leading the standings on 19 points from six wins and a draw, followed by Maybank and Terengganu Hockey Team with 17 and 14 points respectively. TNB coach Madzli Ikmar said the 11 national players would be tired after playing three consecutive tournaments at the Nations Cup in South Africa in June, the World Cup in Belgium in August and the Asian Games, which ended on Saturday. "The 11 players need a good rest after playing so many international matches. I have to use the other 12 players in the training squad in the MHL. "I am having a headache as I also need to use national players to play in the league to do well. I have decided that players who played a few matches in the Asian Games would play in the match against Armed Forces," said the former national captain Madzli. Madzli added that the other issue was that the national team would also feature in the six-nation Asian Champions Trophy in Punjab, India from Oct 27 to Nov 5. "Again, national players from TNB would be released to play in the tournament. I know that the priority is the national team, but if all 11 players feature in the tournament, then how are we going to play with the remaining 12 players in MHL? "I will leave it to the team management to decide whether they want to release national players for the tournament," said Madzli. The MHL will break on Nov 14 as the national team prepares for the Sultan Azlan Shah Cup in Ipoh from Nov 22-29 before the national league resumes for the knockout stage on Dec 2.

title: 'PMCK Expands Beyond Hospitals as Maybank Maintains BUY With RM0.35 Target Price
body: 'PMCK Bhd is entering a new phase of growth as the healthcare group expands beyond its core hospital operations into the medical consumables business. Maybank Investment Bank remains positive on the company, maintaining its BUY recommendation with an unchanged target price of RM0.35, compared with PMCK’s share price of RM0.195 in the report, implying potential upside of about 79%. A major highlight is PMCK’s proposed RM52.8 million acquisition of Marpoliq Sdn Bhd and Derberg Sdn Bhd, two medical consumables suppliers. The acquisition will broaden PMCK’s healthcare ecosystem from hospital services into sourcing and distribution of disposable medical devices, respiratory and airway products, feeding supplies, incontinence pads and other hospital and home-care accessories. Completion is targeted by 1Q27. Maybank views the deal positively because medical consumables provide recurring and higher-margin income while giving PMCK exposure to both government and private hospitals. Importantly, the acquisition comes with a RM3 million annual profit-after-tax guarantee for FY27E and FY28E. The deal is valued at just 7.2x P/E and 4.9x EV/EBITDA, significantly below the average valuations of Bursa-listed medical supply peers. The earnings impact could also be meaningful. Maybank estimates the acquisitions could increase PMCK’s FY27E core net profit from RM13.0 million to RM16.8 million, representing a 29.4% uplift after accounting for the acquired companies’ earnings contribution and additional interest expenses. Both businesses also enjoy stronger profitability, with FY26 PAT margins of 21.6% for Marpoliq and 29.1% for Derberg, compared with PMCK’s existing margin of around 12%. Beyond the acquisition, PMCK has an established healthcare footprint in northern Malaysia. It has operated PMC Alor Setar since 1995, while Kedah and Perlis remain relatively underserved in terms of private hospital beds. Another major catalyst is the upcoming 90-bed PMC Kulim hospital, targeted for 1QCY28, which should expand capacity and increase patient throughput. Looking ahead, Maybank forecasts PMCK’s revenue rising from RM107.1 million in FY27E to RM207.2 million in FY29E, while core net profit is projected to increase from RM13.6 million to RM19.8 million. With hospital expansion, growing patient volumes and the move into higher-margin medical consumables, PMCK is building multiple growth engines that could strengthen its longer-term earnings profile.

title: 'Bursa once said no to crypto. LIDAC26 showed how far Malaysia has come since
body: 'Back in 2024, I wrote a column lamenting Bursa Malaysia’s decision to keep bitcoin and other crypto assets off its new multi-asset exchange, asking whether it might go down as Bursa’s biggest blunder. Two Thursday’s ago, I spent the better part of a day at M Resort & Hotel in Kuala Lumpur listening to regulators, bankers and fund managers talk about digital assets not as a fringe curiosity, but as the plumbing for the next generation of our capital market. What a difference two years makes. The event was LIDAC26, the Luno Institutional Digital Asset Conference, now in its second edition. Luno, one of the digital asset exchanges registered with the Securities Commission Malaysia (SC), pitched it squarely at institutions rather than retail punters, and the room reflected that. The main hall kept the headline sessions flowing from 9.30am, four breakout sessions ran in smaller rooms alongside it through the day, and the session screens I saw all carried a QR code for live audience questions. Attendees could even earn seven continuing professional development (CPD) points, the credits licensed finance professionals collect to keep their qualifications current, which tells you exactly who the organisers were courting. So what were the big takeaways? Three stood out. 1. Stablecoins are the real story Luno chief executive James Lanigan opened proceedings with a slide that cut through a lot of the noise. By Luno’s count, about RM1.43 trillion worth of assets had been tokenised, or recorded as digital tokens on a blockchain, by the first quarter of 2026, and roughly RM1.26 trillion of that was stablecoins, tokens pegged to a currency such as the US dollar. That’s right. Around 90% of all tokenised assets are, in effect, digital cash, the overwhelming majority of which is tokenised USD, cementing it as not only the world’s reserve currency but the currency of choice in the budding crypto economy. Lanigan’s framing was that the industry had moved from speculation, through building infrastructure, and was now firmly in its institutional era, with one of his final slides declaring that Malaysia was not a late market, but an early one. 2. The regulator wants substance, not buzzwords The most anticipated session was that by Wong Huei Ching, the SC’s executive director of digital strategy and innovation, who laid out where Malaysia’s rules are heading. Her message, stripped to its core, was that putting an asset on a blockchain is not innovation in itself, and that pilots need to prove their worth before the rules are rewritten. The SC is practising what it preaches. In April, it teamed up with Khazanah Nasional, our sovereign wealth fund, to price Malaysia’s first tokenised sukuk (an Islamic bond recorded on a blockchain), a RM100 million pilot that SC chairman Mohammad Faiz Azmi said would test tokenisation’s potential “in a controlled and credible manner”. The market she regulates is growing fast, too. Trading value on Malaysia’s licensed digital asset exchanges hit RM17.14 billion in 2025, a 23% jump from RM13.93 billion the year before, according to the SC. 3. The ringgit is going on-chain John Ho, head of legal and financial markets at Standard Chartered, walked participants in the main hall through Bank Negara Malaysia’s growing list of experiments. These include Project Mawar, which explores a wholesale digital ringgit for banks, and the central bank’s Digital Asset Innovation Hub, where Standard Chartered and Capital A are testing a ringgit stablecoin, while Maybank trials tokenised deposits. The prize is not small. One industry estimate cited on stage, and widely reported, puts Malaysia’s tokenisation opportunity at around RM175 billion by 2030. The tidbits Many other speakers added flair and colour to the proceedings. Former deputy international trade and industry minister Ong Kian Ming spoke on navigating digital assets in a fragmenting global order, while Harjit Singh of HSS Advisory and Anil Puri of EY tackled a question plenty of Malaysian crypto investors have been asking for years: how exactly will all this be taxed? My favourite, though, was a breakout billed as Malaysian builders shaping the global digital asset landscape. On one stage sat TM Lee, co-founder of CoinGecko, Matthew Tan, founder of Etherscan, and Siong Ong, co-founder of Jupiter, products used by crypto traders the world over. CoinGecko and Etherscan were both born right here in Kuala Lumpur, and I can’t help but feel proud that some of the most widely used tools in the industry were built by Malaysians. Siong Ong’s speaker photo on the big screen? A Pudgy Penguin, an uber popular non-fungible token (NFT) collection. In a day full of suits, it was a welcome reminder of where this industry came from. The one glaring miss I was, however, surprised that bitcoin, the 800-pound gorilla in the room, barely got a look-in. Bitcoin alone is worth around RM6.9 trillion today, according to CoinGecko, and together with ether, the Ethereum network’s native token, the pair make up about two-thirds of the entire crypto market. Stablecoins, for all the stage time they got, account for a mere 10%. Despite more than a decade of relentless innovation in the industry, bitcoin still commands over half of all crypto value, and not telling that story was a missed opportunity. So where does that leave us? The SC revised its guidelines on Mar 2 to permit digital currency exchange-traded funds (ETFs), and Bursa, the very exchange that shut crypto out of its multi-asset platform in 2024, said in March that it welcomed the listing of digital currency ETFs, and told reporters in July that it planned to add them to its line-up. The regulator has built the framework, Khazanah has shown the plumbing can work and Bank Negara is already testing the ringgit on-chain. All that’s left is for the first digital currency ETF to actually start trading on Bursa. After all, it’s about time the exchange that once said no had something to show for its yes. title: '9月龙虎榜 | 兴业跌出10大市值  马银行蒸发83亿 - 财经 - 投资周刊 - 星洲人 - VIP文
body: '9月龙虎榜 | 兴业跌出10大市值 马银行蒸发83亿 高债券收益率碾压银行赚幅、外资撤出，加上股息除权影响，9月多家银行股市值“缩水”。  大马政府债券跌价、收益率增高，相对使到银行固定收益资产竞争激烈，并可能打击非利息收入，外资转为净流出。根据投行数据，从7月1日至9月25日，银行股两个月遭外资撤走13亿令吉。 市值最大的马来亚银行（MAYBANK,1155,主板金融服务组）首笔中期股息在9月23日除权，在9月30日以9令吉99仙挂收，跌破10令吉，市值录得1208亿3500令吉，比8月杪减少约83亿4500万令吉。 排名第二和第三的仍是大众银行（PBBANK,1295,主板金融服务组）和联昌集团（CIMB,1023,主板金融服务组），市值分别为912亿3000万令吉和842亿1300万令吉，低于上个月秒录得的960亿8200万令吉，以及860亿4200万令吉。 相比银行股遭遇外资流出，公用事业股杨忠礼电力（YTLPOWR,6742,主板公用事业组）受到追捧，股价一个月涨约1.4%，以5令吉91仙挂收，市值增至501亿6100万令吉，取代了8月排名第七的丰隆银行（HLBANK,5819,主板金融服务组）。 丰隆银行市值也和其他银行一样减少，降至501亿6100万令吉，9月市值榜排位第八名。 此外，在8月排名第十的兴业银行（RHBBANK,1066,主板金融服务组）跌出榜外，被国油气体（PETGAS,6033,主板公用事业组）取代。 ZETRIX交投一骑绝尘 9月仍有半数热门股是“熟面孔”，当中创办人兼董事经理黄天顺遭逼仓，且两度推迟派息的ZETRIX公司（ZETRIX,0138,主板科技组）遭遇沉重卖压，全月交投火热，计有101亿零355万1700股易手。 频频遭逼仓的黄天顺，截至9月23日时，直接与间接持股已减至10.97%。不过，两度推迟的每股终期派息2.89仙，终在上周一（28日）派给股东。在这轮卖压下，该股股价丢失13.5仙或45.76%，截至9月底跌至16仙。 市场上月中突然传出亚航集团面临财务状况，政府正展开情景规划，包括询问马航与峇迪航空是否有能力吸纳亚航国内市场份额，引起投资者担忧，不过，创办人丹斯里东尼费南达斯很快驳斥有关传闻。全月下来，该公司成交量达到7亿7107万6700股。 中东地缘政治局势升温，手套股上月中异军突起，顶级手套（TOPGLOV,7113,主板医疗保健组）也再次成投资者焦点，全月易手9亿1379万1600股，是第四热门股。 而上个月的热门股捷硕（JAKS,4723,主板建筑组）、HHRG公司（HHRG,0175,创业板工业产品服务组）、威铖（VS,6963,主板工业产品服务组）及亚航集团（AAGB,5238,主板消费产品服务组），继续在10大热门股榜中，分占第三、第六、第七与第八位。 恒源大涨82.56% 中东局势不见好转，令国际油价飙升，带动能源股上涨，当中恒源（HENGYUAN,4324,主板能源组）更是狂飙1令吉61仙或82.56%，从8月的1令吉95仙，大升至3令吉56仙，涨幅冠绝全场。 能源与水务转型部（PETRA）推出企业再生能源供应计划（CRESS）加速配套，再生能源股项从中受惠，共有4只股项“霸占”10大上升排行榜。 title: 'Singapore’s strong economic growth masks cooling job market
body: 'AI adoption could reduce manpower needs, particularly in services sector, Maybank said.  Singapore’s strong economic growth is not translating into a comparable increase in employment, with job gains running well below the levels seen during previous economic booms, according to Maybank.  Employment excluding migrant domestic workers grew by 20,800 in the first half of 2026, while resident employment increased by 7,600. Real GDP, meanwhile, expanded 6.1% year on year over the same period.  During 2004-07, 2011-13 and 2021-22, average annual employment growth reached 133,000, whilst resident employment grew by an average 60,100.  “The Singapore economy is running hot on the AI boom, but the job market, paradoxically, appears to be cooling,” the bank said.  The current AI-driven and capital-intensive growth cycle is generating far fewer jobs, particularly in modern services, it noted.  Employment in financial, professional, and infocomm services increased by only 1,300 jobs in the second quarter of 2026, following contractions in the previous two quarters.  The labour market is also showing signs of weaker hiring and job mobility. Retrenchments rose to 4,600 in the second quarter, the highest level since the fourth quarter of 2020, with services accounting for most of the job cuts.  At the same time, the monthly recruitment rate fell to 1.4%, a historical low outside the pandemic years, whilst the monthly resignation rate declined to a record low of 1% in the second quarter.  The report describes Singapore’s labour market as “low-hire, low-quit,” reflecting subdued recruitment and job mobility alongside increased retrenchments.  The outlook is also expected to remain subdued despite continued GDP growth. Annual employment growth excluding migrant domestic workers is forecast to slow to 40,000 in 2026 and 35,000 in 2027, from 55,500 in 2025.  Resident employment growth is projected to be weaker at 12,000 in 2026 and 10,000 in 2027, compared with 11,600 in 2025. These would represent the most subdued employment growth figures since 2021.  Forward-looking surveys also point to cautious hiring. ManpowerGroup’s fourth-quarter Net Employment Outlook was stable from the previous quarter but moderated from a year earlier.  Separately, a Singapore National Employers Federation survey found that 54% of companies have no plans to increase headcount in 2027, whilst another 6% plan to cut jobs.  The report said existing government support measures could be expanded as workers face longer re-entry periods following retrenchment. These include SkillsFuture Jobseeker Support, which provides unemployed individuals with up to $6,000 over six months, as well as private and public sector traineeships, career transition measures, job placements, and Career Conversion Programmes that provide salary support to employers reskilling mid-career workers.  It also suggested raising the current $5,000 monthly income ceiling and extending the duration of financial support under the Jobseeker Scheme. Administrative minimum wage adjustments under the Progressive Wage Models may also need to be reviewed amid structural shifts in the resident labour market.  “Besides job security and unemployment, these structural shifts may have implications for retail spending; residential and commercial property demand; demographics; and widening income disparities,” the bank said.

title: 'Doktor rugi RM300,000 terpedaya pelaburan Kad Prihatin Siswa
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR - Seorang doktor swasta berusia 38 tahun kerugian RM300,000 selepas terpedaya dengan tawaran pelaburan Projek Kad Prihatin Siswa yang didakwa membabitkan sebuah syarikat, pada awal 2023.  Ketua Polis Daerah Ampang Jaya, Asisten Komisioner Khairul Anuar Khalid berkata, mangsa diperdaya suspek yang mendakwa projek berkenaan membabitkan 20 universiti dengan kira-kira 620,000 pelajar.  Katanya, suspek turut menjanjikan pulangan keuntungan kepada mangsa sebelum mangsa membuat lima transaksi berjumlah RM300,000 ke akaun Maybank milik suspek.  “Satu perjanjian pelaburan turut ditandatangani dengan menjanjikan keuntungan 10 peratus sebulan selama 12 bulan serta pemulangan modal selepas tamat tempoh perjanjian.  “Mangsa juga didaftarkan sebagai pemegang 10 peratus saham syarikat tersebut,” katanya menerusi kenyataan hari ini.  Bagaimanapun, Khairul Anuar berkata, mangsa yang merupakan wanita tidak pernah menerima keuntungan dan dividen seperti yang dijanjikan.  “Suspek turut gagal memberikan penyelesaian walaupun telah beberapa kali diminta penjelasan. Mangsa kemudiannya membuat laporan polis untuk tindakan lanjut,” katanya.  Beliau berkata, kes kini disiasat mengikut Seksyen 420 Kanun Keseksaan kerana menipu.  Sehubungan itu, beliau menasihatkan orang ramai supaya tidak mudah terpedaya dengan tawaran pelaburan yang menjanjikan pulangan tinggi.  “Orang ramai disaran membuat semakan terlebih dahulu melalui portal rasmi Semak Mule PDRM serta mendapatkan maklumat berkaitan status dan kesahihan tawaran pelaburan melalui Suruhanjaya Sekuriti Malaysia (SC) dan Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) sebelum membuat sebarang transaksi,” katanya. - MalaysiaGazette

title: 'Giggs warns Asean nations naturalised players not quick fix
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Manchester United icon Ryan Giggs has urged Southeast Asian nations not to treat naturalised and dual-heritage players as a shortcut to success. Giggs cautioned that strong domestic academy pipelines must anchor sustainable progress in football. Speaking to reporters in the capital, the 13-time Premier League winner addressed the accelerating trend across the region, where nations including Malaysia and Indonesia have increasingly turned to foreign-born and heritage players to fast-track competitiveness on the continental stage. Giggs, himself a celebrated graduate of United's famed "Class of '92" youth system, offered his take on the debate and said that while outside talent can raise immediate standards, it should never come at the expense of grassroots development. "I think everything is always a balance," Giggs said when asked if relying on naturalised players is a sound strategy for lower-ranked nations looking to climb the ladder. "Where it's countries or leagues outside the big leagues, you need the infrastructure of academy players coming through. "And also, the foreign players coming in, they need to be good quality, good professionals." The 53-year-old former Wales manager also pointed out the critical role of coaching in bridging the developmental gap, noting that importing tactical expertise must serve to elevate local coaching standards rather than displace them. "The coaching, if possible, I think should be local," he said. "But obviously, if you bring in experienced coaches from other countries, they can also help show the professionalism and introduce different tactical ideas. "It's always a balance. But I think for any country, it's always good if you have your own players coming through from an early age, though of course, they have to be good enough." Beyond regional football development, Giggs reflected on his long-standing ties with Malaysia, describing the country as an indispensable commercial partner for English football giants. "Oh, it's very important," he said. "If I look at Man United, I've worked with Maybank, I've worked with Malaysia Airlines, and events like this boost the spotlight on the country." Decades after making his senior debut, Giggs admitted he remains touched by the enduring enthusiasm of Malaysian supporters, who still flock to greet him at airport arrivals halls. "If you speak to anyone who's been here, whether during pre-season or after they finish playing, they love it," he said. "They love the people, they love the culture, and they love the food, even if sometimes it can be a bit too spicy for the UK! But no, I love it, and I always love coming back."

body: '一周股市 | 预算案周五揭盅 马股料窄幅震荡 展望：保留现金 财案后再行动 （吉隆坡3日讯）踏入第四季，马股仍面对不少国内外不确定因素包括政治动荡、美债回酬率等，但下周市场焦点转向2027年财政预算案，投资者在等待政府释放更明确的政策讯号之际，市场情绪料持续审慎，预期吉隆坡富时综合指数将在1620至1650点之间窄幅震荡。  乐天交易股票研究副总裁唐柏麟表示，随着部分优质蓝筹股可能浮现趁低吸纳活动，1620点将是富时综指立即支持点，但若复苏至1650点以上，将为上探1660点铺平道路。 “若富时综指强势突破1660点将强化短期技术面，但指数想要持续复苏需要获得债券回酬率下滑、原油价格趋稳，以及指数权重股参与率增多等因素支撑。” 另一位分析员认为，鉴于本周马股已经下滑40.75点至1630.87点，市场已经消化部分负面因素，若预算案大派糖果，投资者情绪有望由悲转喜，带动马股再次挑战周五1640点的反弹高点。 由于2027年财政预算案会是大选前的最后一份预算案，市场普遍看好政府会加码派发福利，现金援助将从150亿令吉增至约170亿令吉，进一步支持中低收入群体的消费力。同时，政府应该会避免推出新税种，加重人民的负担。 此外，早前政府有意增加沙巴与砂拉越的国会议席，因此市场不排除政府可能进一步去发展东马基础设施。 投资策略方面，谨慎的投资者可先保留现金观望，待预算案公布后再进行布局，但若预算案增加发展项目拨款，建筑及基建相关股或受惠，而一旦政府继续加大现金援助及民生支出，消费股也可能受到市场关注。 回顾：综指全周挫40.75点 美国联储局9月中旬升息后，美债回酬率持续走高，拖累包括美股3大指数都按周下滑。随着美债回酬率走高，外资加速回流美国，马股受到牵连，拖累综合指数按周下滑40.75点或2.44%，最低跌至1630.10点。 马股本周录得“三跌两起”，综合指数周一先跌1.60点，周二再挫26.06点，连续2天下跌，并接连失守1660点和1650点，经过2天下跌后，周三反弹7.21点至1651.17点。 在短暂反弹后，周四延续跌幅，再跌20.81点至1630.36点，全日最低跌至1630.10点，也是全周最低。 周五，马股一度反弹至1640.78点，不过在卖压抛售下，综合指数最终微涨0.51点或0.03%，收挂1630.87点。 以马来亚银行（MAYBANK,1155,主板金融服务组）为首的银行股纷纷下跌，金融指数按周下滑2.61%，导致大盘按周下滑2.44%。 马银行一度失守10令吉关口，最低跌至9令吉91仙，不过在买盘支撑下，成功在周五回升至10令吉零2仙。 15大指数跌多起少，其中工业产品指数和产业指数跌幅最重，前者跌3.03%，后者回落3.07%。 全周马股量跌价升，一周成交量跌至174亿2275万零120股，较上周的175亿9282万零900股减少1亿7007万零780股；总成交值则从上周的143亿9697万7279令吉，增加至144亿3405万7312令吉，增加3708万零33令吉。  热门新闻 百格视频

title: 'Doktor diperdaya bapa bekas penyanyi, polis siasat penipuan pelaburan projek Kad Prihatin Siswa
body: 'Ampang Jaya: Polis sudah membuka kertas siasatan membabitkan penipuan pelaburan projek Kad Prihatin Siswa yang dikaitkan dengan sebuah syarikat milik seorang lelaki yang juga bapa kepada bekas penyanyi. Ketua Polis Daerah Ampang Jaya, Asisten Komisioner Khairul Anuar Khalid berkata, mangsa, doktor swasta berusia 38 tahun pada awal 2023 bersama suaminya berurusan dengan suspek berkaitan projek Kad Prihatin Siswa yang dikaitkan dengan sebuah syarikat secara bersemuka dan melalui WhatsApp. Menurutnya, suspek memperkenalkan projek terbabit sebagai pelaburan yang membabitkan 20 buah universiti dan kira-kira 620,000 pelajar serta menjanjikan pulangan keuntungan kepada pelabur. "Mangsa membuat lima kali transaksi pembayaran dengan jumlah keseluruhan sebanyak RM300,000 ke atas nombor akaun Maybank milik suspek sepanjang 2023. "Selepas daripada itu, satu perjanjian pelaburan ditandatangani yang menyatakan pelaburan sebanyak RM300,000 dengan keuntungan sebanyak 10 peratus sebulan selama 12 bulan dan modal akan dipulangkan pada tamat tempoh perjanjian," katanya dalam kenyataan hari ini. Beliau berkata, mangsa kemudiannya didaftarkan sebagai pemegang 10 peratus saham syarikat terbabit. "Bagaimanapun, keuntungan dan dividen yang dijanjikan tidak pernah diterima. Mangsa dan suami beberapa kali meminta penjelasan, pembayaran dividen serta salinan perjanjian yang dimatikan setem, namun suspek memberikan pelbagai alasan dan gagal memberikan penyelesaian. "Siasatan dijalankan mengikut Seksyen 420 Kanun Keseksaan dan tiada tangkapan setakat ini," katanya. Harian Metro hari ini melaporkan lelaki itu meyakinkan pelabur bahawa projek Kad Prihatin Siswa membabitkan 20 universiti mampu menjana pulangan lumayan dan kononnya ingin membantu lebih ramai orang Melayu kaya sepertinya. Itu taktik seorang lelaki bergelar Datuk yang juga bapa kepada bekas penyanyi memperdayakan pasangan doktor sehingga menyebabkan kerugian RM300,000 selepas melabur sejak 2023. Malah, dia turut mendakwa berkawan dengan pegawai tertinggi kerajaan dan kononnya minit mesyuarat projek ini juga sudah dihantar ke kerajaan dengan 620,000 pelajar akan menikmati kad terbabit hasil kerjasama dengan syarikat telekomunikasi terkenal.

title: 'Restock Sambal Nyet Bilis, Khairul Aming Sekali Lagi Capai ‘Sales’ RM2 Juta
body: 'Sekilas  Khairul Aming berjaya mencatat jualan sebanyak RM2 juta untuk produk terbaharunya, Sambal Nyet Bilis. Beliau berkongsi pencapaian tersebut di Threads dengan memaparkan angka jualan RM2,181,558.73 sambil mengucapkan terima kasih kepada peminat. Jualan produk ini sebelum ini juga pernah mencapai RM2 juta dalam masa kurang dua minit semasa pelancaran di Menara Merdeka Maybank.  Pempengaruh dan usahawan, Khairul Aming sekali lagi mencatatkan pencapaian membanggakan apabila mencatat jualan sebanyak RM2 juta menerusi penjualan produk terbaharunya iaitu Sambal Nyet Bilis.  Menerusi perkongsian di Threads, Khairul Aming berkongsi foto dirinya sambil memegang komputer riba yang memaparkan angka sebanyak RM2,181,558.73.  Malah, anak jati Kelantan ini turut meluahkan rasa syukur selepas jualan tersebut berjaya mencapai angka yang memberangsangkan.  “Alhamdulillah kita capai jualan 2 juta ringgit untuk restock Sambal Bilis tadi  “Terima kasih guys,”kongsinya.  Perkongsian itu kemudiannya meraih perhatian ramai yang rata-ratanya menzahirkan ucapan tahniah buat Khairul Aming.  Sebelum ini, Khairul Aming mencatat jualan RM2 juta dalam masa kurang dua minit bagi produk terbaharunya itu melalui platform TikTok ketika pelancaran produk berkenaan di Menara Merdeka Maybank (sebelum ini dikenali sebagai Merdeka 118).

title: '石隆门女子遭假贷款群组连环套 汇款3次始觉受骗向警方求助
body: '（古晋3日讯）意图通过网上个人贷款缓解经济，学校保洁掉入网上诈骗陷阱，3次汇款共6400令吉给老千后，老千继续各种理由要求汇款、保洁才如梦初醒被骗并来到石隆门警局报案求助。  上述欺骗案是发生在石隆门警区，受害者是现年40岁来自石隆门甘榜瑟吉邦的女子，在石隆门某间政中任职保洁工作。  受害者是昨午5时15分来到石隆门警局报案求助，商业犯罪调查查案官已着手展开调查工作。  石隆门警区主任莫哈默海德今早向媒体发布有关讯息。  受害者是在9月28在工作地点游览面子书时，看到名为“myringgitcash”的个人贷款广告，并有意申请1万令吉的个人贷款。  受害人点击广告链接填写了申请人的个人信息，随后被添加到一个名为“myringgit10k”的WhatsApp群组。  加入该WhatsApp群组后，受害人与3名自称是群组管理员的人员联系，联系电话号码分别为011-11236641、011-21097126和011-28589136。  在与3个人交涉后，受害人于 9 月 29 日通过“myringgit10k”WhatsApp 群组被告知，其申请的贷款已获批准，并要求投诉人预先支付几笔款项，据称是为了将贷款资金存入受害人的账户。  因此，投诉人向2个不同的账户进行了三笔交易，具体如下：  2026年9月30日，向Muhammad Nurzaidi Bin Nazri名下的Maybank账户（151342200688）汇款1,100.00令吉 2026年10月1日，向Kannan A/L Gagendran名下的Maybank账户（362405001788）汇款2,200.00令吉 2026年10月1日，向Kannan A/L Gagendran名下的Maybank账户（362405001788）汇款3,140.00令吉  付款后，受害人仍被要求支付额外款项，但由于他认为自己受到了欺骗且未收到任何款项，因此没有继续支付并火速来道警局报案求助。

title: '[VIDEO] ‘Tidak Sabar Hadiri Pernikahan Kami’ – Syed Saddiq, Bella Astillah Kenang Pertemuan Terakhir Dengan Allahyarham Tun Hasmah
body: 'Ahli Parlimen Muar, Syed Saddiq dan bakal isteri, Bella Astillah menyifatkan pertemuan bersama Allahyarham Tun Dr Siti Hasmah Mohd Ali selama dua jam pada tiga hari lalu sebagai momen yang sangat bermakna buat mereka. Artikel Berkaitan: [VIDEO] ‘Baru Hendak Tulis Muka Surat Pertama’ – Syed Saddiq & Bella Astillah Akui Tak Layak Disamakan Dengan Tun M & Allahyarhamah Tun Hasmah Artikel Berkaitan: Bella Astillah Kongsi Keadaan Syed Saddiq – ‘Dia Tak Mampu Teruskan Apa Yang Telah Dirancang Hari Ini’ Pertemuan akhir Ketika ditemui , Saddiq atau nama penuhnya, Syed Saddiq Syed Abdul Rahman berkata pada pertemuan itu Allahyarham berkongsi rasa tidak sabar untuk menghadiri pernikahan mereka selain kelihatan ceria dan gembira. Menurutnya, momen tersebut menjadi salah satu kenangan manis yang tidak akan dilupakan bersama tokoh yang disayangi ramai itu. Kalau tidak silap, kami bertemu tiga hari sebelum Allahyarhamah meninggalkan kita semua. Ketika pertemuan itu, Allahyarhamah berada dalam keadaan sangat ceria. Beliau juga berkongsi rasa tidak sabar untuk menghadiri majlis pernikahan kami. Saddiq berkata demikian pada sidang media Walimatulurus Bella Astillah & Syed Saddiq di Kuala Lumpur pada Jumaat. Berkongsi lanjut, Saddiq berkata, Allahyarham banyak menitipkan nasihat kepadanya terutama mengenai kehidupan selepas berkahwin. Banyak nasihat yang disampaikan, khususnya mengenai pentingnya kompromi dalam rumah tangga. Perkahwinan bukan sekadar soal cinta semata-mata, tetapi mengenai toleransi dan bagaimana kita bijak berkompromi, melalui ujian serta menangani isu seperti perasaan cemburu dalam hubungan. Ketika ditanya sama ada dia melihat sebarang perubahan pada Allahyarham ketika pertemuan terakhir mereka, Saddiq berkata, Allahyarham masih sempat bergurau dan berkongsi kisah-kisah lama, termasuk kisah cintanya bersama Tun Dr Mahathir Mohamad. Allahyarham masih boleh bergurau dan mengingati perkara yang berlaku 50 atau 60 tahun lalu, termasuk kisah cintanya bersama Tun Dr. Mahathir. Manakala, Bella turut berkongsi antara pesanan Allahyarham supaya menjadi seorang wanita yang kuat, selain mengingatkan bahawa kehidupan sebagai isteri kepada seorang ahli politik bukanlah mudah. Allahyarham berpesan supaya saya menjadi seorang wanita yang kuat, sentiasa berada di sisi suami serta menjadi wanita yang lembut tetapi pada masa sama mempunyai kekuatan. Ada juga nasihat yang boleh saya kongsikan dan ada yang saya memilih untuk simpan kerana menghormati Allahyarham. Beliau memberitahu bahawa perjalanan sebagai isteri kepada seorang ahli politik bukan sesuatu yang mudah. Namun, selagi ada kepercayaan dalam hubungan, insya-Allah rumah tangga akan berkekalan. Toleransi dan rasa hormat terhadap pasangan juga sangat penting. Dalam perkembangan lain, Saddiq dan Bella akan disatukan sebagai suami isteri pada sebuah majlis di Kuala Lumpur pada 10 Oktober depan. Majlis pernikahan mereka akan berlangsung di aras 118, Menara Merdeka Maybank dengan konsep serba putih disulami elemen Arab atau Islamik atas permintaan keluarga. The post [VIDEO] ‘Tidak Sabar Hadiri Pernikahan Kami’ – Syed Saddiq, Bella Astillah Kenang Pertemuan Terakhir Dengan Allahyarham Tun Hasmah first appeared on OHBULAN!.

title: 'Syed Saddiq, Bella Astillah to hold wedding receptions in Muar & Kota Kinabalu, public invited to 'Kenduri Rakyat'
body: 'Muar MP Syed Saddiq Syed Abdul Rahman and Malaysian singer-actress Bella Astillah, who are set to marry on Oct 10, will celebrate their special occasion with the public through two receptions themed “Kenduri Rakyat”.  The couple, who got engaged on March 28, will first exchange vows at Menara Merdeka Maybank in Kuala Lumpur.  The celebrations will then continue in Muar, Johor, on Oct 25, before the couple heads to Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, on Oct 31.  At a press conference in Kuala Lumpur today (Oct 2), Syed Saddiq said preparations for the receptions had been challenging, as the events were organised within a span of two months.  Much of the difficulty came from finding enough vendors and a suitable venue within the limited timeframe.  “We are expecting around 20,000 to 30,000 guests. We will do our best to accommodate everyone,” the former youth and sports minister said.  Bella said about 10,000 special souvenirs would be prepared for guests attending the two public receptions, with the items distributed on a first-come, first-served basis.  She clarified that the Sabah reception would be held in Kota Kinabalu instead of in her hometown of Sandakan due to certain limitations.  Bella then went on to share more about her relationship with Syed Saddiq, revealing that it was the simple things he did that gave her the confidence to trust him.  “Everything he does is big in my eyes. Just little things like opening the door for me, reminding me to sleep early and eat my meals or just telling me to exercise … Even though it’s basic stuff, I’m happy,” she said.  Bella previously married Singaporean actor Aliff Aziz in 2016, but the relationship ended in divorce twice – once in 2019 and the second time in 2024.  She has two children from her former marriage: Ayden, nine; and Ara, six.

title: 'Syed Saddiq, Bella Astillah jemput orang ramai ke ‘Kenduri Rakyat’ sempena perkahwinan
body: 'Syed Saddiq, Bella Astillah jemput orang ramai ke ‘Kenduri Rakyat’ sempena perkahwinan KUALA LUMPUR – Bakal raja sehari, Syed Saddiq Syed Abdul Rahman dan tunangnya, Bella Astillah menjemput orang ramai menghadiri majlis ‘Kenduri Rakyat’ sempena perkahwinan mereka yang bakal berlangsung pada 10 Oktober ini. Majlis berkenaan akan diadakan di Muar, Johor pada 25 Oktober, sebelum diteruskan di Kota Kinabalu, Sabah pada 31 Oktober. Syed Saddiq yang juga Ahli Parlimen Muar berkata, kedua-dua majlis resepsi itu dirancang dalam tempoh kurang dua bulan, sekali gus menyebabkan mereka berdepan kekangan masa dan kesukaran mendapatkan lokasi yang sesuai. Katanya, konsep ‘Kenduri Rakyat’ dipilih dengan mengetengahkan semangat rewang dan meraikan perkahwinan bersama masyarakat. “Majlis kahwin kami nanti bertemakan rewang. Kalau sebelum ini, sambutan Hari Raya yang saya anjurkan di Muar sudah mencecah 10,000 orang, jadi kita jangka untuk kenduri kami lebih ramai yang akan datang. “Jadi, majlis itu nanti berkonsepkan ‘siapa cepat dia dapat’ (nikmati juadah). Jika makanan habis sekalipun, kami akan berada di sana untuk bersama dengan tetamu,” katanya pada majlis Walimatulurus Bella Astillah dan Syed Saddiq, di sini hari ini. Sebanyak 10,000 cenderahati istimewa turut disediakan untuk tetamu yang hadir ke majlis berkenaan. Ditanya mengenai perasaannya menghitung hari bahagia bersama Bella pada 10 Oktober nanti, Syed Saddiq pantas menjawab: “Saya tak sabar nak menghalalkan hubungan kami.” Menurut Syed Saddiq, dia mengakui tidak rasa berdebar, tetapi tidak sabar untuk bergelar suami kepada Bella. “Perasaan saya lebih kepada tidak sabar berbanding berdebar. Tak sabar nak kongsikan hari bahagia kami bersama semua termasuklah keluarga dan sahabat andai. “Saya selalu kongsikan kepada bakal isteri saya, kebahagiaan perlu dikongsikan kepada semua kerana tanpa doa, sokongan dan dorongan orang ramai, mungkin hari ini (perkahwinan) tidak akan terjadi. Setiap orang ada saham dalam menjayakan perkahwinan kami,” katanya. Sebelum ini, Syed Saddiq dan Bella mengesahkan mereka bakal disatukan sebagai suami isteri pada 10 Oktober ini. Majlis pernikahan pasangan itu dijadual berlangsung di aras 118, Menara Merdeka Maybank, di sini, dengan konsep serba putih yang disulami elemen Arab dan Islamik atas permintaan keluarga. Menariknya perjalanan kisah cinta mereka dari mula perkenalan sehingga menjelang hari perkahwinan bakal disiarkan dalam program khas Walimatulurus Bella Astillah & Syed Saddiq yang akan ditayangkan di Astro Ria bermula 6 Oktober 2026. Syed Saddiq dan Bella dilaporkan mula berkenalan dengan lebih rapat pada 2025 sebelum mengikat tali pertunangan pada 28 Mac lalu.

title: 'Religious council to bear sisters’ funeral costs after Tambun accident
body: 'IPOH: The Perak Islamic Religious and Malay Customs Council (MAIPk) will bear the funeral costs for two sisters who died in a road accident near Taman Perpaduan Ria, Tambun here on Friday (Oct 2). MAIPk chief executive officer Syamsul Hazeman Md Salleh said that the council would also assist their surviving sister, who was hospitalised due to serious injuries from the crash. “The MAIPk will bear the funeral management costs for the two siblings who died, while other forms of assistance for the seriously injured sibling will follow. ALSO READ: Schoolgirls killed in Ipoh crash were sisters, say cops "MAIPk provides funeral management assistance to families who are unable to afford such expenses as well as for the deceased with no next of kin," he said. The two victims - Elyana Nasuha Ibrahim, 19 and her younger sister Suhaila Ibrahim, 10 - were killed at about 7.20am on Friday. Their 12-year-old sister Norhayati Qaliesha Ibrahim, who was riding pillion with her sisters, is being treated at Raja Permaisuri Bainun Hospital for her injuries. ALSO READ: Two schoolgirls killed, one hurt in motorcycle-car crash in Tambun The victims were headed towards Bercham on a motorcycle before being hit by a car that was turning out from a junction onto Jalan Perpaduan. The police are investigating the crash under Section 41(1) of the Road Transport Act 1987. The two sisters were pupils of SK Tasek Dermawan and were orphans living with their older sister in Taman Perpaduan. Following the tragedy, a donation drive has been launched through the school’s Parent-Teacher Association (PTA) to help ease the family’s financial burden. Members of the public wishing to contribute can channel donations to SK Tasek Dermawan’s PTA Maybank account at 508177707877.

title: 'Syed Saddiq & Bella Astillah Pilih ‘Kenduri Rakyat’ Untuk Kongsi Hari Bahagia
body: 'MAJLIS perkahwinan selalunya menjadi momen untuk diraikan bersama keluarga dan kenalan terdekat, namun Syed Saddiq Syed Abdul Rahman dan Bella Astillah memilih untuk membuka ruang lebih luas untuk berkongsi hari bahagia mereka. Bukan satu, malah dua majlis resepsi bertemakan ‘Kenduri Rakyat’ bakal diadakan di kampung halaman masing-masing iaitu di Muar, Johor dan Kota Kinabalu, Sabah. Pasangan ini merancang untuk mengadakan Kenduri Rakyat di Muar pada 25 Oktober, sebelum meneruskan sambutan di Kota Kinabalu pada 31 Oktober. Menurut Syed Saddiq, 34, konsep tersebut dipilih sebagai tanda penghargaan kepada mereka yang selama ini menitipkan doa, sokongan dan dorongan buat mereka berdua. Baginya, perkahwinan bukan sekadar tentang penyatuan dua individu, sebaliknya turut menjadi kesempatan untuk berkongsi kebahagiaan dengan mereka yang sentiasa memberikan sokongan. “Dari awal kalau ikut dari sudut tanggungjawab hakiki adalah nikah untuk menghalalkan hubungan kami berdua. “Namun pada masa yang sama, saya selalu kongsikan kepada bakal isteri saya (Bella), kebahagiaan itu perlu dikongsikan kepada semua juga. “Ini kerana tanpa doa, sokongan, dorongan mungkin hari ini tidak akan terjadi. Dan ‘the chapter of our future journey’ itu mungkin tidaklah semudah seperti hari ini,” ujarnya. Rewang Jadi Nadi Kenduri Rakyat Tidak mahu majlis sekadar berlangsung sebagai acara resepsi biasa, kedua-dua Kenduri Rakyat itu akan membawa konsep rewang dengan penduduk setempat turut dijemput untuk bersama-sama menyediakan juadah. “Bila namanya Kenduri Rakyat, tentunya kita akan buat rewang juga. Maksudnya orang kampung semua akan dijemput untuk sertai masak sekali. “Orang kampung semua dijemput hadir supaya kita dapat membumikan majlis perkahwinan ini untuk dinikmati oleh semua di luar sana,” katanya. Antara cabaran utama yang dihadapi adalah mendapatkan lokasi bersesuaian, selain memastikan keperluan kenduri dapat disediakan untuk jumlah tetamu yang dijangka ramai. Beberapa penaja turut tampil membantu menyediakan keperluan, termasuk beras, santan dan roti. Bagi sambutan di Sabah pula, Bella atau nama lengkapnya, Dayang Nabellah Awang Astillah, 32, menjelaskan bahawa Kenduri Rakyat di Kota Kinabalu akan mengangkat tema pakaian tradisional Sabah sebagai penghormatan kepada kepelbagaian budaya negeri tersebut. Bella sebelum ini pernah mendirikan rumah tangga dengan penyanyi dan pelakon Aliff Aziz pada September 2016 sebelum bercerai pada 16 Mei 2019. title: 'Syed Saddiq, Bella Astillah to hold wedding receptions in Muar & Kota Kinabalu, public invited to 'Kenduri Rakyat'
body: 'Muar MP Syed Saddiq Syed Abdul Rahman and Malaysian singer-actress Bella Astillah, who are set to marry on Oct 10, will celebrate their special occasion with the public through two receptions themed “Kenduri Rakyat”. The couple, who got engaged on March 28, will first exchange vows at Menara Merdeka Maybank in Kuala Lumpur. The celebrations will then continue in Muar, Johor, on Oct 25, before the couple heads to Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, on Oct 31. At a press conference in Kuala Lumpur today (Oct 2), Syed Saddiq said preparations for the receptions had been challenging, as the events were organised within a span of two months. Much of the difficulty came from finding enough vendors and a suitable venue within the limited timeframe. “We are expecting around 20,000 to 30,000 guests. We will do our best to accommodate everyone,” the former youth and sports minister said. Bella said about 10,000 special souvenirs would be prepared for guests attending the two public receptions, with the items distributed on a first-come, first-served basis. She clarified that the Sabah reception would be held in Kota Kinabalu instead of in her hometown of Sandakan due to certain limitations. Bella then went on to share more about her relationship with Syed Saddiq, revealing that it was the simple things he did that gave her the confidence to trust him. “Everything he does is big in my eyes. Just little things like opening the door for me, reminding me to sleep early and eat my meals or just telling me to exercise … Even though it’s basic stuff, I’m happy,” she said. Bella previously married Singaporean actor Aliff Aziz in 2016, but the relationship ended in divorce twice – once in 2019 and the second time in 2024. She has two children from her former marriage: Ayden, nine; and Ara, six.

title: 'Syed Saddiq, Bella Astillah bakal kongsi bahagia menerusi majlis resepsi “Kenduri Rakyat”
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Bakal mempelai, Syed Saddiq Syed Abdul Rahman dan Bella Astillah bakal berkongsi kemeriahan hari bahagia bersama masyarakat menerusi dua majlis ‘Kenduri Rakyat’ di Muar, Johor dan Kota Kinabalu, Sabah. Pasangan itu bakal diijabkabulkan pada 10 Oktober ini, sebelum mengadakan majlis resepsi di Kuala Lumpur pada 18 Oktober. Kenduri Rakyat pula dijadualkan berlangsung di Muar pada 25 Oktober dan Kota Kinabalu pada 31 Oktober. Syed Saddiq yang juga Ahli Parlimen Muar berkata, keputusan mengadakan Kenduri Rakyat dibuat bagi membolehkan kebahagiaan mereka dikongsikan bersama orang ramai yang selama ini memberikan sokongan dan doa. “Dari awal kalau ikut dari sudut tanggungjawab hakiki adalah nikah untuk menghalalkan hubungan kami berdua. “Tetapi pada masa yang sama, saya selalu kongsikan kepada bakal isteri saya, kebahagiaan itu perlu dikongsikan kepada semua juga. “Kerana tanpa doa, sokongan, dorongan mungkin hari ini tidak akan terjadi. Dan ‘the chapter of our future journey’ itu mungkin tidaklah semudah seperti hari ini,” katanya pada Sidang Media Walimatulurus Bella Astillah & Syed Saddiq, di sini. Menurutnya, kedua-dua majlis berkenaan akan mengetengahkan konsep rewang dengan penduduk setempat turut dijemput bersama-sama menyediakan juadah. “Bila namanya Kenduri Rakyat, maksudnya kita akan buat rewang juga. Maksudnya orang kampung semua akan dijemput untuk sertai masak sekali. “Orang kampung semua dijemput hadir supaya kita dapat membumikan majlis perkahwinan ini untuk dinikmati oleh semua di luar sana,” katanya. Syed Saddiq berkata, persiapan kedua-dua majlis itu dibuat dalam tempoh kurang dua bulan, selain berdepan cabaran mendapatkan lokasi kerana banyak tempat telah ditempah lebih awal. Beberapa penaja turut membantu menyediakan keperluan kenduri, termasuk sumbangan beras, santan dan roti. Bagi majlis di Muar, beliau menjangkakan kehadiran lebih tinggi berbanding acara rumah terbuka hari raya yang pernah dianjurkannya sebelum ini dengan kehadiran kira-kira 10,000 orang. “Di Muar saja dah 10,000 orang. Kalau majlis perkahwinan minimum 20-30,000. Kita akan cuba raikan seramai yang mungkin. First come, first served. “Dan kalau makanan habis, kami berdua tetap akan berada di sana untuk cuba bersalaman, bersua muka dengan seramai yang mungkin,” ujarnya. Sementara itu, Bella menjelaskan Kenduri Rakyat di Sabah akan berlangsung di Kota Kinabalu dan bukan di Sandakan, meskipun beliau dilahirkan di Sandakan. Menurutnya, pakaian tradisional Sabah akan dijadikan tema majlis bagi meraikan kepelbagaian budaya negeri itu. “Bella memang happy nak buat sebab Bella lahir di Sabah. Tapi ramai orang salah faham Bella akan buat majlis di Sandakan. “Bella ingin mengambil kesempatan untuk memberitahu, Bella punya majlis nanti di Kota Kinabalu,” katanya. Dalam perkembangan sama, Bella menyifatkan kerjasama bersama Astro menerusi program khas perjalanan perkahwinan mereka sebagai peluang untuk berkongsi kisah dengan lebih dekat bersama peminat. “Bella rasa ini adalah perfect collaboration sebab akhirnya Bella boleh kongsikan dengan peminat, sebab Bella tahu mereka selalu tanya. “Bella nak cerita, tapi kadang-kadang risau nanti penyampaiannya lain, penerimaannya lain. Jadi Bella rasa Astro banyak membantu dari segi apa yang kita sampaikan,” katanya. Program berkenaan akan membawa penonton mengikuti perjalanan pasangan itu menerusi beberapa episod, termasuk persiapan menjelang akad nikah, kehidupan selepas bergelar suami isteri serta rakaman majlis resepsi di Muar dan Sabah. Episod ketiga akan menampilkan siaran langsung pernikahan mereka pada 10 Oktober menerusi Astro AWANI, Astro Ria, Astro Prima dan Astro Gempak, manakala majlis resepsi pada 18 Oktober akan disiarkan secara langsung menerusi Astro Prima dan Astro Gempak. Pasangan itu sebelum ini mengumumkan bakal melangsungkan pernikahan di aras 118, Menara Merdeka Maybank, Kuala Lumpur, dengan konsep serba putih yang disulami elemen Arab atau Islamik atas permintaan keluarga. Mereka mengikat tali pertunangan pada 28 Mac lalu.

title: '[VIDEO] ‘Baru Hendak Tulis Muka Surat Pertama’ – Syed Saddiq & Bella Astillah Akui Tak Layak Disamakan Dengan Tun M & Allahyarhamah Tun Hasmah
body: 'Ahli Parlimen Muar, Syed Saddiq dan bakal isterinya, Bella Astillah tidak bersetuju dengan kenyataan yang menyamakan kisah cinta mereka dengan pasangan negarawan, Tun Dr Mahathir Mohamad dan Allahyarhamah Tun Dr Siti Hasmah Mohamad Ali. Artikel Berkaitan: Bella Astillah Kongsi Keadaan Syed Saddiq – ‘Dia Tak Mampu Teruskan Apa Yang Telah Dirancang Hari Ini’ Artikel Berkaitan: [VIDEO] ‘Berdebar? Tidak, Saya Gembira’ – Syed Saddiq Tak layak disamakan Dalam satu sesi temu bual, Saddiq menegaskan perbandingan itu terlalu jauh, malah merasakan mereka tidak layak apabila persamaan tersebut dibuat. Saya rasa kami tidak layak untuk dibandingkan dengan Allahyarhamah dan juga Tun Dr. Mahathir. Tidak dekat pun, malah tidak sampai satu peratus kerana kalau kita lihat jasa mereka, ia memang luar biasa. Saddiq berkata demikian pada sidang media Walimatulurus Bella Astillah & Syed Saddiq di Kuala Lumpur pada Jumaat. Mengulas lebih lanjut, Saddiq berkata Allahyarhamah Tun Dr Siti Hasmah merupakan tokoh yang wajar dicontohi khususnya dalam bidang perubatan. Tun Dr Siti Hasmah salah seorang doktor wanita terawal yang memberikan inspirasi kepada wanita. Beliau satu-satunya doktor wanita dalam kelompoknya ketika itu di Singapura dan mendapat biasiswa. Bila pulang untuk berkhidmat, pada awalnya beliau berada di kota, tetapi apabila diberikan ujian dan cabaran untuk dihantar ke kawasan luar bandar, beliau tidak mengeluh. Beliau pergi membantu dan mendidik keluarga serta anak-anak di sana untuk menerima pendidikan moden. Beliau adalah antara yang terawal dan perintis. Sementara itu, Saddiq menyifatkan Tun Mahathir sebagai tokoh yang banyak memberi sumbangan kepada negara. Tun Dr Mahathir lagilah. Saya rasa saya tidak perlu menyenaraikan satu per satu pencapaian dan jasa beliau kepada negara yang sehingga hari ini kita masih menerima manfaatnya. Jadi, sejujurnya, bagi mereka yang berkongsikan perkara ini, saya tahu ia datang daripada niat yang baik. Tetapi jawapan kami, kita tidak layak untuk disamakan kerana mereka jauh lebih ke hadapan daripada kami. Kata Saddiq, kisah percintaan mereka juga tidak setara untuk disamakan dengan pasangan negarawan itu memandangkan ikatan hubungan mereka sedang dibina dan masih berada di peringkat awal. Saya tahu mungkin ada yang kata, ‘Oh, tetapi bukan daripada sudut sumbangan kepada negara, mungkin daripada sudut cinta.’ Itu pun saya rasa kami tidak layak. Kerana kami ini baru hendak berkahwin, hendak menghalalkan hubungan. Mereka ini sudah 70 tahun meraikan cinta dan kebijaksanaan bersama. Kami belum sampai pun 25 tahun, baru hendak membuka bab atau buku yang pertama. Kalau kita ibaratkan seperti sebuah buku, kami baru hendak menulis muka surat pertama. Mereka bukan sekadar menulis muka surat pertama, mungkin mereka sudah mempunyai perpustakaan sendiri yang boleh berkongsikan kisah cinta mereka. Bukan satu buku, tetapi sudah beribu-ribu buku. Dalam perkembangan lain, Saddiq dan Bella akan disatukan sebagai suami isteri pada sebuah majlis di Kuala Lumpur pada 10 Oktober depan. Majlis pernikahan mereka akan berlangsung di aras 118, Menara Merdeka Maybank dengan konsep serba putih disulami elemen Arab atau Islamik atas permintaan keluarga. title: 'Bella Astillah & Syed Saddiq Bakal Disatukan Di Menara Merdeka 118, Ada ‘Kenduri Rakyat’ Menanti!
body: 'Selepas mengesahkan tarikh pernikahan mereka, pasangan Bella Astillah dan Ahli Parlimen Muar, Syed Saddiq Syed Abdul Rahman kini berkongsi pula perancangan untuk beberapa majlis resepsi yang bakal diadakan selepas mereka disatukan sebagai suami isteri. Lebih istimewa, majlis pernikahan pasangan ini bakal berlangsung di salah satu bangunan ikonik negara, sekali gus mencipta sejarah apabila mereka menjadi pasangan pertama yang diijabkabulkan di menara berkenaan. Bakal Disatukan Di Menara Merdeka 118 Pemilihan lokasi tersebut direalisasikan menerusi kolaborasi istimewa antara Astro dan Precinct Merdeka 118, sekali gus menjadikan ikon Kuala Lumpur itu sebagai latar eksklusif untuk hari bahagia Bella dan Syed Saddiq. Sebelum ini, pasangan berkenaan dilaporkan bakal disatukan pada 10 Oktober ini di aras 118, Menara Merdeka Maybank, Kuala Lumpur. Majlis pernikahan itu juga akan mengetengahkan konsep serba putih yang disulami elemen Arab atau Islamik, mengikut permintaan keluarga kedua-dua belah pihak. Tiga Majlis Resepsi Di Tiga Lokasi Tidak terhenti pada satu majlis sahaja, Bella dan Syed Saddiq turut merancang untuk mengadakan tiga majlis resepsi yang akan berlangsung di Kuala Lumpur, Muar, Johor serta Sabah. Berikut merupakan tarikh yang telah ditetapkan iaitu di Kuala Lumpur: 18 Oktober, Muar, Johor: 25 Oktober dan Sabah: 31 Oktober Bagaimanapun, lokasi bagi setiap majlis resepsi tersebut masih belum diumumkan dan akan dikongsikan kemudian. Difahamkan juga, sebanyak 10,000 cenderahati istimewa telah disediakan untuk para tetamu yang bakal hadir meraikan hari bahagia pasangan ini. Bertunang Pada Mac Lalu Untuk info, Syed Saddiq dan Bella sebelum ini mengikat tali pertunangan dalam sebuah majlis yang berlangsung di ibu negara pada 28 Mac 2026. Dalam majlis tersebut, pihak Bella menerima lima dulang hantaran dan membalas dengan tujuh dulang hantaran kepada pihak Syed Saddiq. Pasangan ini dilaporkan mula berkenalan dengan lebih rapat pada 2025 sebelum hubungan mereka melangkah ke fasa pertunangan pada Mac lalu. Kini, selepas melalui fasa pertunangan, Bella dan Syed Saddiq bakal melangkah ke alam perkahwinan pada Oktober ini dengan beberapa majlis yang pastinya dinantikan oleh keluarga, sahabat serta para peminat mereka. title: 'Nelly Korda's Deliberate Golf Break Costs Her as She Becomes Ineligible for LPGA Award - Report
body: 'Nelly Korda's Deliberate Golf Break Costs Her as She Becomes Ineligible for LPGA Award - Report Nelly Korda had a chance to settle her LPGA Hall of Fame future on the course this year. Victories at the Chevron Championship and U.S. Women's Open left her at 25 points, two short of induction. Given her early-season form, she was widely expected to earn those two points by the end of 2026. A single major win would have done it, but she has not won another major since June. Now, despite leading the tour in scoring average, Korda is set to miss another Hall of Fame point. This time, it has nothing to do with her performance or scores. Korda is ineligible for the Vare Trophy, the LPGA's award for lowest scoring average, due to insufficient rounds played, though she remains on track for Player of the Year. Golfweek's senior writer Beth Ann Nichols notes that the World No. 1 "currently leads the Vare Trophy race for low scoring at 69.38." However, she is not playing enough golf to win it. Had she earned the Vare Trophy, she would have received a Hall of Fame point. Paired with the Player of the Year award, which is worth one more point, that would have put her at 27. But the Vare Trophy has two key eligibility requirements. First, the golfer must play at least 60 individual-scoring rounds, or 60% of the applicable official rounds, whichever is lower. If Nelly Korda makes the cut at The ANNIKA and plays all four rounds of the CME Group Tour Championship, she will have played 61 rounds. However, she won't meet the second eligibility criterion, which is playing at least 70 rounds, or 70% of the applicable official rounds, whichever is lower. Counting the four rounds of the Dow Championship she played this summer, Korda finishes at 65 rounds. Thus, she falls five rounds shy of the eligibility criterion. She missed out on the Vare Trophy and the Hall of Fame point for the same reason in 2021. She could have become eligible if she had played two more events during the season. Her last event was the Solheim Cup, which Charley Hull & co. won. In total, she has made only 15 starts so far in 2026. She is now on a break that includes the ongoing Lotte Championship, which she is not playing. Golfweek reports that she will also be skipping the Asia swing, which includes the Buick LPGA Shanghai, the BMW Ladies Championship, the Maybank Championship, and the TOTO Japan Classic. This brings her total break to around two months. This isn't the first time she has missed the Asia swing. In fact, some fans have been outraged by her habit of skipping it. Korda has not played a fall Asian event since 2023. She skipped the 2024 stops after a neck injury sustained in practice. "I'm disappointed to miss these events and am especially sorry to my fans who were looking forward to seeing me play," she wrote in 2024. She also skipped last year's swing because of injury. After a top-five finish in Hawaii, Korda withdrew from the International Crown in October 2025 with an unspecified injury, and she was expected to sit out the Asia swing that followed. It came in a winless 2025 in which neck problems cost her time. Korda said after the Hawaii event that her body is "definitely worn down" by that point in the year, and she has stressed the need to be as close to 100 percent as possible before teeing it up. But despite the reduced schedule, the 28-year-old has a chance to win the remaining two points by the end of the season. She leads Haeran Ryu in the Player of the Year race by 75 points. So that is one possible point. In addition, she can win either The ANNIKA or the CME Group Tour Championship to earn the last point. Korda is a three-time winner at The ANNIKA and can do it again this year. Nelly Korda's shortened schedule has cost her another opportunity to add an LPGA Hall of Fame point, but her season is far from over. title: 'Syed Saddiq, Bella Astillah anjur 'Kenduri Rakyat' rai perkahwinan
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Bakal mempelai, Syed Saddiq Syed Abdul Rahman dan tunangnya, Bella Astillah menjemput orang ramai menghadiri majlis 'Kenduri Rakyat' di Muar, Johor dan Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, selepas mereka diijabkabulkan di sini, pada 10 Oktober ini. 'Kenduri Rakyat' meraikan perkahwinan Syed Saddiq dan Bella akan diadakan di Muar, Johor pada 25 Oktober, diikuti Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, pada 31 Oktober. Syed Saddiq yang juga Ahli Parlimen Muar berkata, kedua-dua majlis resepsi dirancang dalam tempoh kurang dua bulan dan mereka berdepan kekangan masa serta kesukaran mendapatkan lokasi majlis perkahwinan. "Majlis kahwin kami nanti bertemakan rewang. Kalau sebelum ini, sambutan Hari Raya yang saya anjurkan di Muar sudah mencecah 10,000 orang, jadi, kita jangka untuk kenduri kami lebih ramai yang akan datang. "Jadi, majlis itu nanti berkonsepkan 'siapa cepat dia dapat' (nikmati juadah). Jika makanan habis sekalipun, kami akan berada di sana untuk bersama dengan tetamu," katanya pada majlis Walimatulurus Bella Astillajh & Syed Saddiq di sini, hari ini. Difahamkan, sebanyak 10,000 cenderahati istimewa disediakan untuk tetamu. Sebelum ini, Syed Saddiq dan Bella dilapor mengesahkan bakal disatukan sebagai suami isteri pada 10 Oktober ini. Majlis pernikahan mereka akan berlangsung di aras 118, Menara Merdeka Maybank, di sini, dengan konsep serba putih disulami elemen Arab atau Islamik atas permintaan keluarga. Syed Saddiq dan Bella dilapor mula berkenalan dengan lebih rapat pada 2025 sebelum mengikat tali pertunangan pada 28 Mac lalu.
