title: 'Trading Of MKH Shares To Be Suspended
body: 'Whitmore Holdings Sdn Bhd will proceed with the compulsory acquisition of the remaining shares in MKH Bhd after securing valid acceptances representing at least 90% of the offer shares under its unconditional mandatory takeover offer.  MKH said Bursa Malaysia will suspend trading in its shares upon the expiry of five market days from the extended closing date of the offer.  MKH said it had received a press notice from Maybank Investment Bank Bhd, on behalf of Whitmore and its ultimate offeror Batu Kawan Bhd, confirming that the 90% threshold had been met as at 5pm on Sept 30, 2026.  Whitmore is offering RM2.00 cash per MKH share for all remaining voting shares not already owned by Whitmore and Batu Kawan.  Following the acceptance level, Whitmore and Batu Kawan will invoke subsection 222(1) of the Capital Markets and Services Act 2007 to compulsorily acquire the remaining shares from dissenting shareholders.  A compulsory acquisition notice will be issued to those shareholders within two months from Sept 30.  Following the suspension, Whitmore and Batu Kawan intend to procure MKH to take the necessary steps to withdraw its listing status from Bursa Malaysia’s Official List.  If the delisting is completed, MKH shares will no longer be traded on the Main Market.  The takeover offer will remain open for acceptance until 5pm on Oct 8, 2026.

title: 'The Legacy of Great Towers
body: 'Passport to Nature, Heritage and Culture After five hectic days of talking about towers, visitor experiences and the future of some of the world’s most iconic landmarks, what does a tower person do to chill out? Climb another tower? Get close to nature? Or immerse themselves in a different culture? For the delegates of the World Federation of Great Towers (WFGT) Conference, which ended at the Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur on Sept 18, the answer was — all three. But not necessarily in that order. First, they went looking for elephants About 20 WFGT delegates, accompanied by their Malaysian hosts, left Kuala Lumpur after the five-day conference for a post-conference journey into Pahang. Their first stop was the National Elephant Conservation Centre (NECC), Kuala Gandah. And suddenly, the language of towers gave way to the language of nature. There were no observation decks, city skylines or glass elevators. Instead, there was jungle, water and the unmistakable presence of elephants. About a dozen delegates ventured down to the river and had a splashing great time bathing with a young elephant. Some got wet. Some got wetter. And almost everyone came away with a broad smile. The delegates were also given a video presentation, briefing and tour of the centre by Perhilitan personnel, gaining a closer understanding of Malaysia’s elephant conservation efforts. NECC head Muhammad Fadlli bin Ab Yazi and also his team also played a video of Perhilitan's conservation, research and elephant translocation efforts. It was perhaps the moment when everyone truly let their hair down after five intensive days of conference sessions. Kuala Lumpur Tower CEO Khairil Faizal came all the way to join in the fun Even Jean-Yves Ghazi, executive director of the World Federation of Great Towers, joined in the experience. At one point, he fed sugar cane to an elephant — with his back facing the animal. It was one of those moments that could never be fully captured in a conference room. It had to be experienced. Video 1: CELEBRATION OF CULTURE: WFGT delegates even joined the performers for joget as they sampled warm Malaysian hospitality at the Garden Terrace of Kuantan 188. Hyperlink: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/g1smui/AGtS8XXEWhOeZpLwpOS3WbW-9FciXuJn0GGimgXVPIt8-0eoVSV1r7YO7nd7=s294-w294-h294-k-p-v1-no Pahang for nature, culture and hospitality If the elephants had provided the delegates with a taste of Malaysia’s natural side, Pahang and Kuantan 188 delivered culture and warm Malaysian hospitality. At the Sky Terrace overlooking the Kuantan River, the evening turned into a garden party. The delegates were treated to cultural performances by Anak Kayan Pahang, with performers spanning three generations. The delegates joined the performers for a joget, turning the evening into an informal celebration of friendship and Malaysian hospitality. Before that, there was singing at the restaurant deck where dinner was hosted. After some urging, Dato Zulkifli Mohamad — WFGT member and managing director of Kuantan 188 — took to the floor and sang the Bee Gees classic To Love Somebody. The irrepressible Dato “One More” Zul Zulkifli soon called on Randy Stancik, general manager of Willis Tower Skydeck in Chicago, to join him on stage with the emcee. And no one wore a broader smile than Zul when everything turned out splendidly well. He had stitched the evening together — including lobbying the WFGT to host the conference in Kuala Lumpur. The WFGT duly presented an Appreciation Award to him with these fondly crafted words: “To Dato ‘One More’ Zul for being Dato Zul” — with love from Your Distinguished Guest. Zul, being his warm and jovial self, joked: “Now, please tell me, how do I say ‘one more’ to my wife?” And everyone erupted in laughter. The Dato Bandar Kuantan Dato Zaliza bin Zulkipli and members of Majlis Bandaraya Kuantan, Tourism Pahang and MOTAC Pahang also turned up to support this event and extend their hospitality. The trio who made the climb As for climbing, Miguel Amerlink and Mariana Ferruzca of Torre Latino México, together with Daniel Cecetka of UFO Bratislava in Slovakia, made it a point to scale the antenna of Kuantan 188. Not by lift. Not by stairs. But with ropes and safety harnesses, with the help of climbing guides. For people whose professional lives revolve around great towers, perhaps this was the ultimate way to start the morning. Three tower people, looking down from above, before the rest of the group headed on to the next destination. It was another reminder that a tower can be experienced in more ways than simply looking out from its observation deck. Visiting the historic royal town of Pekan From Kuantan, the delegates continued to Pekan, the historic royal town, where they were introduced to history, craftsmanship, music and royal tradition. At Perkampungan Kraf Diraja Tunku Azizah, they watched a weaving demonstration at Pusat Tenun Che Minah Sayang. They also visited the birthplace of Malaysia’s second prime minister, Tun Abdul Razak, the Pahang Silk Weaving Centre, Karyaneka Centre and Serambi House Pahang. Then came the music. A gamelan performance filled the space with the calming and distinctive sounds of traditional Pahang music. Caryn Stancik from the United States, who tried her hand at playing the gamelan, said: “It’s like a cultural awakening. I just love the music. It feels so nice and relaxing like the rustling of wind chimes. “When I go back to the US, I will definitely look out for gamelan music CDs to explore it further.” That is perhaps what a meaningful travel experience does. It leaves you curious enough to continue the journey after you have gone home. A sumptuous lunch beside the river at Gerabak Jaman Tory completed the Pekan experience before the delegates began their journey back to Kuala Lumpur. Trinidad Hospitality Group CEO Dato Sri Naresh Mohan and YB Leong Yu Man, Pahang Exco for Unity, Tourism and Culture took time off to greet and host the delegates. Building a towering experience for visitors In his closing remarks, Zul said he hoped that the staging of the WFGT conference in Kuala Lumpur would leave something meaningful behind. “Every tower has its unique offering,” said Zul, who had also thoughtfully arranged a WFGT visit to Menara Merdeka Maybank. “Each tower not only offers its unique view of the city but also connects to people, landscape, businesses, surroundings and nature in different ways.” A visitor could climb a tower, discover nature, cruise a river, experience local food, listen to traditional music or explore heritage and culture — thus creating a much richer journey around the country’s towers. In many ways, the WFGT delegates had already experienced the concept before they left for home. At the opening of the WFGT conference, Ghazi had reminded delegates: “Our responsibility is not simply to operate great towers.” “It is to ensure that these extraordinary places continue to inspire, educate, connect and create memorable experiences for generations to come.” That was precisely what had happened during their journey to Malaysia. The towers had not been left behind after all. They had simply become gateways to something much bigger. Zul hopes that the proposed Malaysian Tower Passport can carry that idea forward as one of the meaningful outcomes of the WFGT conference in Kuala Lumpur, in line with the aspirations of Visit Malaysia 2026. Before they left for home, a bus full of WFGT delegates sang Rasa Sayang, urged on by award-winning guide Jasmine Leow, who incidentally holds both City and Nature guide badges. After five days of talking about towers, everyone had discovered that a great tower can be much more than a place to look at a city. It can be a gateway to the city, nature, its people, its heritage, its culture — and to experiences visitors remember long after they have gone home. body: 'KUALA LUMPUR 1 Okt - Amanah Hartanah Bumiputera (AHB) mengekalkan jumlah agihan pendapatan termasuk bonus sebanyak 5.00 sen seunit bagi tahun kewangan berakhir 30 September 2026 (FY2026), dengan keseluruhan pembayaran RM236.41 juta yang memberi manfaat kepada lebih 82,000 pemegang unit. Agihan akhir itu membabitkan pembayaran RM120.13 juta. Agihan pendapatan tersebut adalah bersih selepas cukai dan zakat, membolehkan pemegang unit menerima jumlah penuh tanpa sebarang potongan atau tanggungan tambahan. Pembayaran akan dibuat dalam bentuk unit AHB dan dikreditkan terus ke dalam akaun pemegang unit selewat-lewatnya pada 13 Oktober 2026. Beliau berkata PHB terus memperkukuh kedudukan AHB sebagai instrumen pelaburan pilihan pelabur Bumiputera melalui pengurusan modal yang berhemat, strategi pelaburan dinamik dan pengoptimuman portfolio bagi memastikan pertumbuhan mampan serta penciptaan nilai jangka panjang. Menurut Mazuki, penawaran tambahan sebanyak 400 juta unit AHB yang diumumkan baru-baru ini memperluas peluang kepada lebih ramai pelabur Bumiputera untuk mengambil bahagian dalam pelaburan hartanah komersial utama. Beliau berkata AHB akan terus menyokong pembentukan kekayaan jangka panjang Bumiputera dan menjana nilai mampan kepada pemegang unit. Komitmen itu selaras dengan aspirasi Pelan Transformasi Ekonomi Bumiputera 2035 (PUTERA35) untuk memperkukuh penyertaan ekonomi, pemilikan dan pembentukan kekayaan Bumiputera. Agihan pendapatan akan dilaburkan semula secara automatik, menambah pegangan unit pelabur dan membolehkan mereka berpotensi menikmati manfaat pengkompaunan dalam jangka panjang. Unit tambahan akan dikreditkan terus ke dalam akaun tanpa memerlukan permohonan berasingan. Pelabur Bumiputera boleh melanggan AHB pada harga tetap RM1.00 seunit, dengan pelaburan minimum RM100 dan maksimum RM1 juta. Langganan boleh dibuat di cawangan pengedar sah AHB seluruh negara, iaitu Malayan Banking Berhad (Maybank), AmBank Berhad, AmBank Islamic Berhad, Bank Islam Malaysia Berhad dan Bank Kerjasama Rakyat Malaysia Berhad. Sejak ditubuhkan pada 2010, AHB telah mengagihkan sejumlah RM2.7 bilion pendapatan kepada pemegang unit Bumiputera.

title: 'MKH bakal dinyahsenarai selepas Batu Kawan kuasai 95.16% saham
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR 1 Okt – MKH Bhd bakal dinyahsenarai daripada Bursa Malaysia selepas Batu Kawan Bhd bersama anak syarikatnya, Whitmore Holdings Sdn Bhd serta pihak yang bertindak bersama mereka menguasai 95.16% saham syarikat pemaju hartanah itu. Jumlah pegangan tersebut bersamaan 548.85 juta saham MKH setakat penutupan dagangan pada 30 Sept 2026, menurut kenyataan yang dikeluarkan oleh Maybank Investment Bank Bhd bagi pihak Batu Kawan dan Whitmore. Dengan pegangan yang sudah melepasi 90%, Batu Kawan dan Whitmore kini boleh mengambil alih baki saham MKH yang masih dipegang pemegang saham yang tidak menerima tawaran pengambilalihan tersebut. Baki saham MKH akan diambil alih secara wajib Langkah itu akan dibuat di bawah Seksyen 222(1) Akta Pasaran Modal dan Perkhidmatan 2007 yang membolehkan baki saham diperoleh secara wajib. Tawaran pengambilalihan pada harga RM2 sesaham itu masih dibuka sehingga 8 Oktober 2026 selepas tarikh tutup asal pada 17 September lalu dilanjutkan. Selepas tempoh tawaran tamat, Bursa Malaysia Securities akan menggantung dagangan saham MKH selepas lima hari pasaran, sebelum Batu Kawan dan Whitmore meneruskan proses untuk menarik balik status penyenaraian MKH. Pengambilalihan MKH bernilai RM1.15 bilion Langkah Batu Kawan mengambil alih MKH bermula pada Mei lalu apabila Whitmore bersetuju membeli kepentingan 47.7% dalam MKH daripada anggota keluarga Chen pada harga RM2 sesaham, membabitkan nilai RM549.8 juta. Pembelian itu kemudiannya disusuli tawaran kepada pemegang saham MKH yang lain pada harga sama bagi membolehkan Batu Kawan meningkatkan pegangannya dalam syarikat tersebut. Secara keseluruhan, pengambilalihan MKH untuk menjadikannya syarikat persendirian bernilai sehingga RM1.15 bilion, termasuk kos pembelian kepentingan awal daripada keluarga Chen. Tawaran RM2 sesaham terima pandangan berbeza Bagaimanapun, tawaran tersebut sebelum ini mendapat pandangan berbeza daripada penasihat bebas MKH dan MKH Oil Palm (East Kalimantan) Bhd, iaitu cabang perladangan MKH yang disenaraikan secara berasingan. Kenanga Investment Bank Bhd, yang bertindak sebagai penasihat bebas MKH, menilai tawaran RM2 sesaham itu sebagai “tidak adil tetapi munasabah”, dengan mengambil kira harga tawaran yang lebih rendah daripada nilai aset wajar MKH. Bagi MKH Oil Palm pula, Mainstreet Advisers Sdn Bhd menggesa pemegang saham menolak tawaran 66.26 sen sesaham daripada Batu Kawan, yang disifatkannya sebagai “tidak adil dan tidak munasabah”. Menurut Mainstreet, harga tawaran itu mewakili diskaun 47% kepada nilai aset bersih (NAV) MKH Oil Palm. Pada masa sama, Batu Kawan bercadang mengekalkan MKH Oil Palm sebagai syarikat yang disenaraikan di Bursa Malaysia.- DagangNews.com

body: '户头解冻遭速提1165万 投资者迎追讨曙光 轰动全国的黄金投资骗局金玉华（Genneva Gold）私人有限公司，已被高庭正式颁布清盘令！ 马来西亚高庭于2026年9月30日正式批准清盘申请，此举为数以千计的受害投资者通过法律清盘程序、向该公司追讨多年血汗钱铺平了道路。法庭也同时确认黄荣富（译音）正式担任该公司的清盘人。 高庭法官旺法蒂拉诺在宣读判词时指出，法庭下令清盘基于三大理由：第一，该公司此前因非法吸收存款被定罪，证明其曾被用于非法用途；第二，公司停运多年，目前缺乏合法执照和准证恢复业务；第三，公司管理极度混乱，不仅未妥善保存秘书记录，更没有一个正常运作的董事会。 户头刚解冻 1165万遭“闪电”转移 此项清盘申请是由持有金玉华75万股的董事黄婉瑜（译音）于2024年8月提出。而促使她急切向法庭申请清盘的导火线，正是涉及一笔高达1165万令吉的银行资金被迅速提走的惊人内幕。 根据法庭文件，地庭于2024年6月下令撤销国家银行此前的资产扣押令，解冻了金玉华在马银行（Maybank）及大众银行（Public Bank）的户头资金。然而，款项解冻后，金玉华董事局随即批准将1165万9661令吉20仙的款项，迅速转入其长期法律顾问律师楼的客户托管账户。 更令人震惊的是，黄婉瑜声称，在资金移至律师楼账户后，其中竟有高达到1026万令吉，以“专业服务费（律师费）”的名义被转出。由于担心公司剩余资产沦为某些人的“私人利益”而非用于偿还投资者，她决定通过法律清盘，由独立清盘人介入展开深入调查。 清盘人接管 全面追查非法资产转移 已被法庭正式确认为清盘人的黄荣富表示，初步调查显示，金玉华的资产在过去确实曾被不当且违法地转移。 随着高庭正式下达清盘令，清盘人现已获得法律授权，全面接管并清查金玉华遗留的所有资产。接下来的核心工作将包括追查这笔被“速提”的千万资金去向、追讨不当转移的资产，并在稍后开放受害者索赔登记程序。受害投资者受促密切关注官方清盘资产申报流程，以保障自身权益。 清盘是投资者的“迟来正义”，但“能拿回多少”仍是残酷的未知数 虽然高庭颁布清盘令、委任独立清盘人全面追查是法律的胜利，但受害者切勿盲目乐观： 金玉华当年席卷的资金高达数十亿令吉，涉及数万名受害者。如今独立清盘人去追查的，只是这区区一千多万令吉的冰山一角。 清盘人黄荣富虽然誓言追讨，但要从律师楼的口袋里、从已定罪的高层资产中把钱“吐出来”，还需要经历无数轮的法律诉讼与资产清算。即便最终追回，在扣除清盘行政费、法律费及优先债权后，普通投资者能分到的数额恐怕也只是象征性的巴仙率（%）。 金玉华案跨越十余年，从高调吸金、国行取缔、漫长诉讼，到如今解冻后的“临终分赃”与强行清盘，它是一部活生生的大马金融血泪史。它再次敲响警钟：在崩盘的庞氏骗局面前，不仅骗子的承诺不可信，连高喊合法合规的“内部人”也随时准备在废墟上刮骨吸髓。 【金玉华案前因后果：从吸金数十亿到内部“闪电分赃”】 高调吸金（2009—2012年）： 金玉华打着“伊斯兰合规黄金买卖”旗号，以高于市价20%卖金并承诺每月给2%至3%高额回扣，吸引全马数万名投资者砸入数十亿令吉棺材本。 国行取缔（2012—2020年）： 2012年10月，国家银行突击查封该公司，大盘轰然倒塌。历经多年诉讼，上诉庭于2020年做出终审定罪，判定多名核心高层非法吸收存款及洗黑钱罪成，判监并重罚4.5亿令吉。 解冻速提（2024年）： 2024年6月，地庭撤销当年的资产扣押令，其银行户头重新解冻。不料，控制权派系董事随即采取“闪电操作”，将1165万令吉现金转入合作的律师楼户头，更将其中1026万令吉以“律师费”名义转出分赃。 内讧清盘（2026年9月30日）： 另一名董事黄婉瑜因不满千万资金被内部蚕食，愤而“掀桌子”申请清盘。高庭最终宣判金玉华正式破产清盘，由独立清盘人接管。 图取自中国报 【免责声明】 《风采》网站欢迎读者/网民留言，创造友好交流空间；唯网民留言皆不代表本网站立场。本网站有权删除任何人身攻击、鼓吹种族宗教隔阂、诽谤造谣、网络霸凌等煽动性留言。 想要买《风采》，网购最方便！ 👉 https://s.lazada.com.my/s.xqJTn (西马) 👉 https://s.lazada.com.my/s.xqJ58 (东马) 👉 https://my.shp.ee/urmN2pCX (西马) 👉 https://my.shp.ee/K9R1Es9m (东马) 👉订阅《风采》纸本杂志： https://shop.enanyang.my/product/feminine/

title: 'AHB kekalkan agihan pendapatan 5.00 sen seunit, pemegang unit terima RM236.41 juta bagi FY2026 | DagangNews - Berita Bisnes Anda
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR 1 Okt - Amanah Hartanah Bumiputera (AHB) mengekalkan jumlah agihan pendapatan termasuk bonus sebanyak 5.00 sen seunit bagi tahun kewangan berakhir 30 September 2026 (FY2026), dengan keseluruhan pembayaran RM236.41 juta yang memberi manfaat kepada lebih 82,000 pemegang unit. Pelaburan Hartanah Berhad (PHB) bersama pengurus dananya, PHB Asset Management Berhad (PHBAM), mengumumkan agihan pendapatan akhir sebanyak 2.10 sen seunit bagi tempoh enam bulan berakhir 30 September 2026, menurut kenyataan PHB bersama hari ini. PHB selaku penaja dana turut mengisytiharkan edaran bonus sebanyak 0.40 sen seunit, menjadikan jumlah agihan bagi tempoh tersebut sebanyak 2.50 sen seunit. Bonus itu diberikan kepada pegangan sehingga satu juta unit pertama bagi setiap pemegang unit. Selepas mengambil kira agihan pendapatan interim sebanyak 2.50 sen seunit yang diumumkan pada April 2026, jumlah agihan bagi FY2026 mencapai 5.00 sen seunit. Agihan akhir itu membabitkan pembayaran RM120.13 juta. Agihan pendapatan tersebut adalah bersih selepas cukai dan zakat, membolehkan pemegang unit menerima jumlah penuh tanpa sebarang potongan atau tanggungan tambahan. Pembayaran akan dibuat dalam bentuk unit AHB dan dikreditkan terus ke dalam akaun pemegang unit selewat-lewatnya pada 13 Oktober 2026. Pengarah Urusan Kumpulan PHB, Mazuki Abdullah @ Muhammad berkata agihan bagi FY2026 mencerminkan ketahanan berterusan AHB dan kekuatan portfolio hartanahnya, disokong pendekatan pengurusan aset serta pelaburan yang berdisiplin. “Prestasi AHB pada tahun ini membuktikan komitmen kami untuk terus memberikan pulangan yang kompetitif kepada pemegang unit,” katanya. Beliau berkata PHB terus memperkukuh kedudukan AHB sebagai instrumen pelaburan pilihan pelabur Bumiputera melalui pengurusan modal yang berhemat, strategi pelaburan dinamik dan pengoptimuman portfolio bagi memastikan pertumbuhan mampan serta penciptaan nilai jangka panjang. Menurut Mazuki, penawaran tambahan sebanyak 400 juta unit AHB yang diumumkan baru-baru ini memperluas peluang kepada lebih ramai pelabur Bumiputera untuk mengambil bahagian dalam pelaburan hartanah komersial utama. Beliau berkata AHB akan terus menyokong pembentukan kekayaan jangka panjang Bumiputera dan menjana nilai mampan kepada pemegang unit. Komitmen itu selaras dengan aspirasi Pelan Transformasi Ekonomi Bumiputera 2035 (PUTERA35) untuk memperkukuh penyertaan ekonomi, pemilikan dan pembentukan kekayaan Bumiputera. Agihan dilaburkan semula secara automatik Sementara itu, Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif PHBAM, Zulkifli Ishak berkata pihaknya kekal komited menguruskan AHB secara bertanggungjawab supaya dana itu terus menjadi pilihan pelaburan yang mudah diakses oleh pelabur Bumiputera. Agihan pendapatan akan dilaburkan semula secara automatik, menambah pegangan unit pelabur dan membolehkan mereka berpotensi menikmati manfaat pengkompaunan dalam jangka panjang. Unit tambahan akan dikreditkan terus ke dalam akaun tanpa memerlukan permohonan berasingan. Pelabur Bumiputera boleh melanggan AHB pada harga tetap RM1.00 seunit, dengan pelaburan minimum RM100 dan maksimum RM1 juta. Langganan boleh dibuat di cawangan pengedar sah AHB seluruh negara, iaitu Malayan Banking Berhad (Maybank), AmBank Berhad, AmBank Islamic Berhad, Bank Islam Malaysia Berhad dan Bank Kerjasama Rakyat Malaysia Berhad. Sejak ditubuhkan pada 2010, AHB telah mengagihkan sejumlah RM2.7 bilion pendapatan kepada pemegang unit Bumiputera.

title: 'MKH bakal dinyahsenarai selepas Batu Kawan kuasai 95.16% saham | DagangNews - Berita Bisnes Anda
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR 1 Okt – MKH Bhd bakal dinyahsenarai daripada Bursa Malaysia selepas Batu Kawan Bhd bersama anak syarikatnya, Whitmore Holdings Sdn Bhd serta pihak yang bertindak bersama mereka menguasai 95.16% saham syarikat pemaju hartanah itu. Jumlah pegangan tersebut bersamaan 548.85 juta saham MKH setakat penutupan dagangan pada 30 Sept 2026, menurut kenyataan yang dikeluarkan oleh Maybank Investment Bank Bhd bagi pihak Batu Kawan dan Whitmore. Dengan pegangan yang sudah melepasi 90%, Batu Kawan dan Whitmore kini boleh mengambil alih baki saham MKH yang masih dipegang pemegang saham yang tidak menerima tawaran pengambilalihan tersebut. Baki saham MKH akan diambil alih secara wajib Langkah itu akan dibuat di bawah Seksyen 222(1) Akta Pasaran Modal dan Perkhidmatan 2007 yang membolehkan baki saham diperoleh secara wajib. Tawaran pengambilalihan pada harga RM2 sesaham itu masih dibuka sehingga 8 Oktober 2026 selepas tarikh tutup asal pada 17 September lalu dilanjutkan. Selepas tempoh tawaran tamat, Bursa Malaysia Securities akan menggantung dagangan saham MKH selepas lima hari pasaran, sebelum Batu Kawan dan Whitmore meneruskan proses untuk menarik balik status penyenaraian MKH. Pengambilalihan MKH bernilai RM1.15 bilion Langkah Batu Kawan mengambil alih MKH bermula pada Mei lalu apabila Whitmore bersetuju membeli kepentingan 47.7% dalam MKH daripada anggota keluarga Chen pada harga RM2 sesaham, membabitkan nilai RM549.8 juta. Pembelian itu kemudiannya disusuli tawaran kepada pemegang saham MKH yang lain pada harga sama bagi membolehkan Batu Kawan meningkatkan pegangannya dalam syarikat tersebut. Secara keseluruhan, pengambilalihan MKH untuk menjadikannya syarikat persendirian bernilai sehingga RM1.15 bilion, termasuk kos pembelian kepentingan awal daripada keluarga Chen. Tawaran RM2 sesaham terima pandangan berbeza Bagaimanapun, tawaran tersebut sebelum ini mendapat pandangan berbeza daripada penasihat bebas MKH dan MKH Oil Palm (East Kalimantan) Bhd, iaitu cabang perladangan MKH yang disenaraikan secara berasingan. Kenanga Investment Bank Bhd, yang bertindak sebagai penasihat bebas MKH, menilai tawaran RM2 sesaham itu sebagai “tidak adil tetapi munasabah”, dengan mengambil kira harga tawaran yang lebih rendah daripada nilai aset wajar MKH. Bagi MKH Oil Palm pula, Mainstreet Advisers Sdn Bhd menggesa pemegang saham menolak tawaran 66.26 sen sesaham daripada Batu Kawan, yang disifatkannya sebagai “tidak adil dan tidak munasabah”. Menurut Mainstreet, harga tawaran itu mewakili diskaun 47% kepada nilai aset bersih (NAV) MKH Oil Palm. Pada masa sama, Batu Kawan bercadang mengekalkan MKH Oil Palm sebagai syarikat yang disenaraikan di Bursa Malaysia.- DagangNews.com

title: 'Deluge lodges prospectus for proposed SGX Mainboard IPO
body: 'SAC Capital and Maybank Securities will serve as joint bookrunners and underwriters.  Deluge Corporation has lodged a preliminary prospectus with the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) for its proposed initial public offering on the Singapore Exchange’s Mainboard.  The release did not disclose the number of shares to be offered, the offer price or the proposed listing date.  SAC Capital has been appointed as the issue manager for the offering, whilst iCapital Holdings (SG) will serve as the listing consultant.  SAC Capital and Maybank Securities are the joint bookrunners and underwriters.  Deluge said a final prospectus would be made available once it is registered by MAS and the offering is launched. title: 'Wacana PTKP dan PPh 21 DTP belum cukup, PPN perlu turun jadi 8%
body: 'KONTAN.CO.ID-JAKARTA. Wacana pemerintah menaikkan batas Penghasilan Tidak Kena Pajak (PTKP) dan memperluas insentif PPh 21 Ditanggung Pemerintah (DTP) belum cukup untuk menggankat kesejahteraan hidup masyarakat yang masih tertekan.  Maklum, pemerintah belum mengubah besaran PTKP sebesar Rp 54 juta per tahun selama satu dekade.  Sementara itu, insentif PPh 21 DTP yang sebelumnya terbatas pada sektor padat karya dan pariwisata akan diperluas ke seluruh sektor bagi pekerja dengan gaji di bawah Rp 10 juta.  Kepala Ekonom Bank Maybank Indonesia Juniman menilai, kenaikan PTKP dan perluasan insentif PPh 21 DTP dapat memberikan ruang pendapatan lebih besar bagi masyarakat untuk meningkatkan konsumsi.  Namun, pemerintah tidak bisa hanya mengandalkan kedua kebijakan tersebut untuk mengerek daya beli.  "Kalau kita lihat, peningkatan PTKP itu memang menjadi keinginan pemerintah, terutama untuk meningkatkan daya beli masyarakat, khususnya kelas menengah ke bawah," ujar Juniman kepada Kontan, Rabu (30/9/2026).  Menurutnya, kenaikan PTKP akan membuat sebagian masyarakat yang sebelumnya mulai masuk sebagai wajib pajak menjadi tidak lagi terbebani pajak penghasilan. Dengan demikian, terdapat tambahan pendapatan yang bisa digunakan untuk konsumsi.  Namun, Juniman mengingatkan pemerintah agar tidak melihat kenaikan PTKP hanya dari sisi peningkatan daya beli. Pemerintah juga harus menghitung konsekuensinya terhadap penerimaan pajak.  "Hal ini harus dikalkulasi dengan betul-betul," jelasnya.  Menurut Juniman, persoalan daya beli masyarakat tidak akan selesai hanya dengan menaikkan PTKP. Kebijakan tersebut hanya menjadi salah satu instrumen untuk memberikan tambahan ruang konsumsi bagi masyarakat.  Terlebih, dalam kondisi ketika pertumbuhan pendapatan masyarakat tidak mampu mengejar kenaikan biaya hidup, pemerintah perlu menyiapkan kebijakan yang lebih luas.  "Dalam kondisi sekarang, ketika pendapatan masyarakat tidak meningkat secepat kenaikan biaya hidup, tentu ini akan menjadi masalah kalau pemerintah hanya berkutat pada PTKP," ujarnya.  Karena itu, Juniman mendorong pemerintah tidak hanya mengandalkan kenaikan PTKP dan insentif PPh 21 DTP. Pemerintah dapat mempertimbangkan penyesuaian tarif pajak, sembari memperluas basis penerimaan melalui ekstensifikasi pajak.  Salah satu opsi yang dapat dipertimbangkan adalah menurunkan tarif Pajak Pertambahan Nilai (PPN). Menurut Juniman, kebijakan tersebut dapat mengurangi beban masyarakat sekaligus mendorong konsumsi domestik yang saat ini mulai melambat.  "Kalau sekarang PPN 11%, dengan kondisi saat ini ketika konsumsi mulai melambat, paling tidak pemerintah bisa mempertimbangkan untuk menurunkan tarif PPN. Itu bisa mengurangi beban masyarakat dan pada akhirnya mendongkrak penjualan serta aktivitas ekonomi domestik," katanya.  Juniman bahkan menyarankan opsi penurunan tarif PPN hingga menjadi 8%. Namun, ia menekankan bahwa pemerintah harus menghitung secara cermat dampaknya terhadap volume transaksi dan penerimaan negara.  "Kalau misalnya 8%, volume-nya naik berapa, nanti kan ada datanya. Bisa naik atau turun. Paling enggak bisa sama," jelas Juniman.  Menurutnya, penurunan tarif pajak tidak selalu berarti penerimaan negara akan turun. Jika penurunan tarif mampu mendorong peningkatan volume transaksi dan konsumsi, penerimaan yang hilang dari sisi tarif dapat dikompensasi oleh kenaikan basis pajak.  "Peningkatan volume konsumsi sebenarnya secara langsung juga bisa meningkatkan penerimaan pajak. Jadi yang hilang dari tarif bisa dikompensasi dengan kenaikan volume yang ada," ujarnya.  Karena itu, pemerintah perlu melakukan analisis sensitivitas sebelum mengubah tarif PPN.  Perhitungan tersebut penting untuk melihat seberapa besar kenaikan volume transaksi yang diperlukan agar penerimaan pajak tetap terjaga.  Juniman menilai kombinasi kebijakan tersebut diperlukan lantaran perekonomian Indonesia masih sangat bergantung pada konsumsi domestik. Sementara itu, dorongan dari sektor eksternal relatif sulit diandalkan di tengah kondisi ekonomi global.  "Jadi, kalau tarif pajak bisa diturunkan terlebih dahulu, kemudian ketika ekonomi sudah tumbuh cepat, tarif bisa dinaikkan kembali secara perlahan. Istilahnya, ada trade off di situ," pungkasnya.

title: 'AAGB Rejects Bailout Talk After 64% Share Rout; Analysts Retain Bullish Calls with Over 100% Upside
body: 'AirAsia Group has rejected reports questioning its financial solvency, saying at a press conference chaired by co-founder and adviser Tony Fernandes that it had neither sought nor received a government bailout. It also denied that aircraft had been repossessed over unpaid leases or that the government had approached other airlines to take over its routes. Management said its fundraising efforts were primarily intended to refinance expensive debt rather than raise rescue capital. The clarification came after AirAsia Group’s share price fell 46% over one month, 61% over three months and 64% over the past year. Maybank Investment Bank analyst Yin Shao Yang maintained his “Buy” rating but cut the target price by 33% to RM1.22 in a report today, still implying 126% upside. Yin remains positive because he views AirAsia Group’s valuation as distressed. Its R M1.8 billion market capitalisation is below the approximately RM2 billion combined trough valuation of AirAsia Group and Capital A during the Covid-19 period, despite the airline currently being operational. The stock also trades at 1.9 times 2027E price-to-book value, below the 2.0-times average of global low-cost carriers. Successful refinancing could provide further support by generating approximately RM200 million in annual interest savings. Nevertheless, Yin’s “Buy” call depends heavily on jet-fuel prices moderating to US$115 per barrel in 2027E. He widened his 2026E core net-loss forecast to RM797.9 million from RM335.0 million, but expects earnings to rebound to core net profits of RM730.9 million in 2027E and RM772.1 million in 2028E. Yin estimates that every US$1-per-barrel increase in jet-fuel prices would reduce the group’s earnings by approximately RM75 million. title: 'One of Top Plantation Analysts Turns Cautious as Indonesia’s Land Reform Clouds Sector Outlook
body: 'Maybank Investment Bank analyst Ong Chee Ting downgraded his three-month view on regional plantations to “Neutral” from “Positive” after Indonesia passed a new agrarian reform law on September 22. The law seeks to address unequal land ownership and agrarian disputes. Ong believes unresolved questions over future landholding limits and whether the 20% land-provision requirement or an alternative profit-sharing arrangement applies to existing concessions could weigh on plantation share prices. He stressed that the law does not automatically require companies to surrender productive plantation land and has left his earnings forecasts unchanged pending implementation rules. Ong considers Malaysian plantation companies with little or no Indonesian estate exposure relatively safer from this regulatory risk. Sarawak Oil Palms and Ta Ann Holdings have all their planted area in Malaysia, while TH Plantations has only 3% in Indonesia. Separately, Maybank’s preferred “Buy” list now comprises SD Guthrie, Sarawak Oil Palms and Genting Plantations, with SD Guthrie replacing Kuala Lumpur Kepong on that list. Ong remains constructive on 2027 crude-palm-oil (CPO) prices, although strong current production and weak exports may limit near-term gains. Ong Chee Ting is currently ranked No.2 among 15 analysts covering the plantation sector on StockTipRatings, based on data since 2023. He holds a 76% expert rating, with a 17% average return and an 85% success rate across stocks he covered over the one-year period following his calls. Public Investment Bank analyst Chong Hoe Leong takes a less cautious near-term view. He maintained the plantation sector at “Overweight”, arguing that the new law is unlikely to cause immediate earnings or asset losses while its rules remain unsettled. He expects firmer CPO prices to support second-half earnings and retains a 2026 CPO price forecast of RM4,500 per tonne. His preferred stocks are Sarawak Plantation and Ta Ann Holdings, citing their above-industry production growth, projected dividend yields of 7%–8% and lack of Indonesian plantation exposure. Chong Hoe Leong ranks No.2 among 12 Public Investment Bank analysts tracked by StockTipRatings, based on data since 2023. He has a 45% expert rating and a 39% success rate across stocks he covered over the one-year period following his calls. title: 'Maybank, Gallant Venture to develop Bintan halal hub
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) has teamed up with Gallant Venture to develop the Bintan Inti Halal Hub (BIHH), a halal industrial ecosystem in Bintan, Indonesia amid growing global demand for halal products and services. The collaboration brings together Maybank's regional banking and halal ecosystem expertise with Gallant's industrial infrastructure to create opportunities for businesses looking to expand across Asean's growing halal economy. Maybank will provide a comprehensive suite of Islamic banking and financial solutions to businesses operating within BIHH and across the broader halal value chain. "This includes account services, deposits, cash management solutions, foreign exchange services, trade and working capital financing, payroll and settlement solutions, as well as access to Maybank's regional network and Islamic banking expertise," the bank said in a statement. The hub will support businesses expanding across Indonesia, Singapore and Malaysia, while attracting international investment into regional manufacturing and trading operations. Businesses will also gain access to halal certification support, business matching, strategic partners and Salaam Marketplace, Malaysia's first B2B halal marketplace, which expanded to Singapore in November 2025. Maybank Islamic Bhd group chief executive officer of Islamic banking and Maybank Islamic Bhd chief executive officer Yasin Abdullah said the initiative strengthens the ecosystem needed to help businesses connect, grow and tap into regional halal trade opportunities. He said the halal economy was among the fastest-growing segments globally, presenting significant opportunities for businesses across Southeast Asia. "This initiative also supports our ROAR30 aspirations - powering the real economy, opening up RM100 billion in opportunities for small and medium enterprise, and building the foundations for Maybank's global Islamic leadership. "By bringing together financing, market access, industry partnerships and halal ecosystem capabilities, we aim to support businesses throughout their expansion journey and contribute meaningfully to Asean's halal economy," he added.

title: 'Maybank, Gallant Venture bangunkan hab halal Bintan
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Maybank bekerjasama dengan Gallant Venture membangunkan Bintan Inti Halal Hub (BIHH), hab perindustrian halal di Bintan, Indonesia bagi memperkukuh perdagangan serantau dan membuka peluang pertumbuhan kepada perusahaan kecil dan sederhana (PKS). Kerjasama strategik itu menggabungkan kepakaran perbankan Islam dan rangkaian serantau Maybank dengan infrastruktur perindustrian Gallant Venture bagi menyediakan ekosistem bersepadu kepada perniagaan yang ingin mengembangkan operasi dalam pasaran halal ASEAN. Kerjasama itu diperkenalkan sempena pembukaan Halal Indo Expo 2026 di Jakarta, Indonesia pada minggu lalu dengan tumpuan kepada penyediaan kemudahan pembiayaan, sokongan pensijilan halal, pemadanan perniagaan serta akses ke pasaran serantau. Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Kumpulan Perbankan Islam merangkap Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Maybank Islamic Bhd, Yasin Abdullah, berkata inisiatif itu bertujuan memperkukuh ekosistem bagi membantu perniagaan berkembang dan menyertai perdagangan halal serantau. "Selain itu, kerjasama itu turut menyokong aspirasi ROAR30 Maybank untuk memperkasa ekonomi sebenar, membuka peluang bernilai RM100 bilion kepada PKS serta mengukuhkan kepimpinan global kumpulan itu dalam perbankan Islam," katanya dalam kenyataan. Menerusi kerjasama itu, Maybank akan menyediakan pelbagai penyelesaian perbankan Islam dan kewangan, termasuk perkhidmatan akaun, pengurusan tunai, pertukaran mata wang asing, pembiayaan perdagangan dan modal kerja, selain penyelesaian pembayaran gaji serta transaksi. Perniagaan yang menyertai hab berkenaan turut mendapat sokongan pensijilan halal, pemadanan perniagaan dan akses kepada Salaam Marketplace, platform perniagaan ke perniagaan (B2B) halal pertama Malaysia yang diperluas ke Singapura sejak November 2025. Ketua Perbankan Islam Maybank Singapura, Sazzali Sabandi, berkata hubungan serantau yang lebih kukuh dan ekosistem bersepadu penting bagi membolehkan perniagaan mengembangkan operasi melangkaui pasaran domestik serta merebut peluang perdagangan dan pelaburan di ASEAN. Sementara itu, Pengarah Perbankan Syariah Maybank Indonesia, Romy Buchari, berkata kerjasama itu berpotensi membangunkan Bintan sebagai pintu masuk strategik bagi industri pembuatan halal dan perdagangan serantau, selain menarik pelaburan, mewujudkan peluang pekerjaan serta memperkukuh rantaian bekalan Indonesia. Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Gallant Venture, Eugene Park, berkata BIHH disasarkan menjadi pangkalan pembuatan dan eksport yang kompetitif serta menyediakan peluang kepada pelabur untuk menyertai pasaran halal global. Beliau berkata, model kerjasama Singapura-Bintan menggabungkan kekuatan Singapura dalam bidang kewangan, logistik dan akses pasaran antarabangsa dengan infrastruktur pembuatan Bintan yang menawarkan kos kompetitif serta kemudahan sedia guna. BIHH yang terletak di Bintan Industrial Estate kini memasuki fasa pembangunan seterusnya membabitkan kawasan seluas 100 hektar selepas menyiapkan zon perintis seluas lima hektar, disokong saluran projek pembuatan dan sambutan menggalakkan. Kedudukan strategik Bintan yang hanya mengambil masa kira-kira 60 minit perjalanan feri dari Singapura serta berhampiran Malaysia turut menyokong potensinya sebagai hab industri halal dan pelancongan, selain mendapat manfaat daripada status Zon Perdagangan Bebas serta jaringan logistik sedia ada.

title: 'Maybank upgrades MAE Malware Shielding to detect more security risks
body: 'Maybank is rolling out an enhanced version of its Malware Shielding feature on the MAE app, which can now detect a wider range of potential security risks on users’ devices. As part of the update, MAE users will also be required to review and agree to a new set of Malware Shielding Terms & Conditions before they can continue using the app  The upgraded feature started rolling out progressively on 26 September 2026 with MAE app version 0.9.51, so don’t be surprised if the update hasn’t reached your phone just yet. Once updated, you’ll be prompted to review and agree to the new terms before you can continue using the app. By tapping ‘Agree’, you’re acknowledging that Malware Shielding will check your device for potential malware and risky security settings every time you launch MAE.  So what exactly is it looking out for? According to Maybank, Malware Shielding can detect malicious apps that may intercept authentication codes, remotely control your device or steal banking credentials. It also checks for unsafe device configurations, including Developer Mode, rooted or jailbroken devices, emulators and cloned environments.  The feature can also detect active screen sharing, recording, mirroring and overlay apps, as well as VPN services and untrusted keyboard apps. On top of that, it checks whether the MAE app itself has been modified or tampered with.  As for privacy, Maybank says Malware Shielding does not access, collect, process or store any personal information from the apps installed on your device. The bank also says your banking information and personal data remain confidential and protected.

title: 'Former Maybank tech head Ravinder Singh joins Bursa Malaysia
body: 'By Asia Samachar | Malaysia | After more than two decades navigating the technology side of banking and financial services — including 11 years with Maybank and another five with AmBank — Ravinder Singh Bachan Singh is moving to Bursa Malaysia to lead the stock exchange operator’s technology function. The 45-year-old has been appointed Director, Group Technology at Bursa Malaysia Bhd, effective Sept 28, 2026. He will also be designated a Principal Officer of the company. Ravinder was previously Regional Head of Technology at Maybank Investment Banking Group, where he was responsible for technology across its investment banking and asset management businesses. His 11-year stint with Maybank formed a significant part of a financial services career spanning more than 20 years. Before that, he spent about five years with AmBank Bhd, including as Head of Cash Management, Group IS. Over the years, Ravinder has built experience across investment banking, asset management, wealth management and transaction banking, both in Malaysia and internationally. His areas of expertise include technology strategy and transformation, digital platforms, cybersecurity, operational resilience and technology governance across multiple markets. At Bursa Malaysia, Ravinder will take charge of the group technology function, placing him in a key leadership role overseeing an increasingly critical component of the Malaysian capital market operator’s operations. Ravinder holds a Degree in Computing from Staffordshire University in the United Kingdom. He is also TOGAF 9 certified by The Open Group, a professional certification in enterprise architecture. Bursa Malaysia announced his appointment in an exchange filing on Sept 25. title: 'Maybank completes RM2.5bil AT1 sukuk mudharabah issuance
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) has completed the issuance of RM2.5 billion additional tier 1 (AT1) sukuk mudharabah under its sukuk programme. In a Bursa Malaysia filing today, the banking group said the perpetual sukuk comprises three series with nominal amounts of RM750 million, RM1.10 billion and RM650 million, respectively. The RM750 million tranche carries a fixed distribution rate of 4.85 per cent per annum until its first call date on Sept 29, 2031, while the RM1.10 billion tranche carries a rate of 5.11 per cent until its first call date on Sept 28, 2033. Meanwhile, the RM650 million tranche has a fixed distribution rate of 5.15 per cent per annum until its first call date on Sept 26, 2036. "The relevant reset distribution rates for the three tranches are based on the prevailing five-year, seven-year and 10-year Malaysian Government Securities rates, respectively, plus their respective initial spreads for fixed rates of 0.98 per cent, 0.97 per cent and 0.98 per cent per annum," said Maybank. The proceeds would be used for shariah-compliant purposes, including investments in ringgit- and foreign currency-denominated Islamic financial instruments approved by Bank Negara Malaysia's Shariah Advisory Council or the Securities Commission Malaysia's Shariah Advisory Council. It would also be used to fund the Islamic business activities of Maybank's subsidiaries and overseas branches, as well as other shariah-compliant business activities, said Maybank. The returns from the investments would be used for the periodic distributions of the AT1 sukuk mudharabah, which are payable semi-annually. The sukuk has been assigned an AA3 rating by RAM Rating Services Bhd.

title: 'Maybank perkasakan Ciri Malware Shielding terbina dalam Aplikasi MAE
body:
'

Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) sedang memperkasakan ciri keselamatan perlindungan perisian hasad (Malware Shielding) pada aplikasi perbankan MAE miliknya bagi menawarkan perlindungan lebih kukuh terhadap perisian berniat jahat serta pelbagai potensi risiko keselamatan peranti.

Menurut Maybank, penambahbaikan ciri keselamatan tersebut mula dilancarkan secara berperingkat bermula 26 September menerusi aplikasi MAE versi 0.9.51.

Bagaimanapun, setakat artikel ini ditulis, kemas kini versi baharu tersebut masih belum ditawarkan secara rasmi di gedung aplikasi Android dan iOS.

Versi terkini yang masih tersenarai di Google Play Store dan Apple App Store ialah versi 0.9.50. Sehubungan itu, pengguna disaran peka terhadap penawaran kemas kini tersebut dan segera memasangnya sebaik sahaja ia tersedia.

Pengesanan Ancaman Lebih Meluas

Maybank menjelaskan ciri Malware Shielding yang dipertingkatkan ini berupaya mengesan lebih banyak potensi risiko keselamatan pada peranti pengguna.

Sekiranya sebarang ancaman dikesan, aplikasi MAE akan memaparkan notifikasi amaran serta panduan langkah demi langkah yang perlu diambil oleh pengguna bagi mengamankan semula peranti sebelum mereka dibenarkan meneruskan transaksi perbankan.

Sebaik sahaja aplikasi versi terkini dipasang, pengguna akan diminta untuk menyemak dan bersetuju dengan Terma dan Syarat Malware Shielding. Apabila pengguna menekan butang “Setuju”, kebenaran akan diberikan kepada sistem untuk mengesan dan memaklumkan sebarang potensi perisian hasad mahupun tetapan peranti yang berisiko secara automatik pada setiap kali aplikasi MAE dilancarkan.

Bagi mengelakkan kebimbangan mengenai privasi, pihak bank menegaskan ciri Malware Shielding tidak mengakses, mengumpul, memproses atau menyimpan maklumat peribadi daripada aplikasi lain yang terpasang pada peranti pengguna. Maybank memberi jaminan bahawa segala maklumat perbankan dan data peribadi kekal sulit serta terlindung sepenuhnya.

Latar Belakang Ciri Keselamatan MAE

Sebagai rekod, Maybank mula memperkenalkan ciri Malware Shielding pada tahun 2024 sebagai langkah keselamatan pencegahan awal yang mengimbas potensi ancaman setiap kali aplikasi dilancarkan.

Ciri ini berupaya mengesan:

  • Aplikasi berisiko atau perisian berniat jahat (malicious apps).
  • Tetapan peranti yang tidak selamat, termasuk pengaktifan Mod Pembangun (Developer Mode).
  • Sistem operasi yang telah diubah suai atau dinyahkunci keselamatannya melalui proses root (Android) atau jailbreak (iOS).
  • Aktiviti perkongsian skrin (screen sharing) dan rakaman skrin (screen recording).
  • Sambungan serta perkhidmatan rangkaian yang tidak selamat.
  • Versi aplikasi MAE yang telah diubah suai (modified version).

Bergantung pada tahap risiko yang dikesan, sistem perlindungan ini boleh memaklumkan pengguna, memberikan arahan penyelesaian isu, atau menyekat sepenuhnya akses kepada aplikasi MAE sehingga risiko terbabit ditangani.

Maklumat lanjut, layari laman web rasmi Maybank.

title: 'Maybank’s MAE App Now Checks Your Phone For More Scam Risks
body: 'Maybank has upgraded Malware Shielding, the security check built into its MAE app. According to Maybank’s announcement, the new version is rolling out in stages from 26 September 2026. The upgrade lets it spot more kinds of risk on your phone.  If it finds a risk, MAE will tell you what’s wrong and how to fix it. For more serious risks, it may stop you from using the app until the problem is gone.  Malware Shielding Checks Your Phone Every Time You Open MAE  Malware is harmful software that scammers trick people into installing. They often send a link to an app file instead of pointing people to an official app store. Once malware is on a phone, it can read the TAC or OTP codes your bank sends you, or let a scammer control the phone from far away and approve transfers.  Malware Shielding looks for these dangers each time you launch MAE. In 2024, the Association of Banks in Malaysia (ABM) said this kind of check only runs when you open a banking app. It doesn’t keep running in the background all day. Maybank says the feature doesn’t collect or store the personal content on your phone, such as your photos, messages, or contacts.  The Phone Settings And Apps MAE Now Looks Out For  Some of the risks on Maybank’s list are clearly dangerous, such as scam apps. Others are everyday tools. Maybank says a VPN or a keyboard app from an unknown developer may expose your password, your TAC, or other banking details to people you don’t know.  Several of these have normal uses. People use VPNs for work or to watch shows from other countries, and some use screen recording to show a family member how to pay a bill. Maybank’s list doesn’t make exceptions for these, so switch them off before you open MAE.  A Warning Or A Lockout Depends On The Risk  Malware Shielding may warn you, show you steps to fix the problem, or block MAE until it’s fixed. Maybank’s FAQ says this depends on how serious the risk is.  Maybank doesn’t say which risks only bring up a warning and which lock the app. Because the check runs every time you open MAE, a setting you switch on later, such as screen recording, can still trigger it the next time you log in.  Other banks run similar checks. Members of ABM and the Association of Islamic Banking and Financial Institutions Malaysia (AIBIM) began adding malware shielding to their apps in August 2024. Banks that had switched it on by then included CIMB, Public Bank, RHB, and UOB, so you may see similar warnings in their apps too.  In June 2026, ABM reported that malware shielding helped stop more than 60,000 malware-related scam attempts in 2025, involving about RM22 million in potential losses.  A Malware Shielding Alert Can Affect Whether You Get Your Money Back  Bank Negara Malaysia’s (BNM) SEFT policy sets out when banks compensate victims of unauthorised transactions, including money taken through malware. However, BNM’s 2025 Annual Report says some victims may be held fully responsible and get no compensation at all. One example it gives is a victim who downloads a harmful app even after the bank has warned them about the risk.  So if you tap past a Malware Shielding alert and carry on, it could be harder to get compensation if a scammer later takes money from your account.  Update MAE And Tap Agree To Keep Using It  To get added Malware Shielding protection, update MAE to the latest version from Google Play, the App Store, or Huawei AppGallery. After the update, MAE will ask you to read and agree to the Malware Shielding terms and conditions. This step is compulsory, so you can’t keep using the app until you tap “Agree”.  If MAE blocks you, follow the steps on your screen. You may be asked to delete a suspicious app, turn off a setting such as Developer Mode, stop screen sharing or recording, switch to a supported phone, or reinstall MAE from an official app store. Once that’s done, close MAE and open it again.  If you’re still locked out, call Maybank Group Customer Care on 1-300-88-6688, or +603-7844 3696 from overseas. If you think money has already left your account, turn on your bank’s kill switch and call the National Scam Response Centre on 997. The line is open 24 hours, and your call counts as a police report.

title: 'Maybank Fully Redeems RM1.56 Billion AT1 Sukuk On First Call Date
body: 'Maybank has fully redeemed its RM1.56 billion Additional Tier 1 (AT1) Sukuk Mudharabah on its first call date, seven years after the Islamic capital securities were issued.  The banking group said the redemption was completed on the same day, Sept 25, 2026.  The AT1 Sukuk Mudharabah was originally issued on Sept 25, 2019, under Maybank’s sukuk programme, which has since been upsized from RM10 billion to RM30 billion in nominal value.  The securities were structured based on the Shariah principle of Mudharabah, a profit-sharing arrangement, and formed part of the banking group’s Additional Tier 1 capital instruments.  Maybank Investment Bank Bhd made the announcement on behalf of Maybank’s board of directors.

title: 'BERNAMA - Maybank Group Sustainability Week 2026 Advances Net Zero Ambitions Through Capacity Building and Collective Action
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR, Sept 25 (Bernama) -- Maybank recently organised the Maybank Group Sustainability Week (MGSW) 2026, a three-day programme held from 21 to 23 September 2026 at Menara Merdeka Maybank. Under the theme “Net Zero. From Commitment to Action”, MGSW 2026 focuses on advancing Maybank’s net zero journey through capacity building, sustainability awareness and capabilities, in line with the Group’s ROAR30 sustainability ambitions. MGSW 2026 saw Maybankers across the Group participate in two key events; ‘Net Zero Week’, the ‘Maybank Sustainability Practitioner Certification (MSPC) Open Day’ and ‘Grand Conferment Ceremony’, celebrating over 1,000 certified sustainability practitioners. title: 'EPF Disposes 10 Million Maybank Shares
body: 'The Employees Provident Fund (EPF) has disposed of 10 million shares in Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank), reducing its direct shareholding in Malaysia’s largest banking group to 12.045%.  Maybank said the disposal took place on Sept 22 through Citigroup Nominees (Tempatan) Sdn Bhd, under an account held for the EPF.  Following the transaction, the retirement fund’s direct interest in Maybank stood at approximately 1.46 billion shares, representing 12.045% of the bank’s issued share capital.  The filing did not disclose the disposal price or total transaction value.  The EPF remains a substantial shareholder in Maybank following the disposal.  Maybank shares closed at 10.22, dropping close to 10% over the last six months.

title: 'Bursa Appoints Former Maybank Technology Head As Group Tech Director
body: 'Bursa Malaysia Bhd has appointed Ravinder Singh Bachan Singh as Director, Group Technology, effective Sept 28, 2026.  The stock exchange operator said Ravinder, 45, will also be designated as a Principal Officer of the company upon assuming his new role.  Ravinder brings more than 20 years of experience in the domestic and international financial services industry, spanning investment banking, asset management, wealth management and transaction banking.  Prior to joining Bursa Malaysia, he served as Head of Technology for Maybank Investment Banking Group, where he oversaw technology functions across its investment banking and asset management businesses.  His expertise includes technology strategy and transformation, digital platforms, cybersecurity, operational resilience and technology governance across multiple markets.  Ravinder holds a Degree in Computing from Staffordshire University in the United Kingdom and is TOGAF 9 certified by The Open Group, a professional qualification in enterprise architecture.

title: 'Penangan BTS! Army Sanggup Beratur Awal Pagi Di Cawangan Maybank Untuk Dapatkan Kad Debit Edisi Terhad
body: 'Sekilas  Peminat BTS sanggup beratur awal pagi di cawangan terpilih Maybank untuk mendapatkan kad debit edisi terhad kumpulan itu. Hanya 60 keping kad ditawarkan setiap hari, tetapi Maybank juga menyediakan permohonan secara dalam talian bermula 28 September. Kad debit ini adalah sebahagian daripada kerjasama Maybank dengan siri jelajah dunia BTS, WORLD TOUR ARIRANG.  Penangan kumpulan terkenal Korea Selatan iaitu BTS memang tidak dapat disangkal apabila peminat kumpulan itu dilihat sanggup beratur dari awal pagi di beberapa cawangan Maybank bagi mendapatkan kad debit edisi terhad kumpulan berkenaan.  Meskipun hanya 60 keping kad ditawarkan setiap hari di cawangan terpilih, namun itu tidak menghalang golongan Army dari mendapatkan kad edisi terhad tersebut.  Bagi yang tidak berkesempatan untuk beratur, Maybank turut menyediakan pilihan permohonan secara dalam talian yang akan dibuka mulai 28 September ini.  Kad debit edisi terhad tersebut merupakan sebahagian daripada kerjasama Maybank bersempena siri jelajah dunia BTS yang akan datang, WORLD TOUR ARIRANG.  Kerjasama tersebut sekali gus memberi peluang kepada peminat BTS untuk memiliki kad debit khas yang menampilkan elemen berkaitan kumpulan tersebut.

title: 'Maybank limits BTS world tour debit card to 60 per branch per day, online applications open 28 September
body: 'Subscribe to our FREE Newsletter, or Telegram and WhatsApp channels for the latest stories and updates.  Maybank dropped the limited-edition Maybank Visa BTS World Tour “ARIRANG” Debit Card at 12 selected branches yesterday, and just as expected, fans queued up in droves to get their hands on it!  The new black card has a simple design, with the words “BTS World Tour ARIRANG” printed in a glossy finish across the bottom half of the card. It was released in conjunction with the Kpop band’s upcoming world tour.  Fans who braved the queues outside the banks proudly shared pictures of their new cards online. It’s easy to see why the excitement is so real because only 60 cards are issued per day at each selected Maybank branch, making this a seriously hot commodity.  If you don’t have time to queue, you can still get your hands on the Maybank BTS card online via Maybank2U from 28 September onwards. Simply open the Maybank2U app, go to “Settings,” select “Cards,” then choose “Replace/Renew Card.” Do note that this process comes with a card replacement fee of RM12.  Excitement for BTS-themed cards abroad  Malaysian fans are not the only ones treated to a special BTS bank card. Fans in Thailand and the Philippines have also shared their respective country’s card designs online — a sign of just how deeply the group has embedded itself across Southeast Asia.  That footprint runs especially deep in Malaysia. BTS has consistently sold out arenas here since their early tour years, with Malaysian ARMY widely regarded as one of the most organised and vocal fandoms in the region. The group’s blend of polished choreography, emotionally direct lyrics, and members who have spoken openly about mental health resonated strongly with young Malaysians navigating similar pressures. The fact that a national bank is now issuing limited-edition BTS debit cards is, in many ways, just the financial sector catching up to what fans already knew.  An Indonesian fan on X, formerly Twitter, expressed hope that local banks would release a BTS-themed card — or at minimum, a Flazz card, an e-money smart card issued by Bank Central Asia. The comment drew significant engagement, suggesting the appetite extends well beyond Malaysia’s borders.  Share your thoughts with us via TRP’s Facebook, X, Instagram, or Threads.

title: 'Maybank BTS World Tour Arirang debit card: Everything you need to know before applying
body: 'Maybank has officially introduced its limited edition Maybank Visa BTS World Tour Arirang Debit Card in Malaysia. With initial physical branch allocations selling out rapidly across the country, fans looking to secure the card should now stand by for the official Maybank2u online rollout on 28 September 2026. What is the Maybank BTS World Tour Arirang debit card? The card is an exclusive limited edition Visa debit card released in collaboration with Visa for the BTS World Tour Arirang. It links directly to any existing or new Maybank current or savings account, including popular options like a standard Savings Account i. Maybank has capped total nationwide issuance to 200,000 cards. Following the instant sell out of physical branch quotas, remaining card stock will be made available strictly through online applications. Additional features compared to a standard Maybank debit card While core banking functions mirror standard Maybank debit cards, the BTS edition includes several exclusive perks and modern payment integrations. Cardholders can add the Maybank Visa BTS World Tour Arirang Debit Card to Apple Pay and Samsung Wallet. This allows users to make contactless mobile payments directly from an iPhone, Apple Watch, or compatible Samsung Galaxy device without needing the physical card on hand. Beyond mobile wallet support and limited edition artwork, getting the card grants an immediate advantage in Maybank and Visa’s official concert ticket giveaway. While standard debit cardholders must accumulate spending to qualify, obtaining this limited edition card automatically awards an entry into the prize draw. In terms of banking capabilities, the card operates on the Visa network with smart chip security, contactless highway toll support, and standard fee structures, including the standard RM12 replacement fee. How to win BTS World Tour Arirang concert tickets in Kuala Lumpur Maybank and Visa are running a contest from 23 September 2026 until 1 November 2026, offering cardholders a chance to win pairs of tickets to the BTS World Tour Arirang concert at National Stadium Bukit Jalil on 12 December 2026. To participate, cardholders must first register by sending an SMS with the word BTS to the number 66628, or register through the dedicated Maybank2u promotion page. Once registered, users can earn entries through multiple qualifying actions: - Automatic entry: Successfully applying for or replacing an existing card with the limited edition BTS debit card awards one automatic entry. - Cumulative spending: Every cumulative RM400 spent on eligible retail transactions using any Maybank Visa debit card during the campaign period earns one entry. - Additional spending: Every subsequent RM400 spent yields additional entries to boost winning chances. Transactions involving eWallet top ups, government payments, and charity donations are excluded from eligible spend. Winners will be selected through Maybank’s randomiser system, with each cardmember eligible to win a maximum of one pair of tickets. How to apply for the Maybank BTS World Tour Arirang debit card? With physical branch allocations fully exhausted, all remaining card requests must be submitted online when portal access opens on 28 September 2026. Existing Maybank customers Existing Maybank debit cardholders do not need to visit a branch or collect cards in person. You can request a card replacement online via Maybank2u starting 28 September 2026. To place an order, log in to Maybank2u on the web, navigate to Settings, select Cards, go to Manage Debit Cards, and click Replace or Renew Card. Select the BTS card, enter your mailing address, and confirm the request using Secure2u or SMS TAC. The card will be delivered directly to your home address for a standard RM12 replacement fee. Delivery times may exceed thirty days during periods of high demand. If card allocations run out completely before your request processes, Maybank will issue a full refund of the replacement fee. Non-Maybank customers If you do not currently hold a Maybank account, you cannot directly order a card replacement online as a first time applicant. New customers must first open an account with Maybank. You can set up an account online through the MAE app or visit any Maybank branch with your MyKad or passport and a standard RM250 deposit, or RM50 with an employment letter. Once your account is active and registered on Maybank2u, you can stand by to request the BTS debit card replacement via Maybank2u starting 28 September 2026. Transaction limits and security settings The card comes with a default daily purchase limit of RM3,000, which can be increased up to RM10,000 via Maybank2u or adjusted at any Maybank ATM. Each card carries a validity period of seven years from issuance. Cardholders planning to use the card for online shopping or overseas ATM cash withdrawals must manually activate ecommerce and overseas transaction features inside Maybank2u prior to making transactions.

title: 'Maybank Lancar Kad Debit Visa Edisi Terhad BTS ‘Arirang’, Peminat Boleh Dapatkan Di 12 Cawangan Terpilih
body: 'Suami isteri meninggal selang sehari, terpisah di dunia hanya beberapa jam. Sehidup semati, jodoh hingga ke syurga. Ungkapan itu cukup dekat dengan Allahyarham Alias bin Panjang Aris dan isterinya, Allahyarhamah Roezah binti Abdul Hamid apabila kedua-duanya dijemput Ilahi dalam tempoh tidak sampai 24 jam. Setelah puluhan tahun hidup bersama, membina keluarga dan melalui susah senang sebagai suami isteri, tiada siapa menyangka perpisahan hanya berlaku seketika buat suami isteri ini. Arwah Roezah sempat menghantar arwah suami ke tanah perkuburan sebelum mengikut jejak suami dikasihinya itu. Kisah kehilangan dua insan tersayang ini dikongsikan cucu mereka, Haziq Azmin menerusi Threads. Jelasnya, arwah datuk dan Opah cukup dekat di hatinya kerana sejak kecil, insan inilah yang menjaganya di saat ibu bapanya keluar bekerja mencari rezeki. Malah dia akui bukan mudah menerima hakikat perpisahan ini dan mengambil masa untuk berkongsi kisah duka ini. “Baru ada kekuatan nak buat post ni.” tulis Haziq Azmin. Membuka cerita tentang kedua-duanya, Haziq berkongsi bahawa arwah atuk dan Opah dilahirkan dalam bulan yang sama iaitu pada bulan Mei. Arwah atuk dilahirkan pada 28 Mei 1942 sementara arwah Opah pula pada 13 Mei 1948. Tarikh mereka meninggal dunia juga berdekatan. Arwah atuk meninggal pada 26 Ogos 2026, manakala arwah Opah sehari selepas itu iaitu pada 27 Ogos 2026. Menurut Haziq, keadaan kesihatan arwah atuknya sudah lama uzur malah doktor ada memaklumkan hal ini kepada keluarga. “Arwah atuk menghembuskan nafas terakhir kira-kira pukul 7.56 malam. Kami sekeluarga dah terima atuk pergi, sebab doktor memang bagitahu keadaan atuk dah kritikal. Namun kami semua tidak menyangka akan menerima satu lagi berita duka dalam masa terdekat, selang sehari. Mengimbas kembali pagi terakhir dirinya diuji kehilangan dua insan kesayangan, Haziq memaklumkan Opahnya turut berada di tanah perkuburan ketika jenazah atuk dikebumikan sekitar pukul 11 pagi. “Opah ada bersama kami di tanah perkuburan. Saksikan arwah atuk sampai siap dimasukkan ke liang lahat. Siap siram kubur atuk lagi dan sempat berbual dengan saudara-mara yang hadir. “Tak ada pun tanda-tanda Opah sakit. Balik dari tanah perkuburan, Opah berehat seketika. Sehinggalah jam 3.50 itu, Opah bangun mahu mandi tapi badannya tak larat bangun. Ibu saudara saya maklum yang Opah nampak lain dari kebiasaan. “Opah beritahu dia susah bernafas. Tanpa sempat kami beri bantuan apa-apa, Opah menyusul ikut arwah Atuk. Tak sangka, secepat itu opah pergi. Memang tak dijangka kami sekeluarga,” jelasnya. Selepas semuanya berlaku, Haziq teringat kembali kata-kata yang pernah dilontarkan arwah Opanya ketika mencium jenazah atuk buat kali terakhir. “Bila nak jumpa lagi ni bang, nanti kita jumpa ya.” Inilah kata-kata akhir Opah ketika mencium arwah atuk dan tak sangka, kata-katanya itu menjadi kenyataan. Keduanya hidup bersama di dunia dan pergi juga selang sehari. “Pasangan sehidup semati, insya-Allah pasangan syurga opah dan atuk.” Jelas anak muda ini lagi, hubungannya dengan arwah atuk dan nenek agak rapat kerana dua insan inilah yang menjaganya dari kecil. “Aku dijaga oleh opah dan atuk sejak kecil time mak ayah pergi kerja. Aku masih tak boleh proses apa yang berlaku,” kongsinya di threads. Jika 26 Ogos hari istimewa bagi sebahagian dari kita, berbeza buat diri Haziq. Pada tarikh yang sama juga iaitu 26 Ogos, ayahnya meninggal dunia 9 tahun lalu dan tarikh itu juga dikongsi dengan pemergian atuknya, Alias. “Semoga arwah opah dan atuk ditempatkan di kalangan orang yang beriman. Kita jumpa kat sana ye opah atuk,” tulisnya mengakhiri kisahnya di threads. Semoga Allah SWT mencucuri rahmat ke atas roh Allahyarham Alias bin Panjang Aris dan Allahyarhamah Roezah binti Abdul Hamid, mengampunkan segala dosa, melapangkan kubur serta menempatkan kedua-duanya dalam kalangan orang beriman dan beramal soleh. Bercinta di dunia, semoga dipertemukan kembali dan kekal berjodoh hingga ke syurga. Al-Fatihah. title: 'Pesara tolak tawaran RM9,799 Maybank, tuntut semula RM48,999
body: 'KUCHING: Seorang pesara menolak tawaran Maybank sebanyak RM9,799.99 sebagai penyelesaian penuh dan muktamad selepas kehilangan RM48,999.99 menerusi lima transaksi tanpa kebenaran daripada akaunnya.  Ahli Dewan Undangan Negeri (ADUN) Padungan, Chong Chieng Jen, berkata mangsa yang hanya dikenali sebagai Encik Lo kehilangan wang berkenaan antara 2 dan 3 Ogos lalu tanpa pengetahuannya.  Menurut beliau, lima transaksi berkenaan melibatkan RM3,000 melalui FPX pada 12.12 tengah hari, 2 Ogos; RM3,000 ke akaun Bank Simpanan Nasional (BSN) pada 12.18 tengah hari; RM3,000 kepada RYT Bank melalui FPX pada 12.31 tengah hari; RM999.99 kepada seorang individu bernama Joanne Johan pada 12.35 tengah hari dan RM39,000 ke akaun Alliance Bank pada 3.12 pagi, 3 Ogos.  Chong berkata, Lo hanya menyedari kehilangan wang tersebut selepas pergi ke bank pada pagi 3 Ogos.  “Encik Lo kehilangan RM48,999.99 daripada akaun Maybank walaupun beliau tidak melakukan sebarang kesalahan. Kini, Maybank menawarkan RM9,799.99 kepadanya dengan syarat beliau menggugurkan tuntutannya terhadap bank.  “Ini tidak boleh diterima,” katanya dalam kenyataan hari ini.  Beliau berkata, pihak bank dimaklumkan mengenai transaksi tanpa kebenaran itu dalam tempoh 24 jam selepas kejadian, manakala transaksi terakhir berjumlah RM39,000 dilaporkan kurang daripada tujuh jam selepas ia berlaku.  “Walaupun bank dimaklumkan mengenai transaksi tanpa kebenaran itu dalam tempoh 24 jam, dan transaksi terakhir dilaporkan kurang daripada tujuh jam selepas ia berlaku, bank mendakwa ia tidak dapat menyekat transaksi berkenaan.  “Bank juga dikatakan tidak mempunyai mekanisme tempoh bertenang bagi akaun dan transaksi Maybank,” katanya.  Menurut Chong, sekiranya Maybank melaksanakan tempoh bertenang seperti yang disarankan oleh Bank Negara Malaysia pada 2022, transaksi berkenaan berkemungkinan dapat disekat dan kerugian Lo dapat dielakkan.  Beliau berkata, susulan campur tangannya dalam kes itu, Maybank minggu lalu menawarkan RM9,799.99, bersamaan 20 peratus daripada jumlah kerugian, sebagai penyelesaian penuh dan muktamad.  “Encik Lo ialah seorang pesara. RM48,999 merupakan wang simpanan hasil titik peluhnya.  “Bagi Maybank, jumlah itu mungkin tidak besar, tetapi bagi Encik Lo, ia amat besar dan memberi kesan serius kepadanya,” katanya.  Chong berkata, Lo tetap dengan pendiriannya untuk menolak tawaran berkenaan kerana jumlah tersebut hanya meliputi 20 peratus daripada keseluruhan kerugiannya.  Beliau turut menggesa polis menjalankan siasatan menyeluruh terhadap kes berkenaan, termasuk meneliti sistem Maybank serta bank-bank penerima yang terlibat dalam transaksi tersebut.  Pada masa sama, Chong menggesa agar keseluruhan jumlah kerugian Lo dibayar balik dan berkata beliau akan terus mengikuti perkembangan kes berkenaan bagi membantu pesara tersebut.

title: 'All You Need To Know About The BTS Arirang x Maybank Visa Card That’s Now Available In Malaysia
body:
'

BTS World Tour Arirang x Maybank Visa

It’s finally a Spring Day for Malaysian fans of BTS. Not literally – all we’ve got is summer over here – but fans can have a spring in their step after a drought of being left out of tour schedules and merch release lists.

Besides 2 concert dates scheduled in Malaysia, the latest merch drop from BTS on our shores comes in the form of an Arirang-themed Visa debit card, with the group’s name on a plastic card we can not leave home without.

What is the BTS World Tour Arirang Visa card for?

As the Worldwide Tour Sponsor for BTS World Tour Arirang – which unites the formidable 7-member group at 82 shows in 34 cities in five continents – Visa has been partnering with card issuers around the globe for limited-edition BTS Arirang debit cards. These cards are recognised as official merchandise by the group’s agency, HYBE, which means another merch item to cop and use in your daily life.

Each country gets its own special Arirang Visa card design, inspired by the colours and motifs of the BTS album and tour – it’ll feel a bit like getting your hands on an exclusive photocard, except this one carries your moolah.

How to get the card? 


Image credit: Lizzy

In Malaysia, Visa has collaborated with Maybank to launch the Arirang-themed Visa card: a slick, all-black matte card with the BTS tour name in shiny lettering and the Arirang red logo on the top right.

There are two ways to get it from the Malaysian bank: offline and online. Here’s how:

Offline

From 23rd September 2026 onwards, fans can head to 12 Maybank branches nationwide to get their hands on the BTS World Tour Arirang Maybank Visa card.

The branches all open at 9.30am on weekdays, with card replacements and applications for new Maybank accounts to secure the card all done over the counter.

To ensure there are enough cards to go around, each branch has a strict daily 60-card issuance rule – in other words, each bank will only grant 60 BTS Visa cards per day to 60 customers. Expect queues even before opening hours because of this.


Image credit: Lizzy

Once you’re through the bank doors as one of 60 lucky fans of the day, it’ll be time to cheer. Look forward to fast service from bank staff who’ll hand you a queue number, and proceed to take your MyKad or passport, current debit card if not lost, and a thumbprint for application when your number is called. At the end of the process, you’ll be issued the BTS Visa card along with an envelope containing a sticker and celebratory message.

There’s a small “replacement” fee of RM12 to get the card, which will be deducted from your Maybank account funds.

Image credit: Lizzy

Here are the locations where you can process your application in person:

  1. Bukit Bintang
  2. Mid Valley City
  3. KL Main Branch (Menara Tun Perak)
  4. Dataran Maybank
  5. Petaling Jaya Main Branch
  6. Shah Alam Main Branch
  7. Penang Main Branch (Lebuh Union)
  8. Ipoh Main Branch (Jalan Sultan Idris Shah)
  9. Kuantan Main Branch (Jalan Sultan Abdullah)
  10. Johor Bahru Main Branch (City Square)
  11. Karamunsing (Bangunan Maybank)
  12. Kuching Main Branch

Online

Opt to skip the physical queues altogether if you’re an existing Maybank debit cardholder. You can get the BTS World Tour Arirang card online through the bank’s Maybank2u website, with online replacement requests accepted from 28th September onwards.

There’s also a RM12 replacement fee for this option, but it’ll be free if you have just 12 months left before your card’s expiry date.

Here’s how to submit a replacement request online:

  1. Log in to Maybank2u
  2. Go to Settings, select ‘Cards’
  3. Select ‘Manage Debit Cards’, then ‘Debit Card – Replace, Activate & Block’
  4. Click the three dots next to your debit card, select ‘Replace/Renew Card’
  5. Find the BTS World Tour Arirang debit card as your design of choice, and then click Next
  6. Fill in your delivery address, acknowledge the Terms & Conditions, and click ‘Submit’
  7. Verify your request with an SMS TAC or Secure 2U via the Maybank2U app
  8. Voilà, the replacement has been processed

Guide to get the BTS World Tour Arirang Visa card in Malaysia

Not every fan can say they have a Visa card with their favourite group on it. If you identify as an ARMY, the limited-edition BTS World Tour Arirang Visa card will be one to get, even if the process to get them might feel a little like the war for tickets.

title: 'SAMSUNG MALAYSIA AND MAYBANK PARTNER TO LAUNCH MALAYSIA’S FIRST SAMSUNG WALLET QR PAYMENT EXPERIENCE MalaysianUpdates
body: 'Kuala Lumpur, 24 July 2026 — Samsung Malaysia Electronics (SME) Sdn Bhd (Samsung) and Malayan Banking Berhad (Maybank) have entered into a strategic partnership to introduce Malaysia’s first Samsung Wallet QR Payment experience, marking a significant development in the country’s digital payments landscape. The collaboration, formalised through the signing of a Collaboration Agreement, combines Samsung’s mobile innovation with Maybank’s established digital banking ecosystem to provide Samsung Galaxy users with a faster, more seamless way to make everyday payments. Beginning 21 July 2026, eligible Samsung Galaxy users will be able to access Maybank’s MAE Scan & Pay functionality directly within Samsung Wallet through the latest application and software updates. As Malaysia continues its transition towards a cashless economy, the partnership reflects both companies’ commitment to making digital payments simpler, more secure and convenient for customers across urban and suburban communities. With QR Payment integrated directly into Samsung Wallet, users can quickly access the feature with a swipe before using Maybank’s Scan & Pay via the MAE app to complete their transactions. The integrated experience is designed to reduce unnecessary steps when making payments, whether users are purchasing meals, groceries, coffee or other everyday essentials. The QR payment functionality can also be used regionally across Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia and Cambodia, providing greater convenience for Samsung Galaxy users when making payments beyond Malaysia. President of Samsung Malaysia Electronics, Charles Kim, said the partnership with Maybank represents an important step in expanding the Samsung Wallet ecosystem in Malaysia. He added that integrating QR payments directly into Samsung Wallet is intended to make everyday transactions more effortless, allowing users to swipe, scan and pay within seconds. Meanwhile, Mohd Amri Mohd Sofian, Head of Community Financial Services Malaysia at Maybank, said the collaboration supports the Bank’s ROAR30 ambitions by focusing on intuitive digital experiences and frictionless payment journeys. Integrating MAE Scan & Pay directly into Samsung Wallet, he said, provides customers with greater convenience while maintaining the security and reliability associated with Maybank’s digital banking services. Beyond convenience, users can also earn Samsung Reward Points with every eligible transaction. These points can subsequently be used to purchase Samsung products or redeem vouchers available through the Samsung Members application, adding further value to everyday payments. As part of the partnership, Samsung and Maybank are also offering exclusive rewards worth up to RM500,000 through a limited-time promotional campaign running from 28 July to 30 October 2026. Eligible customers will receive RM5 after successfully connecting and activating QR Payment on Samsung Wallet, with the opportunity to enjoy up to RM15 in cashback or vouchers when they make qualifying purchases. The launch represents another milestone in Samsung’s efforts to expand Samsung Wallet beyond its existing capabilities and strengthen its role as a comprehensive digital platform for Galaxy users. By bringing together Samsung’s mobile ecosystem and Maybank’s digital banking infrastructure, the partnership aims to provide millions of customers with a more connected, convenient and efficient payment experience.
