title: 'Ekonom Maybank Ungkap Penyebab Belanja APBN Belum Dorong Ekonomi
body: 'KONTAN.CO.ID - JAKARTA. Belanja pemerintah yang meningkat belum sepenuhnya memberikan dampak terhadap sektor riil dan pertumbuhan ekonomi Indonesia.  Kepala Ekonom Maybank Indonesia Juniman menilai keterbatasan keterlibatan sektor swasta menjadi salah satu faktor yang membuat efek pengganda belanja pemerintah belum maksimal.  Sampai Agustus 2026, belanja APBN tumbuh 17,1% secara tahunan (year on year/yoy), sedangkan pendapatan negara meningkat 25,4% yoy. Dengan perkembangan tersebut, APBN mencatat defisit Rp 240 triliun atau setara 0,93% terhadap produk domestik bruto (PDB).  Di sisi lain, keseimbangan primer masih mencatat surplus sebesar Rp 154 triliun.  "Keseimbangan primernya juga masih surplus, artinya pendapatan dikurangi belanja masih surplus," ujar Juniman kepada Kontan, Minggu (20/9/2026).  Meski kondisi fiskal hingga Agustus masih terjaga, Juniman mengingatkan tekanan terhadap defisit APBN akan meningkat mulai September. Hal ini sejalan dengan pola belanja pemerintah yang biasanya meningkat pada September hingga Desember.  Peningkatan belanja tersebut salah satunya berasal dari pembayaran subsidi energi dan nonenergi yang umumnya dilakukan setelah proses audit Badan Pengawasan Keuangan dan Pembangunan (BPKP).  "Makanya, pada Agustus pembayaran tersebut memang belum terlihat. Artinya, pembayaran subsidi masih belum seluruhnya dilakukan," katanya.  Namun, besarnya pertumbuhan belanja pemerintah belum otomatis menghasilkan multiplier effect yang signifikan terhadap perekonomian.  Menurut Juniman, aliran belanja pemerintah masih banyak mengarah ke sektor non-tradable. Sementara itu, sektor tradable seperti pertanian dan manufaktur belum memperoleh dorongan yang sebanding.  Sejumlah program pemerintah, seperti Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG), Koperasi Merah Putih, dan Sekolah Rakyat, juga dinilai lebih banyak memiliki karakter konsumtif.  Di sisi lain, hilirisasi yang menjadi salah satu agenda pemerintah cenderung bersifat capital intensive sehingga kemampuan menyerap tenaga kerja relatif terbatas. Kondisi serupa juga terjadi di sektor pertanian yang semakin banyak memanfaatkan mesin dan teknologi dalam proses produksi.  "Belanja pemerintah tumbuh 21,05% yoy di kuartal kedua, tapi ekonomi kita hanya tumbuh sekitar 5% yoy," ujar Juniman.  Peran Swasta Perlu Diperkuat  Juniman menilai keterbatasan dampak belanja pemerintah terhadap pertumbuhan ekonomi juga tidak terlepas dari masih kecilnya keterlibatan sektor swasta dalam berbagai program ekonomi pemerintah.  Kontribusi government spending disebut hanya sekitar 6% terhadap PDB. Sementara itu, konsumsi rumah tangga menyumbang hampir 54% terhadap PDB. Dengan struktur tersebut, penguatan daya beli masyarakat menjadi salah satu faktor penting untuk menopang pertumbuhan ekonomi.  "Jadi, walaupun belanja pemerintah ditingkatkan sampai berapa pun, kalau porsinya hanya sekitar 6% terhadap PDB, perannya tetap relatif kecil," katanya.  Karena itu, menurut Juniman, APBN perlu diarahkan untuk menciptakan insentif yang dapat menggerakkan sektor riil dan usaha masyarakat, khususnya kelompok kelas menengah.  Ia mengatakan masyarakat berpendapatan rendah relatif telah mendapatkan dukungan melalui berbagai program bantuan sosial, seperti Program Keluarga Harapan (PKH) dan bantuan lainnya. Sementara itu, kelas menengah masih membutuhkan stimulus untuk mempertahankan konsumsi.  Juniman juga menyoroti dominasi pemerintah dalam sejumlah program ekonomi, termasuk hilirisasi, MBG, dan Koperasi Merah Putih. Menurut dia, keterlibatan sektor swasta masih terbatas, sementara Danantara juga menaungi badan usaha milik negara (BUMN) yang terkait dengan pemerintah.  "Seharusnya pemerintah melibatkan swasta untuk menggerakkan mesin ekonomi," ujarnya.  Ia melihat pola tersebut memiliki kemiripan dengan periode pemerintahan sebelumnya, ketika sejumlah proyek besar banyak dikerjakan oleh BUMN. Saat ini, pola serupa dinilai terlihat dalam sejumlah program prioritas pemerintah, meskipun bentuk proyeknya berbeda.  Apabila sektor swasta tidak ikut bergerak, peningkatan pendapatan masyarakat akan lebih sulit terjadi. Kondisi tersebut berpotensi membuat konsumsi rumah tangga stagnan atau tumbuh lebih lambat.  Padahal, konsumsi rumah tangga memiliki kontribusi sekitar 54% terhadap PDB.  "Kalau konsumsi melambat, sementara daya beli hanya tumbuh 4%–5%, sulit bagi ekonomi kita untuk mencapai 6%," kata Juniman.  Sementara itu, kontribusi ekspor yang sekitar 20% dan investasi sekitar 20%–30% dinilai belum cukup untuk mengimbangi perlambatan konsumsi. Terlebih, kondisi ekonomi global masih menghadapi berbagai tantangan sehingga Indonesia tidak dapat sepenuhnya mengandalkan ekspor sebagai sumber pertumbuhan.  Defisit APBN 2026 Diproyeksi Mendekati 3%  Dari sisi fiskal, Juniman memperkirakan defisit APBN akan meningkat signifikan mulai September seiring dengan akselerasi belanja pemerintah.  "Defisit biasanya mendekati 1,9% atau 1,8%, kemudian langsung lompat dan mendekati 2%. Setelah itu, pada Oktober dan November akan terus meningkat sampai akhirnya mencapai level yang diinginkan pemerintah, yaitu 2,85%," jelasnya.  Juniman memperkirakan defisit APBN 2026 berada di kisaran 2,8% hingga 2,93% terhadap PDB. Proyeksi tersebut masih berada dalam kisaran pemerintah dengan asumsi dilakukan refocusing, efisiensi, dan efektivitas belanja, khususnya untuk program-program prioritas.  Menurut Juniman, sejumlah program seperti MBG, Koperasi Merah Putih, dan Sekolah Rakyat sulit untuk dihentikan. Oleh karena itu, pemerintah perlu mencari ruang efisiensi dari pos belanja lainnya, termasuk belanja kompensasi subsidi, terutama subsidi energi.  "Pemerintah mau tidak mau harus melakukan efisiensi karena belanja yang lain sudah dihabiskan dan sudah tidak bisa lagi ditekan," katanya.  Untuk pertumbuhan ekonomi, Juniman memperkirakan ekonomi Indonesia pada 2026 tumbuh sebesar 5,3%, atau di bawah target APBN sebesar 5,4%.  Ia juga memproyeksikan pertumbuhan ekonomi pada kuartal III 2026 melambat menjadi sekitar 5,2%. Sementara itu, pertumbuhan ekonomi pada kuartal IV 2026 diperkirakan berada di kisaran 5,2% hingga 5,25%.  Adapun target pertumbuhan ekonomi sebesar 6% pada tahun depan dinilai membutuhkan kontribusi yang lebih besar dari sektor swasta.  "Mesin pertumbuhan harus dikerahkan, terutama di sektor swasta. Tanpa peran swasta, sulit bagi ekonomi kita untuk tumbuh di atas 6%," pungkas Juniman.

title: 'Maybank, UPSI santuni komuniti menerusi pendidikan dan kreativiti
body: 'TANJONG MALIM – Hampir 200 warga Maybank dari seluruh Perak berganding bahu dengan Universiti Pendidikan Sultan Idris (UPSI) menjayakan program kesukarelawanan berteraskan pendidikan, kreativiti dan pemerkasaan komuniti menerusi Maybank Group Global Corporate Responsibility (CR) Day 2026.  Program yang berlangsung di Kampus Sultan Azlan Shah itu merupakan kerjasama pertama Maybank Group Global CR Day dengan UPSI menerusi Pusat Pembangunan Akademik dan SULAM@UPSI.  Timbalan Naib Canselor (Akademik dan Antarabangsa) UPSI, Prof Dr Raja Nor Safinaz Raja Harun berkata, program bertemakan “Impacting Society Positively, Enabling Well-Being for All” itu mencerminkan komitmen bersama sektor industri dan institusi pendidikan tinggi dalam menghasilkan impak positif kepada masyarakat.  “Pendekatan ini selari dengan aspirasi UPSI untuk menghubungkan ilmu, pendidikan dan kepakaran universiti dengan keperluan sebenar komuniti,” katanya.  Menurut beliau, dua modul SULAM@UPSI yang mempunyai elemen keusahawanan dan kelestarian serta menyasarkan golongan berkeperluan khas dipilih bagi program berkenaan.  Ia membabitkan SULAM Sen-Care daripada Fakulti Pembangunan Manusia (FPM) dan Creative Heritage For Good daripada Fakulti Seni, Kelestarian dan Industri Kreatif (FSKIK).  Raja Nor Safinaz berkata, UPSI berharap program itu menjadi pemangkin kepada kerjasama strategik lebih luas bersama Maybank, khususnya dalam pembangunan bakat, pendidikan, keusahawanan, inovasi, kesukarelawanan dan pemerkasaan komuniti.  “UPSI berharap penganjuran ini bukan sekadar program sehari, sebaliknya menjadi titik permulaan kepada lebih banyak kerjasama strategik pada masa hadapan,” katanya.  Sementara itu, Timbalan Pengarah Pusat Pembangunan Akademik UPSI, ChM Dr Yuhanis Mhd Bakri berkata, hampir 200 warga Maybank dari cawangan di Perak menyertai program berkenaan.  Menurutnya, Maybank Group Global CR Day merupakan inisiatif kesukarelawanan yang menghimpunkan warga institusi perbankan itu di pelbagai negara untuk melaksanakan aktiviti memberi manfaat kepada masyarakat dan alam sekitar.  Pengarah Wilayah Maybank Perak, Suresh Ramasamy pula berkata, kerjasama dengan UPSI membuka ruang kepada warga Maybank mendekati masyarakat melalui aktiviti kesukarelawanan yang lebih bermakna.  “Maybank Group Global CR Day bukan sekadar aktiviti kesukarelawanan, tetapi platform untuk warga Maybank menyumbangkan kemahiran, masa dan tenaga kepada masyarakat.  “Kerjasama dengan UPSI memberi nilai tambah apabila warga Maybank dapat berganding dengan mahasiswa dan warga universiti melaksanakan aktiviti kreatif, inklusif serta memberi manfaat kepada komuniti,” katanya.  Beliau berkata, program itu turut membolehkan warga Maybank, mahasiswa UPSI dan komuniti berkongsi pengalaman, kemahiran serta kepakaran menerusi aktiviti yang dirangka untuk menghasilkan manfaat secara langsung.  Katanya, kolaborasi tersebut memperlihatkan kekuatan hubungan universiti, industri dan komuniti apabila UPSI menyumbangkan ilmu serta bakat, industri membawa pengalaman dan sumber, manakala masyarakat mendapat manfaat daripada kerjasama berkenaan.  Keterangan gambar: Warga UPSI bersama kira-kira 180 kakitangan Maybank dari Perak menjayakan Maybank Group Global Corporate Responsibility (CR) Day 2026 di Kampus Sultan Azlan Shah, UPSI.

title: 'High-flying Miyu of Japan and Thai darling Jeeno Thitikul lead a world-class field of champions at the 2026 Maybank Championship
body: 'The Maybank Championship is set for another star-studded chapter when Asia’s premier ladies’ golf event returns to Kuala Lumpur Golf & Country Club (KLGCC) this October 29-November 1. With a US$3 million prize purse, the fourth edition brings together Major champions, LPGA Tour winners and Southeast Asia’s emerging talents for four days of world-class competition at KLGCC. The competition for the coveted Tiger Trophy has never been more intense. Defending champion and Major winner Miyu Yamashita of Japan is one of the season's most in-form players, highlighted by a dominant nine-stroke victory at the CPKC Women's Open in Canada in August and a playoff win at the Sony JLPGA Championship in Japan in September. Having claimed a dramatic three-way playoff victory at last year’s Maybank Championship, she will have every intention of becoming the tournament’s first repeat champion. Crowd favourite, Thai darling and World No. 2 Jeeno Thitikul of Thailand is also on a rich vein of form, having already claimed three LPGA Tour victories in 2026 to take her total title tally to ten. She returns for a fourth consecutive year in pursuit of the elusive Tiger Trophy, having narrowly missed out in each of her last appearances. Thitikul’s close friend Ruoning Yin of China, the 2024 Maybank Championship winner and a Major champion, will also return to Malaysia in winning mode having triumphed at the FM Championship in August. The spotlight will also firmly be turned on Korean ace Haeran Ryu, who is currently second on the LPGA Tour’s Race to CME Globe ranking on the back of successive Major victories in 2026 at the KPMG Women's PGA Championship and the Amundi Evian Championship. Adding her considerable star power to the field is the perennially popular New Zealander Lydia Ko, a three-time Major winner and reigning Olympic champion who was inducted into the LPGA Hall of Fame in 2024 at age 27. Australian stalwart Hannah Green and Hye-Jin Choi of South Korea, who were the two other protagonists in last year's playoff, will return with unfinished business on their agendas. 2023 Maybank Championship winner Céline Boutier of France, who edged Thitikul in a nail-biting nine-hole playoff at KLGCC three years ago, is also in the field. Other fan favourites who have signed up include emerging English sensation Lottie Woad and her experienced compatriot Charley Hull, and Japanese twins Aki and Chizzy Iwai. The identical twins have been in roaring form this season and will be among the frontrunners for the title. The Maybank Championship is more than Asia’s premier golf event. It provides a distinctive regional pathway for Southeast Asian talent to earn their place alongside the world’s best. This year, five players who earned their places through the Maybank Championship Asean Qualifier bring that story to life. Held in August at KLGCC’s West Course, the 36-hole qualifier concluded with Thai professional Pimnipa Panthong and her amateur compatriots Sarisa Pojanalai and Achiraya Sriwong locked together at four-under-par 140 (Sriwong turned professional recently). Standout Thai amateur Marisa Tojai, who had already claimed four amateur titles in 2026 before arriving at the qualifier, secured the fourth spot at two-under 142, while Malaysia’s Liyana Durisic rounded out the top five at one-under 143. For Malaysian fans, there will be plenty to roar about. Liyana Durisic is currently in great form, having already claimed four PGM Tour titles in 2026, and the Women’s World Sand Greens Championship held in Australia in March. She will be joined by a talented and recognisable group of Malaysian players entering as Sponsor’s Invitations, namely Mirabel Ting, Jeneath Wong, Natasha Oon and Kelly Tan, to make up a five-strong Malaysian challenge. 2025 Annika Award winner Mirabel Ting made headlines in 2024 by becoming the highest-finishing Malaysian in Maybank Championship history, with a T12 finish as an amateur. Her fine performances continued into her debut season on this year’s Epson Tour, helping her clinch two victories in 2026. The wins propelled Ting to the top of the Epson Tour’s Race for the Card standings and secured her place on the LPGA Tour for the 2027 season. Joining Ting is Malaysia’s highest-ranked amateur (currently ranked 59th), Jeneath Wong. After a stellar season in 2023 that saw her earn her a major championship start at the US Women's Open, Wong made history as the first Malaysian to win the Women's Amateur Asia-Pacific Championship in 2025, a victory which earned her further major championship starts, bringing an increasingly impressive international résumé to KLGCC. One-time Epson Tour winner and 2023 Epson Tour Rookie of the Year Natasha Oon makes her first appearance at the Maybank Championship since 2023, seeking to capitalise on her encouraging performance at the recent CPKC Women’s Open. The LPGA Tour rookie is rebuilding her momentum following a lengthy injury that saw her miss most of the 2024 and 2025 seasons. Completing the Malaysian line-up is two-time Olympian Kelly Tan, Malaysia's most successful LPGA Tour player. Tan recorded her career-best results on the LPGA Tour with runner-up finishes at the Dow Great Lakes Bay Invitational in 2022 and 2023, and returns to KLGCC for the third time, bringing over a decade of elite professional experience on the West Course.

title: 'Maybank Supports Digital Learning At SMK Santubong | Sarawak Tribune
body: 'KUCHING: SMK Santubong received four Smart TVs from Maybank Sarawak to support digital learning and enhance teaching and learning at the school. The contribution was made in conjunction with Maybank Group’s 14th Global Corporate Responsibility (CR) Day 2026 and Cahaya Kasih Challenge 2026-2027 programme held at the school today. Santubong Member of Parliament, Datuk Seri Nancy Shukri, said the initiative was in line with the changing needs of education, particularly as technology continued to play a greater role in learning. She said such support was especially important for schools located away from urban centres, where students could benefit from greater access to digital learning facilities. “This event is to ensure that students are able to gain the knowledge they need through education. Especially for schools far from the city, they really need education like this,” she said. Nancy emphasised that education remained a key priority as it could open pathways to employment, improve incomes, and help families build better lives. “Do not let your place of residence or family backgrounds become a barrier. I believe that with knowledge and continuous effort, all of you can achieve the aspirations you dream of,” she said. Nancy said the collaboration between Maybank and the Santubong parliamentary constituency was not new, with the bank having previously supported Pusat Aktiviti Kanak-Kanak (PAKK) Bandar Baru Samariang in 2024 and 2025. Maybank Sarawak’s Regional Director, Abang Jamili Abang Julai, said the initiative reflected the bank’s role in contributing to the community through education and knowledge-sharing. “This is our opportunity in the banking sector to contribute to the children in school. We hope to share our knowledge in financial literacy, business planning and digital technology to help the community,” he said. More than 60 Maybank employees from its regional office, branches and centres in Sarawak took part in the programme, which also featured sharing sessions on financial literacy and scam awareness. The initiative, guided by the theme ‘Impacting Society Positively: Enabling Well-being For All’, focuses on education, community empowerment and environmental sustainability.

title: 'Sabah Energy Issues Inaugural RM350 Million Sukuk With Maybank Investment
body: 'Sabah Energy Corporation Sdn Bhd (SEC) has completed its maiden RM350 million sukuk issuance under a RM3 billion Sukuk Wakalah Programme, marking its first entry into Malaysia’s sukuk capital market.  The Sabah state-owned integrated energy company said the sukuk was assigned a long-term AAA rating with a stable outlook by RAM Rating Services Bhd. The issuance was priced through a book-building exercise, the first for a Sabah state government-linked company, and was oversubscribed by 2.2 times despite volatile market conditions.  Maybank Investment Bank Bhd acted as sole principal advisor, sole lead arranger, sole lead manager, sole sustainability structuring adviser, Shariah advisor and facility agent for the transaction.  SEC Group Chief Executive Officer Datuk Ir Adzmir Abd Rahman said the programme gives the company a scalable and flexible funding platform to support its PETA 2030 agenda.  He said the funding would support efforts to strengthen SEC’s gas and infrastructure businesses, expand power generation and renewable energy, and pursue investments across Sabah’s energy value chain.  The programme also supports the broader SERAMP 2040 objectives of strengthening energy security, accelerating the energy transition and improving supply reliability in Sabah.  SEC has evolved from a gas utility operator into a diversified energy group with interests in natural gas infrastructure, power generation, renewable energy and offshore oil and gas support services. It is also Sabah’s sole natural gas aggregator, transporter and distributor.

title: 'Maybank, ABS jalin kerjasama tingkat piawaian penasihat kekayaan
body: 'PETALING JAYA: Malayan Banking Berhad (Maybank) dan Asian Banking School (ABS) menandatangani Memorandum Persefahaman (MoU) bagi membangunkan kerangka pensijilan profesional penasihat kekayaan pertama yang diiktiraf industri di Malaysia. Kerangka kerja yang dikenali sebagai Program Pensijilan Pengurusan dan Penasihat Kekayaan ABS itu bertujuan menetapkan standard kompetensi khusus bagi profesional penasihat kekayaan dalam sektor perbankan. Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Kumpulan Perkhidmatan Kewangan Komuniti Maybank, Syed Ahmad Taufik Albar berkata, kerjasama itu membolehkan Maybank menyumbang pengalaman melangkaui organisasi bagi meningkatkan standard profesional di Malaysia. “Maybank terus melabur dalam membangunkan profesional kekayaan kami menerusi Maybank Wealth Academy bagi membina keupayaan penasihatan holistik yang memenuhi keperluan kewangan pelanggan. “Peluang ini turut membuka ruang untuk memeluaskan elemen program berkenaan ke peringkat serantau dari semasa ke semasa,” katanya dalam kenyataan. Sementara itu, Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif ABS, Profesor Dr. Manivanan Saman berkata, gabungan kepakaran ABS dan pengalaman praktikal Maybank bertujuan mewujudkan laluan kredibel yang memberikan penanda aras lebih jelas kepada profesional kekayaan. “Maybank bertindak sebagai Rakan Industri Pengasas dengan menyumbang kepakaran dan pengalaman dalam pembangunan bakat, manakala ABS membawa kepakaran dalam pembangunan dan pensijilan perbankan profesional,” katanya. Pengambilan pertama bagi program berkenaan dijangka bermula pada separuh kedua tahun 2027, dengan Maybank berhasrat mengintegrasikannya ke dalam Maybank Wealth Academy. Langkah berkenaan memperkukuh francais pengurusan kekayaan Maybank yang baru-baru ini dinamakan sebagai Bank Swasta Terbaik Malaysia 2026 oleh Euromoney serta Bank Pengurusan Kekayaan Terbaik di Malaysia oleh Alpha Southeast Asia bagi tahun ke-10 berturut-turut. –UTUSAN

title: 'Maybank sumbang empat Smart TV kepada SMK Santubong
body: 'SANTUBONG: Maybank Wilayah Sarawak menyumbangkan empat unit televisyen pintar (Smart TV) kepada Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan (SMK) Santubong bagi menyokong transformasi pendidikan digital di sekolah berkenaan.  Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat, Dato Sri Nancy Shukri berkata, kemudahan itu dijangka menjadikan suasana pembelajaran lebih interaktif, menarik dan selaras dengan perkembangan teknologi pendidikan masa kini.  “Dengan adanya Smart TV ini, suasana pembelajaran akan lebih interaktif, menarik dan selaras dengan perkembangan teknologi pendidikan masa kini.  “Kita tidak mahu anak-anak belajar di kampung ketinggalan. Jadi ini adalah kelebihan kerjasama dengan pelbagai pihak,” katanya ketika berucap pada Program Maybank Global CR Day 2026 dan Program Cabaran Cahaya Kasih 2026–2027 di SMK Santubong, di sini, hari ini.  Menurut Nancy yang juga Ahli Parlimen P193 Santubong, kerjasama antara Maybank dan Parlimen Santubong bukan perkara baharu apabila bantuan turut disalurkan kepada Pusat Aktiviti Kanak-Kanak (PAKK) Bandar Baru Semariang pada 2024 dan 2025 bagi menambah baik kemudahan serta keselesaan pembelajaran.  Katanya, setiap penerima manfaat akan dibimbing dan diberikan sokongan secara berterusan bagi memastikan manfaat yang diberikan lebih menyeluruh dan berkekalan.  “Jadi, ini adalah kesinambungan kerjasama dengan pihak Maybank. SMK Santubong dan PAKK Bandar Baru Semariang adalah antara yang terbaik di Sarawak ini,” katanya.  Dalam pada itu, Nancy berkata pendidikan sentiasa menjadi keutamaan sebagai Ahli Parlimen Santubong kerana mahu melihat anak-anak mendapat peluang dan akses pendidikan yang lebih baik.  Katanya, pendidikan membuka peluang kepada pekerjaan, meningkatkan pendapatan dan membantu sesebuah keluarga membina kehidupan yang lebih baik.  “Gunakanlah kesemua kemudahan dan peluang yang dicipta ini dengan sebaik mungkin. Jadikanlah pendidikan sebagai jalan untuk mengubah kehidupan diri dan keluarga.  “Janganlah dijadikan tempat tinggal atau latar belakang keluarga sebagai penghalang. Saya yakin ilmu dan usaha yang berterusan mampu membantu anak-anak mencapai cita-cita yang diimpikan,” katanya.  Nancy turut menggesa ibu bapa supaya memberikan sokongan kepada anak-anak untuk meneruskan persekolahan, termasuk pelajar dari kawasan pesisir yang membantu keluarga dalam pekerjaan seperti perikanan.  “Kalau kita belajar lebih baik, mempunyai cita-cita yang tinggi, maka insya-Allah nak jadi nelayan pun boleh, tetapi nelayan yang moden dan berjaya,” katanya.  Beliau turut berkongsi pengalaman berjalan kaki sejauh tiga hingga empat kilometer ke sekolah rendah ketika zaman persekolahan sebagai antara pendorong untuk terus belajar sehingga ke universiti.  Dalam pada itu, beliau merakamkan penghargaan kepada Maybank Wilayah Sarawak serta semua pihak yang menyumbang bakti, kewangan dan kepakaran dalam menjayakan program berkenaan.  Nancy turut mengucapkan Selamat Menyambut Hari Malaysia kepada semua yang hadir.

title: 'Sabah Energy Corp raises RM350 mil in maiden sukuk, Maybank IB appointed as adviser
body:
'

KUALA LUMPUR (Sept 17): Sabah Energy Corporation Sdn Bhd (SEC) has raised RM350 million through its maiden sukuk issuance under a RM3 billion sukuk wakalah programme.

The issuance was announced in a joint statement with Malayan Banking Bhd (KL:MAYBANK). 

The sukuk was rated AAA with a stable outlook by RAM Rating Services Bhd and was priced through book-building, with demand reaching 2.2 times the amount offered.

Maybank Investment Bank Bhd was appointed as the sole principal adviser, lead arranger, lead manager and sustainability structure adviser, as well as shariah adviser and facility agent. 

“This landmark issuance broadens and diversifies SEC's access to long-term ringgit funding while raising the profile of both SEC and Sabah among domestic and international institutional investors. The strong over-subscription reflects investors' confidence in SEC's credit strength and growth trajectory," said Maybank IB chief executive officer Michael Oh-Lau.

Maybank said the issuance gives the Sabah state-owned energy company a longer-term funding source as it plans investments across its energy businesses, including natural gas infrastructure, power generation and renewable energy.

SEC said the funding platform will support its strategic roadmap called PETA (Pelan Strategik dan Hala Tuju) 2030, which covers the expansion of its gas and infrastructure operations, power generation and renewable energy activities, as well as investments across Sabah's energy value chain.

“In turn, this supports the broader outcomes envisaged under SERAMP 2040: stronger energy security, a faster energy transition and more reliable supply for Sabah," said SEC group chief executive officer Datuk Adzmir Abd Rahman. 

SEC has been Sabah's sole natural gas aggregator, transporter and distributor since its corporatisation in 1997. 

It has since expanded into power generation, renewable energy and offshore oil and gas support services.

title: 'Maybank perkukuh pendidikan digital di SMK Santubong
body: 'KUCHING, 17 Sept: Keperluan pembelajaran yang seiring dengan perkembangan teknologi mendorong Maybank Wilayah Sarawak memperkasa kemudahan digital di Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan (SMK) Santubong menerusi sumbangan empat unit televisyen (TV) pintar.  Pengarah Wilayah Maybank Sarawak, Abang Jamili Abang Julai berkata, sumbangan itu merupakan sebahagian daripada inisiatif Program Cahaya Kasih Maybank yang dilaksanakan bagi tempoh dua tahun khususnya bagi membantu sekolah menangani kekangan kemudahan teknologi dan komunikasi.  Menurutnya, perubahan dalam sistem pendidikan dan perkembangan teknologi memerlukan semua pihak menyesuaikan diri dengan keadaan semasa bagi memastikan pelajar mendapat pengalaman pembelajaran yang bersesuaian dengan keperluan masa kini.  “Kita akan berusaha untuk bersama membantu anak-anak, lebih-lebih lagi tentang pembelajaran ataupun pendidikan.  “Zaman dah berubah, zaman bukan seperti zaman saya sekolah dulu ataupun zaman Yang Berhormat (Datuk Seri Nancy Shukri) pergi sekolah dulu. Jadi kita kena menyesuaikan diri dalam keadaan semasa,” katanya.  Beliau berkata demikian ketika berucap pada program Maybank Global Corporate Responsibility (CR) Day 2026 dan Program Cahaya Kasih Challenge 2026-2027 di SMK Santubong, hari ini.  Abang Jamili menjelaskan, penyediaan kemudahan digital itu diharap dapat meningkatkan pengalaman pembelajaran pelajar, selain memberi peluang kepada mereka memanfaatkan teknologi dalam proses pendidikan.  Menurutnya, transformasi digital merupakan satu keperluan yang tidak dapat dielakkan memandangkan ekonomi dan kehidupan masyarakat kini semakin bergantung kepada teknologi.  Tambahnya, sumbangan empat unit TV pintar itu turut mencerminkan komitmen Maybank untuk memberikan impak positif kepada masyarakat melalui inisiatif tanggungjawab korporat.  “Program Cahaya Kasih bukan sekadar program kesukarelawanan, malah melibatkan perkongsian masa, tenaga dan kepakaran warga Maybank bagi membantu memenuhi keperluan sebenar komuniti,” ujarnya.  Antara perkongsian yang diberikan kepada warga sekolah termasuk pengetahuan berkaitan teknologi serta platform digital Maybank yang dapat memberi pendedahan kepada pelajar mengenai perkembangan dunia digital.  Dalam pada itu, Abang Jamili berharap lebih banyak pihak korporat tampil membantu sekolah berkenaan dalam memperkukuh kemudahan pendidikan dan teknologi.  “Saya harap ada juga pihak-pihak korporat yang lain mungkin sama-sama membantu sekolah ini juga,” jelasnya.  Beliau berkata, usaha itu selari dengan komitmen Maybank untuk memberikan impak positif kepada masyarakat menerusi pelbagai inisiatif di bawah strategi Road to POTI sehingga 2030.  Menurutnya, sebanyak 93 inisiatif dilaksanakan Maybank tahun ini bagi menyokong agenda berkenaan, dengan tumpuan antaranya kepada pemerkasaan komuniti, kesukarelawanan dan kelestarian.  Abang Jamili berkata, Maybank turut menyasarkan 150,000 jam kerja sukarelawan tahun ini di seluruh kumpulan, dengan pendekatan lebih besar kepada kesukarelawanan berasaskan kemahiran.-TVS

title: 'Stock Today: Maybank Dips 0.2% Despite New Wealth Advisory Initiative
body: 'Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) shares fell 0.19% to RM10.40 as of 12.35 pm, after the bank and Asian Banking School (ABS) signed an agreement to explore a professional certification framework for wealth advisory in Malaysia.  The stock opened at RM10.44 and moved between an intraday high of RM10.48 and a low of RM10.38. Some 4.77 million shares changed hands.  Maybank had closed at RM10.42 in the previous trading session, putting the latest price two sen lower.  The proposed ABS Wealth Advisory & Management Certification Programme is intended to establish an industry-recognised benchmark for wealth advisory professionals in banking. Maybank will serve as the founding industry partner while ABS will oversee the standards, assessment and certification process.  Maybank plans to incorporate the programme into its Maybank Wealth Academy, linking the certification with structured learning and workplace development. title: 'Maybank, Asian Banking School Explore Certification Programme For Wealth Advisory
body: 'Maybank and the Asian Banking School (ABS) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to explore the development of a professional certification framework for wealth advisory in Malaysia, aimed at introducing an industry-recognised benchmark for advisory capability.  The proposed certification framework, to be known as the ABS Wealth Advisory & Management Certification Programme, is intended to establish competency standards specifically for wealth advisory professionals in banking. Upon its launch, it will be Malaysia’s first industry-wide professional certification framework dedicated to wealth advisory.  The parties noted that as wealth management needs grow more complex, clients increasingly require advice that connects different aspects of their financial lives. This initiative they added aims to establish a consistent benchmark for the advisory capabilities required to serve clients holistically.  Maybank will serve as the Founding Industry Partner, contributing insights and its experience in developing wealth talent, while ABS will bring its expertise in professional banking development and certification. ABS will retain independence over the standards and how they are assessed and certified.  “This collaboration with the Asian Banking School allows us to contribute that experience beyond our organisation, to raise professional standards for wealth advisory in Malaysia, with the opportunity to extend elements of the programme across the region over time,” said Syed Ahmad Taufik Albar, Group CEO, Community Financial Services, Maybank.  The programme’s first intake is expected in the second half of 2027, and Maybank intends to incorporate the programme into Maybank Wealth Academy, connecting it with structured learning and career development through practical workplace application. The parties will also explore opportunities to extend relevant certification pathways to wealth professionals across the region.

title: 'World-Class Field Set to Illuminate Maybank Championship 2026 | Sports247
body: 'The Tiger Trophy is up for grabs: defending champion Miyu Yamashita, World No. 2 Jeeno Thitikul and a world-class field of Major champions and LPGA Tour winners set the stage for four days of high-stakes competition at KLGCC. Five ASEAN Qualifiers and four Malaysian Sponsor’s Invitations bring regional talents to one of Asia’s biggest stages. The Maybank Championship is set for another star-studded chapter when Asia’s premier ladies’ golf event returns to Kuala Lumpur Golf & Country Club (KLGCC) this October 29-November 1. With a USD3 million prize purse, the fourth edition brings together Major champions, LPGA Tour winners and Southeast Asia’s emerging talents for four days of world-class competition at KLGCC. A World-Class Line-Up The competition for the coveted Tiger Trophy has never been more intense. Defending champion and Major winner Miyu Yamashita of Japan is one of the most in-form players this season, highlighted by a dominant nine-stroke victory at the CPKC Women’s Open in Canada in August, and a playoff win at the Sony JLPGA Championship in Japan in September. Having claimed a dramatic three-way playoff victory at last year’s Maybank Championship, she will have every intention of becoming the tournament’s first repeat champion. Crowd favourite and World No. 2 Jeeno Thitikul of Thailand is also on a rich vein of form, having already claimed three LPGA Tour victories in 2026 to take her total title tally to ten. She returns for a fourth consecutive year in pursuit of the elusive Tiger Trophy, having narrowly missed out in each of her last appearances. Thitikul’s close friend Ruoning Yin of China, the 2024 Maybank Championship winner and a Major champion, will also return to Malaysia in winning mode having triumphed at the FM Championship in August. The spotlight will also firmly be turned on Korean ace Haeran Ryu, who is currently second on the LPGA Tour’s Race to CME Globe ranking on the back of successive Major victories in 2026 at the KPMG Women’s PGA Championship and the Amundi Evian Championship. Adding her considerable star power to the field is the perennially popular New Zealander Lydia Ko, a three-time Major winner and reigning Olympic champion who was inducted into the LPGA Hall of Fame in 2024 at age 27. Australian stalwart Hannah Green and Hye-Jin Choi of South Korea, who were the two other protagonists in last year’s playoff, will return with unfinished business on their agendas. 2023 Maybank Championship winner Céline Boutier of France, who edged Thitikul in a nail-biting nine-hole playoff at KLGCC three years ago, is also in the field. Other fan favourites who have signed up include emerging English sensation Lottie Woad and her experienced compatriot Charley Hull, and Japanese twins Aki and Chizzy Iwai. Regional Roar from ASEAN Qualifiers The Maybank Championship is more than Asia’s premier golf event. It provides a distinctive regional pathway for Southeast Asian talent to earn their place alongside the world’s best. This year, five players who earned their places through the Maybank Championship ASEAN Qualifier bring that story to life. Held in August at KLGCC’s West Course, the 36-hole qualifier concluded with Thai professional Pimnipa Panthong and her amateur compatriots Sarisa Pojanalai and Achiraya Sriwong locked together at four-under-par 140 (Sriwong turned professional recently). Standout Thai amateur Marisa Tojai, who had already claimed four amateur titles in 2026 before arriving at the qualifier, secured the fourth spot at two-under 142, while Malaysia’s Liyana Durisic rounded out the top five at one-under 143. Through this performance-based pathway, each of these five players earned the right to play alongside the world’s best in a full-fledged LPGA Tour event, which is the primary objective of the Maybank Championship ASEAN Qualifier. The Malaysian Challenge For Malaysian fans, there will be plenty to roar about. Liyana Durisic is currently in great form, having already claimed four PGM Tour titles in 2026, and the Women’s World Sand Greens Championship held in Australia in March. She will be joined by a talented and recognizable group of Malaysian players entering as Sponsor’s Invitations, namely Mirabel Ting, Jeneath Wong, Natasha Oon and Kelly Tan, to make up a five-strong Malaysian challenge. 2025 Annika Award winner Mirabel Ting made headlines in 2024 by becoming the highest-finishing Malaysian in Maybank Championship history, with a T12 finish as an amateur. Her fine performances continued into her debut season on this year’s Epson Tour, helping her clinch two victories in 2026. The wins propelled Ting to the top of the Epson Tour’s Race for the Card standings and secured her place on the LPGA Tour for the 2027 season. Joining Ting is Malaysia’s highest-ranked amateur (currently ranked 59th), Jeneath Wong. After a stellar season in 2023 that saw her earn her a major championship start at the U.S. Women’s Open, Wong made history as the first Malaysian to win the Women’s Amateur Asia-Pacific Championship in 2025, a victory which earned her further major championship starts, bringing an increasingly impressive international résumé to KLGCC. One-time Epson Tour winner and 2023 Epson Tour Rookie of the Year Natasha Oon makes her first appearance at the Maybank Championship since 2023, seeking to capitalize on her encouraging performance at the recent CPKC Women’s Open. The LPGA Tour rookie is rebuilding her momentum following a lengthy injury that saw her miss most of the 2024 and 2025 seasons. Completing the Malaysian line-up is two-time Olympian Kelly Tan, Malaysia’s most successful LPGA Tour player. Tan recorded her career-best results on the LPGA Tour with runner-up finishes at the Dow Great Lakes Bay Invitational in 2022 and 2023, and returns to KLGCC for the third time, bringing over a decade of elite professional experience and an intimate knowledge of the West Course. The Maybank Championship reflects Maybank’s belief in Harnessing Collective Power, bringing together world-class players, emerging ASEAN talent, partners and fans to elevate the game and create opportunity across the region. Be part of the action as the world’s best golfers descend on KLGCC from 29 October to 1 November. Tickets for the Maybank Championship 2026 are on sale now at www.maybank.com/golf.

title: 'Maybank, Asian Banking School Collaborate to Raise Wealth Advisory Standards in Malaysia | Maybank
body: 'Maybank to serve as Founding Industry Partner in developing an industry-recognised certification for wealth advisory professionals Maybank and the Asian Banking School (ABS) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to explore the development of a professional certification framework for wealth advisory in Malaysia, aimed at introducing an industry-recognised benchmark for advisory capability. The proposed certification framework, to be known as the ABS Wealth Advisory & Management Certification Programme, is intended to establish competency standards specifically for wealth advisory professionals in banking. Upon its launch, it will be Malaysia’s first industry-wide professional certification framework dedicated to wealth advisory. As wealth management needs grow more complex, clients increasingly require advice that connects different aspects of their financial lives. This initiative therefore aims to establish a consistent benchmark for the advisory capabilities required to serve clients holistically. Maybank will serve as the Founding Industry Partner, contributing insights and its experience in developing wealth talent, while ABS will bring its expertise in professional banking development and certification. ABS will retain independence over the standards and how they are assessed and certified. “Maybank has continuously invested in developing our wealth professionals through Maybank Wealth Academy, building advisory capabilities that complement technical expertise and enable a holistic approach that meets the financial needs of clients. This collaboration with the Asian Banking School allows us to contribute that experience beyond our organisation, to raise professional standards for wealth advisory in Malaysia, with the opportunity to extend elements of the programme across the region over time,” said Syed Ahmad Taufik Albar, Group CEO, Community Financial Services, Maybank. “Malaysia has an opportunity to further develop wealth advisory as a profession through independent and industry-relevant standards. By combining ABS’s expertise in professional banking development with Maybank’s practitioner experience as Founding Industry Partner, we aim to create a credible pathway that gives wealth professionals a clearer benchmark as they progress in their careers while raising the quality of wealth advisory across Malaysia,” said Professor Dr. Manivanan Saman, Chief Executive Officer, Asian Banking School. (L-R) Prof. Dr. Manivanan Saman, CEO of Asian Banking School & Syed Ahmad Taufik Albar, Group CEO, Community Financial Services, Maybank The programme’s first intake is expected in the second half of 2027, and Maybank intends to incorporate the programme into Maybank Wealth Academy, connecting it with structured learning and career development through practical workplace application. The parties will also explore opportunities to extend relevant certification pathways to wealth professionals across the region. This initiative builds on the Bank’s established wealth management franchise, which was named Malaysia’s Best Private Bank 2026 by Euromoney, and recognised as the Best Wealth Management Bank in Malaysia by Alpha Southeast Asia for the 10th consecutive year.

title: 'Star-studded field set for Maybank Championship 2026 – ParGolf
body: 'Defending champion Miyuu Yamashita, World No. 2 Jeeno Thitikul and former winner Ruoning Yin will headline a strong international field at the Maybank Championship 2026. The fourth edition of the LPGA Tour event will be held at Kuala Lumpur Golf & Country Club (KLGCC) from 29 October to 1 November, with players competing for the Tiger Trophy and a US$3 million prize purse. Yamashita will return to Malaysia seeking to become the tournament’s first back-to-back champion. The Japanese Major winner claimed last year’s title following a three-way playoff and has continued her strong form this season. She recorded a dominant nine-stroke victory at the CPKC Women’s Open in Canada in August before winning the Sony JLPGA Championship in a playoff in September. Thailand’s Thitikul will make her fourth consecutive appearance at the tournament after narrowly missing out on the title in previous editions. She has won three LPGA Tour events in 2026, taking her career total to 10. China’s Yin, the 2024 Maybank Championship winner, also returns after capturing the FM Championship in August. Another leading contender is South Korea’s Haeran Ryu, who is second in the LPGA Tour’s Race to the CME Globe standings after winning consecutive Majors at the KPMG Women’s PGA Championship and Amundi Evian Championship. Three-time Major winner Lydia Ko will add further strength to the field. The New Zealander, who is also the reigning Olympic champion, was inducted into the LPGA Hall of Fame in 2024 at the age of 27. Australians Hannah Green and South Korea’s Hye-Jin Choi, who joined Yamashita in last year’s playoff, will return for another opportunity to claim the title. The field also includes 2023 champion Céline Boutier of France, who defeated Thitikul in a nine-hole playoff during the inaugural edition of the tournament. England’s Lottie Woad and Charley Hull, together with Japanese twins Akie and Chisato Iwai, are among the other leading international players confirmed for the championship. Five Malaysians in the field Malaysia will be represented by Liyana Durisic, Mirabel Ting, Jeneath Wong, Natasha Oon and Kelly Tan. Durisic secured her place through the Maybank Championship ASEAN Qualifier, held over 36 holes at KLGCC’s West Course in August. She claimed the fifth qualifying spot after finishing at one-under-par 143. She enters the championship in strong form after winning four PGM Tour titles in 2026, as well as the Women’s World Sand Greens Championship in Australia in March. Ting, Wong, Oon and Tan will compete through sponsor invitations. Ting secured two Epson Tour victories during her first full season as a professional, moved to the top of the Race for the Card standings, and earned her LPGA Tour card for 2027. The 2025 Annika Award winner also holds the record for the best finish by a Malaysian at the Maybank Championship after placing tied for 12th as an amateur in 2024. Wong, Malaysia’s highest-ranked female amateur at World No. 59, will return with an increasingly strong international résumé. She became the first Malaysian to win the Women’s Amateur Asia-Pacific Championship in 2025, earning starts in several Major championships. She had previously qualified for the 2023 U.S. Women’s Open. Oon will make her first Maybank Championship appearance since 2023. The former Epson Tour winner and 2023 Epson Tour Rookie of the Year is rebuilding her momentum after an injury kept her out for much of the 2024 and 2025 seasons. Completing the Malaysian line-up is two-time Olympian Tan, the country’s most successful LPGA Tour player. Tan recorded her best LPGA Tour results with runner-up finishes at the Dow Great Lakes Bay Invitational in 2022 and 2023. She will make her third appearance at the Maybank Championship, bringing more than a decade of professional experience and extensive knowledge of KLGCC’s West Course. title: 'Maybank IB upgrades SD Guthrie to ‘buy’ post sell-off, cites market overreaction to PNB's exchangeable sukuk
body:
'

KUALA LUMPUR (Sept 15): Shares of SD Guthrie Bhd (KL:SDG) have been upgraded to "buy" from "hold" in the near term by Maybank Investment Bank after an "unwarranted" sell-off following Permodalan Nasional Bhd’s (PNB) latest exchangeable sukuk issuance. 

The research house said despite recent share price weakness, the plantation group's fundamentals remain intact. 

It added that the selldown was largely driven by market overreaction to PNB’s US$300 million (RM1.22 billion) exchangeable sukuk (ES), which has no earnings per share (EPS) impact on SD Guthrie.

SD Guthrie shares increased from RM6.14 on Sept 9, the day PNB announced the exchangeable sukuk, to RM6.34 at time of writing on Tuesday. The latest price values the group at RM43.85 billion.

"With the ES issued last week, we believe concerns over ES potential overhang are over and largely misunderstood," Maybank IB said in a note on Tuesday.

Because the sukuk was issued by PNB rather than SD Guthrie, there will be no new share issuance if investors exercise their options. 

Furthermore, there must be a significant price appreciation before conversion rights can be exercised.

Maybank IB estimates SD Guthrie's share price would need to hit at least RM8.66, which is well above current trading levels, before sukuk investors can exchange them for the stock.

"We believe the recent selldown has been unwarranted as nothing has fundamentally changed the past month except for an US$300 million exchangeable sukuk (ES) issued by PNB," Maybank IB added.

The stock upgrade comes as Maybank IB projects SD Guthrie's core net profit to be RM2.9 billion for the financial year ending Dec 31, 2026 (FY2026), which is 5% above the broader market consensus of RM2.76 billion. 

However, long-term consensus expectations lean higher than the research house's forecasts.

According to Bloomberg data, the broader market sentiment on SD Guthrie remains positive, with 14 out of 18 research houses rating the stock as a "buy", two recommending "hold" and two "outperform" calls. 

The Bloomberg consensus 12-month target price stands at RM7.65, a potential upside of 20.9% from current trading levels.

Maybank IB said SD Guthrie's growth would be centred on new business verticals, including industrial park joint developments spanning over 20,000 acres to sustain RM500 million to RM700 million annual income, alongside its goal of developing one gigawatt in large-scale solar projects.

Maybank IB maintained its target price of RM7.10 based on 0.55 times revised net asset value (RNAV).

An interim dividend per share of 11.18 sen declared in its 1HFY2026 results will go ex-date on Oct 20.

title: 'Maybank Islamic agih wakalah zakat RM869,806 bantu asnaf di Kedah
body: 'Kuala Lumpur: Lembaga Zakat Negeri Kedah (LZNK) menerima suntikan Wakalah Agihan Zakat bernilai RM869,806.58 daripada Maybank Islamic Berhad bagi menyokong pelaksanaan empat inisiatif utama pembangunan ekonomi dan kebajikan golongan asnaf di negeri Kedah. Peruntukan strategik itu merangkumi penyediaan modal perniagaan, latihan kemahiran teknologi pembuatan, pengurusan pusat agihan makanan, serta pembekalan mesin jahitan untuk menjana pendapatan keluarga fakir dan miskin. Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Maybank Islamic Berhad, Mohamad Yasin Abdullah berkata, komitmen bank itu terhadap golongan memerlukan tidak terhad kepada bantuan kewangan semata-mata, malah memberi fokus mendalam kepada pembinaan keupayaan, peluang serta pendedahan yang mampu membantu golongan asnaf mengubah taraf kehidupan mereka. "Sebagai badan korporat dan institusi perbankan Islam, Maybank Islamic komited dalam usaha kami untuk memajukan dan membantu golongan asnaf dengan memberi peluang dan pendedahan kepada mereka mengenai mekanisme terbaik untuk mengubah kehidupan mereka. "Bagi mencapai matlamat ini, kami telah merangka pelbagai program tanggungjawab sosial korporat, terutamanya dalam menyantuni golongan yang memerlukan di seluruh cawangan Kumpulan Maybank dan bekerjasama erat dengan Majlis Agama Negeri dan badan-badan zakat di seluruh Malaysia, termasuk LZNK," katanya dalam kenyataan. Sementara itu, Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif LZNK, Datuk Syeikh Zakaria Othman berkata, model wakalah zakat berupaya bertindak sebagai intervensi pembangunan tersusun yang menghubungkan latihan kemahiran, peluang kerjaya, serta bantuan asas. "Dana berkenaan bukan sekadar bantuan jangka pendek, sebaliknya bertujuan mewujudkan ekosistem pendapatan yang lebih stabil kepada penerima manfaat menerusi pendekatan berfokus dan berimpak tinggi," katanya. Daripada keseluruhan peruntukan, komponen terbesar iaitu RM484,880 disalurkan bagi menyokong Program Latihan Kemahiran Teknologi Pembuatan di KHTP Techno Centre yang berlangsung selama tiga bulan bermula April hingga Julai lalu. Program latihan intensif itu berjaya melatih seramai 40 peserta asnaf fakir dan miskin, di mana 92.5 peratus atau 37 daripadanya terus memperoleh pekerjaan tetap di pelbagai syarikat korporat dan agensi perindustrian sebaik tamat kursus. Selain itu, sebanyak RM150,000 turut diperuntukkan sebagai modal permulaan perniagaan kepada tiga peserta Bengkel Jahitan LZNK di Kota Setar, dengan setiap seorang menerima RM50,000 bagi pembiayaan peralatan dan operasi, di samping tawaran melanjutkan pengajian ke peringkat diploma di IKM Alor Setar. Bagi aspek kebajikan asas, Maybank Islamic membiayai RM200,696.58 untuk Program Pusat Agihan Makanan menerusi 16 masjid terpilih di daerah Kuala Muda, yang menyaksikan agihan 3,840 kit makanan sepanjang tempoh enam bulan. Bagi menggalakkan aktiviti keusahawanan dari rumah, peruntukan RM34,230 pula diagihkan menerusi penyediaan mesin jahitan kepada 13 peserta daripada empat Bengkel Jahitan LZNK bagi membolehkan mereka mengambil tempahan sampingan dari rumah.

title: 'Jual saham SD Guthrie susulan penerbitan sukuk PNB tidak wajar – Maybank IB | DagangNews - Berita Bisnes Anda
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR 15 Sept - Maybank Investment Bank (Maybank IB) menyifatkan penjualan saham SD Guthrie Bhd susulan penerbitan sukuk boleh tukar (ES) oleh Permodalan Nasional Bhd (PNB) sebagai keterlaluan dan tidak wajar. Menurut firma penyelidikan itu asas SD Guthrie kekal utuh meskipun harga sahamnya mengalami tekanan baru-baru ini. Tambahnya, reaksi pasaran terhadap penerbitan ES bernilai AS$300 juta atau RM1.22 bilion oleh PNB adalah tidak berasas kerana instrumen berkenaan tidak memberi kesan kepada pendapatan sesaham (EPS) SD Guthrie. “Kami percaya penjualan saham baru-baru ini adalah tidak wajar kerana tiada perubahan fundamental yang berlaku sepanjang bulan lalu selain penerbitan sukuk boleh tukar AS$300 juta oleh PNB,” katanya dalam nota penyelidikan pada Selasa. Sehubungan itu Maybank IB menaik taraf penarafan SD Guthrie kepada “BELI” daripada “PEGANG”. Disalah tafsir pasaran Maybank IB berkata kebimbangan mengenai potensi tekanan jualan atau lebihan bekalan saham daripada sukuk boleh tukar itu juga telah berakhir dan sebahagian besarnya disalah tafsir oleh pasaran. Ini kerana sukuk tersebut diterbitkan oleh PNB, bukannya SD Guthrie, justeru tiada saham baharu akan diterbitkan oleh kumpulan itu sekiranya pelabur melaksanakan hak penukaran mereka. Selain itu, Maybank IB menganggarkan harga saham SD Guthrie perlu meningkat kepada sekurang-kurangnya RM8.66 sebelum pelabur sukuk boleh menukarkan pegangan mereka kepada saham SD Guthrie. Paras itu jauh lebih tinggi berbanding harga dagangan semasa saham berkenaan. Saham SD Guthrie meningkat daripada RM6.14 pada 9 September, ketika PNB mengumumkan penerbitan sukuk boleh tukar itu, kepada RM6.34 pada Selasa, memberikan kumpulan perladangan itu permodalan pasaran sebanyak RM43.85 bilion. Peningkatan penarafan itu turut disokong prospek pendapatan SD Guthrie yang kekal kukuh. Untung dijangka meningkat Maybank IB mengunjurkan keuntungan bersih teras kumpulan sebanyak RM2.9 bilion bagi tahun kewangan berakhir 31 Disember 2026, iaitu 5% lebih tinggi berbanding konsensus pasaran sebanyak RM2.76 bilion. Bagaimanapun, firma itu berkata jangkaan konsensus pasaran bagi tempoh jangka panjang masih lebih tinggi berbanding unjurannya. Berdasarkan data Bloomberg, sentimen pasaran terhadap SD Guthrie kekal positif dengan 14 daripada 18 firma penyelidikan memberikan penarafan “BELI”, dua “PEGANG” dan dua lagi “OUTPERFORM”. Harga sasaran konsensus Bloomberg bagi tempoh 12 bulan pula ialah RM7.65, membayangkan potensi kenaikan sebanyak 20.9% daripada paras dagangan semasa. Maybank IB mengekalkan harga sasaran RM7.10 terhadap SD Guthrie, berdasarkan 0.55 kali nilai aset bersih disemak (RNAV). Firma itu menjangkakan pertumbuhan masa depan kumpulan akan semakin disokong oleh perniagaan baharu, termasuk pembangunan bersama taman perindustrian melibatkan lebih 20,000 ekar tanah. Perniagaan tersebut disasarkan untuk menjana pendapatan tahunan antara RM500 juta hingga RM700 juta. Selain itu, SD Guthrie turut menyasarkan pembangunan projek solar berskala besar berkapasiti satu gigawatt, sekali gus membuka ruang kepada sumber pertumbuhan baharu di luar perniagaan perladangan tradisional.

title: '2026 Mazda CX-5 – third-gen secures over 600 bookings before launch; Maybank reports circa RM160k price tag
body: 'According to a market insight report by Maybank Investment Bank, Bermaz Auto has secured over 600 bookings for the third-generation Mazda CX-5 ahead of the SUV’s launch on October 8 this year. Bermaz Motor, the official distributor of Mazda vehicles here, previously said the latest CX-5 will initially arrive as a fully-imported (CBU) model before local assembly (CKD) starts “about 12-16 months” later. Estimated pricing for the SUV is said to be from RM170k. In its report, the investment back states that CKD production of the CX-5 will start in mid-2027, with pricing below said estimate at circa RM160k. The report also revealed a new B-segment SUV arriving in either 2027 or 2028, likely priced at around RM120k. This likely points towards the second-generation CX-3, which was confirmed by Mazda last month. As per the Japanese carmaker’s mid-year financial report, the next generation of the CX-3 will be introduced in phases in ASEAN, Japan and other markets from 2027, with Thailand being the production base for the model. Both the current CX-3 and Mazda 2 – the latter sharing the same underlying vehicle platform – have already been dropped from Bermaz Motor’s line-up.

title: 'HE Group berpeluang tambah lagi kontrak baharu capai sasaran RM350 juta pada FY26 – Maybank IB | DagangNews - Berita Bisnes Anda
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR 14 Sept — HE Group Berhad berpeluang menambah lagi kontrak baharu bagi mencapai sasaran pengisian semula buku tempahan sebanyak RM350 juta pada tahun kewangan 2026. Menurut Maybank Investment Bank (Maybank IB), setakat ini ia meraih kontrak bernilai RM293 juta, atau 84% daripada sasaran ditetapkan bagi FY26, dan mencerminkan momentum kerja yang sihat. Perkembangan terbaharu ialah kontrak bernilai RM25 juta daripada pengeluar berkaitan semikonduktor bagi melaksanakan kerja pengagihan tenaga, dan memberikan keterlihatan hasil hingga tempoh 1HFY27. "Kami menganggarkan kontrak ini mampu menjana RM2 juta kepada keuntungan bersih HE Group sepanjang tempoh pelaksanaan, berdasarkan andaian margin 8% bagi projek berkaitan," jelas firma tersebut. Dengan buku tempahan sekitar RM317 juta, atau 2.6 kali ganda hasil bagi FY25, Maybank IB melihat kedudukan kontrak kumpulan itu memberikan sokongan terhadap keterlihatan pendapatan yang stabil. Namun, momentum pengisian semula perlu diteruskan bagi memastikan pertumbuhan kekal mampan, dengan kumpulan itu ada buku tender bernilai RM1.3 bilion sebagai sumber potensi kontrak baharu. Kira-kira 80% terdiri projek pusat data (DC), yang dijangka menjadi pemacu penting pertumbuhan HE Group, terutamanya dalam segmen pembinaan serta kejuruteraan mekanikal dan elektrikal (M&E). "Kami menjangka momentum perolehan kerja baharu terus kukuh pada suku keempat 2026, disokong buku tender yang besar, dengan projek DC berpotensi memberi sumbangan kepada operasi," kata Maybank IB. Firma penyelidikan itu turut mengekalkan sasaran pengisian semula kontrak kumpulan pada RM350 juta bagi FY26 dan RM250 juta masing-masing bagi FY27 dan FY28, selain mengekalkan semua unjuran hasil. Sehubungan itu, bersandarkan potensi positif tersebut, ia tidak mengubah saranan 'pegang' terhadap saham kumpulan berkenaan dengan harga sasaran (TP) juga masih kagi kekal kepada 96 sen sesaham. Penilaian ini berdasarkan gandaan harga kepada pendapatan (P/E) 18 kali terhadap unjuran hasil sesaham (EPS) FY27, iaitu dua sisihan piawai melebihi purata syarikat setara sektor M&E.

title: 'Maybank lengkap ambil alih baki 30.95 peratus ekuiti Maybank Ageas
body: 'PETALING JAYA: Malayan Banking Berhad (Maybank) melengkapkan cadangan pengambilalihan baki kepentingan 30.95 peratus dalam Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad selepas menandatangani perjanjian pembelian saham (SPA) bersama Ageas Insurance International NV (Ageas). Pengambilalihan itu disempurnakan menyusuli kelulusan kawal selia yang diterima daripada Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) bagi membolehkan MAHB kini beroperasi sebagai anak syarikat milik penuh Maybank. Maybank Ageas merupakan syarikat pegangan bagi perniagaan Etiqa di Malaysia dan Singapura yang menyediakan rangkaian lengkap produk insurans hayat dan am konvensional serta takaful keluarga dan am. Presiden dan Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Kumpulan Maybank, Datuk Seri Khairussaleh Ramli berkata, pencapaian itu merupakan mercu tanda penting bagi Maybank dalam usaha memperkukuh aspirasi Etiqa untuk menjadi peneraju insurans dan takaful nasional serta organisasi bertaraf global di bawah strategi ROAR30. “Dengan Maybank Ageas kini menjadi anak syarikat milik penuh, kedudukan Etiqa sebagai peneraju insurans dan takaful nasional semakin kukuh, sekali gus memperluas capaian kepada pangkalan pelanggan Maybank. “Fokus kami adalah untuk memacu nilai kepada pelanggan di seluruh Asia Tenggara melalui tawaran kekayaan serantau, strategi jualan silang serta penyediaan penyelesaian kewangan yang lebih bersepadu,” katanya dalam kenyataan. Menurut beliau, pemilikan penuh itu turut mengukuhkan penciptaan nilai jangka panjang yang mampan menerusi pengurusan modal yang lebih berkesan dan cekap di peringkat Kumpulan Maybank. “Jenama Etiqa kekal sebagai francais insurans dan takaful yang kukuh dan akan terus diletakkan sebagai salah satu jenama utama Maybank. “Kami juga ingin merakamkan penghargaan kepada Ageas atas kerjasama selama 25 tahun bersama Maybank serta sumbangan mereka dalam membangunkan francais Etiqa,” tambahnya. Maybank Ageas berada pada kedudukan kukuh untuk memanfaatkan peluang pertumbuhan dalam sektor insurans dan takaful menerusi pangkalan pelanggan yang besar serta rangkaian pengedaran menyeluruh Kumpulan. Langkah berkenaan turut membolehkan Maybank dan Maybank Ageas meningkatkan keupayaan bagi memacu inovasi produk, memperluas penembusan insurans perbankan dan memperkukuh tawaran takaful di samping meningkatkan kecekapan operasi. – UTUSAN

body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) melengkapkan pengambilalihan baki 30.95 peratus kepentingan dalam Maybank Ageas Holdings Bhd (Maybank Ageas), sekali gus menjadikan syarikat itu anak syarikat milik penuhnya. body: 'KUALA LUMPUR 11 Sept – Malayan Banking Berhad (Maybank) melengkapkan cadangan pengambilalihan baki 30.95% kepentingan dalam Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad (MAHB) dan menjadikan syarikat berkenaan sebagai anak syarikat milik penuh kumpulan perbankan itu. MAHB merupakan syarikat pegangan bagi perniagaan Etiqa di Malaysia dan Singapura yang menawarkan rangkaian produk insurans hayat dan am konvensional serta takaful keluarga dan am menerusi pelbagai saluran pengedaran. Presiden dan Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Kumpulan Maybank, Datuk Sri Khairussaleh Ramli berkata langkah itu menjadi mercu tanda penting dalam usaha kumpulan memperkukuh aspirasi Etiqa untuk menjadi peneraju insurans dan takaful nasional. Kukuhkan Kedudukan Etiqa Di Asia Tenggara Menurut beliau, pemilikan penuh MAHB akan membantu Maybank memperkukuh kedudukan Etiqa sebagai peneraju insurans dan takaful, selain memperluas capaian kepada pangkalan pelanggan Maybank yang besar. Tambahnya, langkah itu juga selaras dengan aspirasi kumpulan untuk mengembangkan kedudukan Etiqa di Asia Tenggara serta membangunkan organisasi takaful bertaraf global menerusi strategi ROAR30. “Maybank akan memberi tumpuan kepada usaha memacu nilai kepada pelanggan di seluruh Asia Tenggara melalui tawaran kekayaan serantau, strategi jualan silang serta penyelesaian kewangan yang lebih bersepadu dan diperibadikan. ARTIKEL BERKAITAN: Maybank terima kelulusan BNM ambil alih baki pegangan Etiqa RM4.83 bilion “Pemilikan penuh MAHB turut membolehkan Maybank meningkatkan penciptaan nilai jangka panjang yang mampan melalui pengurusan modal yang lebih berkesan dalam kumpulan MAHB. “Pada masa sama, langkah tersebut dijangka meningkatkan keupayaan kumpulan untuk mengurus modal dengan lebih cekap di peringkat Maybank secara keseluruhan,” katanya dalam satu kenyataan hari ini. title: 'Maybank 2Q FY26 Net Profit Rises 2.4% to RM2.69 Billion
body: 'Maybank reported a 2.4% year-on-year increase in net profit to RM2.69 billion for the second quarter of FY2026, supported by stronger core fee income, tighter cost control and lower impairment provisions. The banking group also recorded profit before tax of RM3.64 billion, representing a 3.7% increase from the corresponding quarter last year. Return on equity improved to 12.0%, compared with 11.6% a year earlier, while net operating income reached RM7.51 billion. For the first six months of FY2026, Maybank generated RM5.17 billion in net profit. First-half return on equity stood at 11.6%, slightly above the 11.5% recorded during the same period last year. Core Fees Support Maybank Earnings Fee-based businesses provided one of the strongest contributors to Maybank’s quarterly performance. Wealth management fees increased 61.5% year-on-year, while investment banking fees climbed 58.4%. Banking-related fees rose by a more moderate 2.6%. Net fund-based income increased 1.9% over the same period. The stronger fee contribution helped offset softer markets-related income, while Maybank’s Insurance and Takaful operations benefited from improved equity market conditions. Net interest margin also expanded by 10 basis points to 2.10% during the quarter. For the first half, Maybank maintained a net interest margin of 2.12%. Core fees rose 12.1% during the six-month period, with wealth management fees increasing 48.4%. The group attributed the improvement partly to stronger investment and bancassurance income. Investment banking fees also benefited from stronger equity capital markets and related activity. Costs Fall as Maybank Maintains Spending Discipline Maybank reduced overhead expenses by 2.5% year-on-year to RM3.69 billion during the second quarter. The decline brought its cost-to-income ratio to 49.1%. Personnel costs fell 6.9%, while marketing expenses declined 21.9%. However, establishment costs increased as Maybank continued investing in technology initiatives. For the first half of FY2026, total overhead expenses declined 3.9% year-on-year. Lower costs combined with substantially reduced impairment provisions helped support the group’s overall profitability. Net impairment provisions declined 51.6% year-on-year during the first half. Maybank Loan Book Reaches RM695.9 Billion Maybank’s group loans expanded 2.7% year-on-year to RM695.9 billion. Growth strengthened during the second quarter, with loans increasing 1.7% from the previous quarter. Malaysia remained the strongest of Maybank’s major home markets, with loans growing 5.5% year-on-year. Indonesia recorded 4.3% growth, while Singapore loans increased 3.4%. Within Malaysia, Community Financial Services loans grew 5.3%. Consumer lending increased 5.7%, while SME loans expanded 2.7%. Singapore Community Financial Services loans increased 7.4%. Maybank also recorded stronger Global Banking activity in Indonesia, where loans increased 6.1%. The figures point to relatively broad lending growth across the group’s regional operations rather than dependence on a single market. Asset Quality Remains Stable Maybank reported a gross impaired loan ratio of 1.35% during the quarter. Its loan loss coverage ratio stood at 103.1%, or 112.1% excluding the reclassification of a significant restructured borrower. Net credit charge was eight basis points. Excluding the provision reclassification involving that borrower, the figure would have been 20 basis points. Maybank said lower provisions for corporate borrowers helped reduce credit costs. Additional overlays addressing emerging risks and model limitations partly offset the improvement. Those overlays stood at RM2.6 billion. Deposits and Liquidity Remain Strong Maybank continued to expand its current and savings account base during the period. Group CASA balances grew 7.6% year-on-year, lifting the CASA ratio to 41.5% from 37.8%. Malaysia recorded a CASA ratio of 44.0%, while Singapore stood at 34.2%. Indonesia maintained a considerably higher CASA ratio of 63.5%. Maybank’s liquidity coverage ratio stood at 130.0% as of June 2026, while its net stable funding ratio reached 113.4%. The group also maintained a Common Equity Tier 1 ratio of 14.92% and total capital ratio of 18.68%. Quarterly Profit Improves 8.5% Maybank’s performance also strengthened compared with the first quarter of FY2026. Net profit increased 8.5% quarter-on-quarter, while profit before tax climbed 10.7%. Net operating income rose 5.8% to RM7.51 billion, primarily due to stronger core fees. However, net interest margin moderated sequentially as funding costs increased in Malaysia and Indonesia. Maybank President and Group CEO Dato’ Sri Khairussaleh Ramli said the performance reflected continued traction across key businesses and progress on the group’s strategic priorities. He highlighted activity in wealth management, investment banking, Global Markets and Maybank’s major regional markets. Maybank expects its second-half priorities to centre on maintaining execution, converting opportunities into quality earnings and responding to changing market conditions. With first-half net profit reaching RM5.17 billion, the group enters the remainder of FY2026 with improving profitability, stable asset quality and continued loan growth across its core markets.

KUALA LUMPUR (Sept 10): Sunway Construction Group Bhd (KL:SUNCON) could win an estimated RM1 billion in podium and tower contracts for an integrated mixed-use development at the Bukit Chagar RTS Link, Johor Bahru, according to Maybank Investment Bank.

The research house noted that the potential win came from a joint venture development between its parent company, Sunway Bhd (KL:SUNWAY), and Mass Rapid Transit Corporation (MRT Corp), which could increase Sunway Construction’s overall net profit by about RM60 million.

Consequently, Maybank IB mantained its “buy” call and RM9.62 target price, pegged to 17.7 times the financial year ending Dec 31, 2027 (FY2027) estimated price earnings.

Previously, Sunway Construction had secured a RM1.5 billion contract to undertake construction works for the rapid transit system (RTS) transit-oriented development at Bukit Chagar, Johor, in a related-party transaction last year.

At the time of writing, Sunway Construction shares were down three sen or 0.38% at RM7.95, valuing the company at RM10.6 billion.

RM11 billion worth of development value surrounding Bukit Chagar station

Analysts estimate that the total development value surrounding the Bukit Chagar station will reach a combined RM11 billion across the three largest surrounding projects.

The commercial opening of the RTS Link in late 2026 or early 2027 is widely anticipated to catalyse property demand and accelerate construction timelines in the zone.

The three anchor projects driving the node represent a combined gross development value of RM11.1 billion, consisting of the RM5 billion Coronation Square, the RM3.5 billion Causewayz Square, and the RM2.6 billion Sunway-MRT Corp integrated development.

Of the trio, Coronation Square — an eight-tower integrated hub comprising offices, residential units, medical facilities, and an Ascott hotel — is slated for completion by 2029.

Meanwhile, the wider Sunway-MRT Corp integrated development will be phased over eight years, with its primary components targeted for completion between 2033 and 2036.

Binastra emerges as major Causewayz Square’s beneficiary

Causewayz Square, a high-density mixed residential and retail project developed by EXSIM Group, is targeted for full completion by December 2030.

Maybank IB highlighted the project's significance for Binastra Corporation Bhd (KL:BNASTRA), noting that the RM1.3 billion worth of contracts secured from this development accounts for approximately 20% of the builder's outstanding order book.

Within this package, the main RM1.2 billion construction job is projected to contribute roughly RM90 million to the group's net profit.

At the time of writing, Binastra Corporation shares were down one sen or 0.4% at RM2.47, valuing the company at RM2.7 billion.

The proposed 50km elevated transit network will comprise 32 stations across the Skudai, Tebrau and Iskandar Puteri corridors, converging at the Bukit Chagar station.

It will serve as the RTS Link’s feeder and last-mile connection, dispersing up to 10,000 cross-border passengers per hour into the Johor Bahru area.

title: 'Maybank Gets BNM Approval for RM4.83 Billion Ageas Deal
body: 'Maybank is moving ahead with its RM4.83 billion Ageas deal after securing Bank Negara Malaysia’s approval. The bank signed an unconditional agreement on 8 September to acquire Ageas Insurance International’s remaining 30.95% stake in Maybank Ageas Holdings. Maybank will carry out the acquisition through its wholly owned subsidiary Etiqa International Holdings, which currently owns 69.05% of the company. The deal will give the bank full control of Etiqa’s insurance and takaful businesses in Malaysia and Singapore. BNM granted the required approvals on 1 September. The Monetary Authority of Singapore had approved the transaction in March. Maybank will fund the purchase entirely through internally generated funds. It will also pay Ageas a RM34.17 million fee accrued from 1 August until the targeted completion date. Maybank Ageas Holdings will distribute a RM799.99 million dividend to its existing shareholders upon completion. Etiqa International Holdings will receive RM552.38 million, while Ageas will receive RM247.61 million. The bank expects the acquisition to support its regional expansion and allow closer integration between its banking and insurance services. The deal does not require approval from Maybank shareholders and is expected to be completed on 11 September 2026. title: 'Maybank ungguli Anugerah IR Bursa Malaysia 2026 dengan empat pengiktirafan
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR, 7 September 2026 – Bursa Malaysia Berhad mengiktiraf kecemerlangan amalan perhubungan pelabur (IR) menerusi penganjuran Anugerah IR Bursa Malaysia 2026, yang diadakan buat julung kalinya bagi menggalakkan peningkatan standard ketelusan dan komunikasi pasaran modal dalam kalangan syarikat tersenarai awam (PLC). Majlis anugerah berkenaan menyaksikan penyampaian pengiktirafan kepada 32 pemenang merangkumi lapan kategori utama. Malayan Banking Berhad (Maybank) dinobatkan sebagai Syarikat Terbaik dalam IR (Keseluruhan), selain memenangi kategori Pelaporan Kewangan Terbaik serta Syarikat Terbaik dalam IR bagi Sektor Perkhidmatan Kewangan Kategori Permodalan Besar. Presiden dan Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Kumpulan Maybank, Dato’ Sri Khairussaleh Ramli, pula dinamakan sebagai CEO Terbaik dalam IR. Menyampaikan ucaptama pada majlis berkenaan, Ketua Setiausaha Perbendaharaan, Kementerian Kewangan, Tan Sri Johan Mahmood Merican, menegaskan bahawa komunikasi yang terbuka dan konsisten oleh PLC merupakan antara pemacu utama penciptaan nilai jangka panjang serta daya saing pasaran. Sementara itu, Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Bursa Malaysia, Dato’ Fad’l Mohamed, berkata dapatan kajian Bursa Malaysia menunjukkan hanya 32 peratus PLC mempunyai fungsi IR dalaman khusus, manakala 17 peratus menggunakan perkhidmatan pihak luar dan 51 peratus lagi masih belum mempunyai struktur IR yang rasmi. “Apabila jangkaan syarikat, pasaran dan pelabur menjadi semakin matang, perhubungan pelabur yang berkesan melangkaui sekadar menyampaikan prestasi kewangan. Ia membantu pelabur memahami kedudukan strategik syarikat untuk masa hadapan,” katanya. Antara pemenang utama lain termasuk Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB) bagi kategori Komunikasi Kelestarian Terbaik, Malkit Singh Maan daripada Hong Leong Bank Berhad bagi kategori CFO Terbaik dalam IR, serta Oriental Kopi Holdings Berhad bagi kategori Syarikat IPO Terbaik dalam IR. Penilaian pemenang dilaksanakan menerusi pendekatan berasaskan pasaran yang melibatkan pelabur serta penganalisis tempatan dan antarabangsa. title: 'Maybank Now Lets MAE Users Invest From RM10 With Savings+
body: 'Maybank customers can now invest in a Shariah-compliant money market fund through the MAE app from RM10. The new Savings+ feature provides access to the fund, which is managed by Maybank Asset Management. It aims to maintain liquidity by investing in relatively short-term and liquid assets. Potential returns stood at up to 3.32% per annum as of 30 June 2026. Returns are calculated daily and credited monthly. They are not guaranteed and may vary depending on market conditions and fund performance. Users can complete the required onboarding and suitability assessment, monitor their investment performance and set up automatic monthly investments within the app. Savings+ has no lock-in period. Investments and withdrawals are processed within an average of two business days. Mohd Amri bin Mohd Sofian, Head, Community Financial Services Malaysia said, “At Maybank, we believe investing should be as simple and accessible as everyday banking. With Savings+, customers can start their investment journey from just RM10 and manage their money seamlessly within the MAE app they already use daily. This reflects our commitment to humanising financial services by making wealth-building more accessible, convenient and relevant to every Malaysian.” The launch expands MAE’s range of investment products, which includes the Maybank Islamic Gold Account-i, Maybank Goal-Based Investment and ASNB Investment. Maybank Savings+ is available to new and existing customers. Savings+ is an investment product rather than a savings or deposit account. Customers should review the relevant product documents for details on fees, risks and processing times. title: 'Maybank to acquire rest of Maybank Ageas for RM4.83 billion
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) has entered into an unconditional share purchase agreement (SPA) with Belgium-based Ageas Insurance International NV to acquire the remaining 30.95% equity interest in Maybank Ageas Holdings Bhd (MAHB) for RM4.83 billion. In a filing with Bursa Malaysia today, Maybank said the agreement involves acquiring 78 million MAHB shares from Ageas. The banking group said it signed the SPA today after receiving approval from Bank Negara Malaysia on Sept 1 and that the purchase consideration will be funded entirely through internally generated funds. Maybank said the proposed acquisition is intended to enable it to wholly own MAHB and provide the group with greater strategic flexibility. “The acquisition is also aimed at strengthening MAHB’s position as a national insurance and takaful player, supporting expansion across Southeast Asia, enhancing sustainable and resilient long-term value for the Maybank group, and improving capital management efficiency across its insurance and takaful franchises. “Full ownership of MAHB is expected to provide both Maybank and MAHB with greater strategic agility to accelerate product innovation, deepen bancassurance penetration, expand takaful propositions, and enhance capital and operational efficiency across the insurance and takaful franchises,” it said. Barring unforeseen circumstances, Maybank said that the proposed acquisition is expected to be completed on Sept 11. Maybank Investment Bank Bhd has been appointed as the principal adviser, while Morgan Stanley Asia (Singapore) Pte has been appointed as its international financial adviser.

title: 'Maybank, Ageas meterai perjanjian ambil alih MAHB bernilai RM4.38 bilion
